Organiser
Raul Bautista
Raul Bautista

Missions tagged to it

Replayable
No

Payout
Not confirmed
Not confirmed

How heists work in GTA 6
A heist is not one mission. It is a chain: scouting the target, recruiting people, stealing equipment, a planning step and then the job itself. Lists mark the planning steps (Heist Planning, Heist Plans in Place) as their own entries, though PowerPyx has no walkthrough page for them, which suggests they are short.
Why it matters: setup missions are split between the two leads. Several are marked for Jason only or Lucia only, so if a heist seems stalled, switch character and check the map. The controls are in how to switch characters in GTA 6.
Who runs the heists: Raul Bautista
Rockstar introduced Raul Bautista before launch as an experienced bank robber who is always looking for talent. In the game he tests the pair before he trusts them. Lucia's first job for him is Car Service, a car theft from a gang chop shop, and the missions that follow lead to his crew.
Tip: Raul's missions arrive by message after a wait, not from a map marker you can visit at will. If nothing new appears, let a day of game time pass.
The Cartel Heist (Chapter 3)
The first story heist is a bank job on Sinfrontera National Bank. PowerPyx tags these missions as part of it, in this order:

#
Mission
Notes from the lists

1
Sinfrontera National Bank
Scope out the bank

2
Security Expert

3
Heist Planning
Planning step

4
Company Property
Meet Brian

5
Safe Word
Steal a practice safe

6
The Missing Link
Meet Andrea; Lucia only

7
Hidden Charges
Meet at the planning room; prepare the explosives

8
The Cartel Heist
Start the heist

GTABase lists the same eight names in Chapter 3, with a slightly different order in the middle, and its heist guide describes Safe Word as the mission where Lucia learns a new skill on the practice safe. Both lists end Chapter 3 with The Cartel Heist.
Why it matters: because the heist closes the chapter, finish Chapter 3's optional missions first. Two of them are time-sensitive, as covered below.
The VCIA Takedown (Chapter 4)
The second heist targets the airport and takes up much of Chapter 4. PowerPyx tags fifteen entries:

Phase
Missions
Played as

Lucia's side
Making Gainz, Blood Sweat and Gear, Amateur Hour, Call Nate, Cash Injections, Dirty Work, Nate Will Be in Touch, Power Play, Team Building
Mostly Lucia

Jason's side
Too Much Baggage, Close Surveillance, Delivery Method
Jason

Together
Fully Catered, Heist Plans in Place, VCIA Takedown
Both

GTABase's heist guide adds two details: in Too Much Baggage Jason scouts the airport, and Fully Catered is about stealing a catering truck. After the heist both lists place a mission called Tie Up Loose Ends.
Tip: this is the longest preparation in the game, and it runs alongside unrelated Chapter 4 missions. Keep a manual save from before Making Gainz if you think you may want to see the build-up again.
Smaller scripted robberies along the way
The story teaches robbery in steps before Raul appears. All of these have walkthroughs on this site, linked from the mission list:

Mission
Chapter
What it is

3
Three jewelry stores

Why it matters: each one introduces something the heists reuse, such as safes with codes, security footage, alarms and escaping with a bag.
The free-roam robbery system
Outside missions, the map index has a Robberies section that lists targets. Guides describe these types:

Stores, restaurants and gas stations, held up at the register.
Smash 'n' Grabs: jewelry stores and pawn shops.
Banks and Payday Loan stores.
Bank vaults, which open late in Chapter 4. Guides report $100,000 or more per vault and an instant four-star wanted level.
Gang operations: guarded compounds with cash and valuables.
Safes and ATMs, including ATMs you can pull out with a winch.

The 100% checklist counts them: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs and 8 vaults, all of which are required. See GTA 6 100% completion. A silver trophy asks for five bank vaults.
Tools that make robberies easier

Tool
From
What it does

Slim jim
Moses, Chapter 2
Opens ordinary cars

Snap Gun
First delivery in Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
Opens doors without the alarm

Cut-off tool
Meet the Heders
Cuts open SCOOP containers

Tip: get the Snap Gun before you rob any jewelry store in free roam. Back doors lead straight to the offices where footage is destroyed and alarms are switched off.

Getting the money home
Stealing is half the job. Loot other than cash goes into a bag and has to reach a fence. Three open in early Chapter 3: Yasmani for jewelry and marked bills, Tyrone for goods and Randy for vehicles. Cash in your pocket is lost if you are wasted or busted, so deposit it at an ATM. The full breakdown is in how to make money in GTA 6, and police behaviour is in GTA 6 wanted level.
Missable missions before each heist
Two optional missions are marked time-sensitive and missable by both lists:

Race Against Yago in Chapter 3.
This Is a Free Call From… in Chapter 4, for Lucia.

PowerPyx says such missions show an hourglass on the map and that missing them does not affect trophies or 100%.
How GTA 6 heists differ from GTA 5
GTA 5 built its story around a handful of heists where you chose an approach and hired a crew from a board. For GTA 6, no guide we have read documents a choice of approach or crew, and GTABase's heist guide does not mention one. What is clearly different is scale: fifteen tagged missions for one heist is far more preparation than any GTA 5 job needed. Other changes are in GTA 6 new features.
What is not confirmed

Payouts for the Cartel Heist and the VCIA Takedown.
Approaches and crew. Whether you choose either.
Fail states and choices inside the two finales. We have not yet matched two walkthroughs.
Raul's Fleeca decoy. PowerPyx describes a mission, First Impressions, in which Raul uses a bank robbery as a distraction. We are waiting for a second guide.
That's Where the Money Is… An optional Chapter 4 mission on both lists; its content is not yet described by two guides.

What to do before each heist

Make a manual save in a spare slot. See how to save and why missions cannot be replayed.
Finish optional missions, especially any with an hourglass.
Sell loot and bank your cash.
Stock ammunition and healing items for both characters.
Check both characters' maps for a setup mission you have not started.

What this means for you
If you came for heists, expect to wait: the first one ends Chapter 3, many hours in. The game fills that time with smaller jobs that pay well and teach the same skills, and the free-roam robberies go on after the story. Treat the two story heists as the peaks and Yasmani's stores, vaults and gang operations as the regular income. For where the heists sit in the full story, see how many chapters are in GTA 6 and the mission list.
What we will add to this page

Step-by-step walkthroughs for each setup mission as two guides confirm them.
Payouts for both heists.
Any approach or crew choices, once verified.
More safe codes from Chapter 3 and Chapter 4.

Q: How many heists are in GTA 6?
A: Two story heists: the Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and the VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Around them are smaller scripted robberies and a free-roam robbery system with banks, vaults and gang operations.

Q: What is the first heist in GTA 6?
A: The Cartel Heist, a job on Sinfrontera National Bank organised by Raul Bautista. It is the last mission of Chapter 3.

Q: Can you replay heists in GTA 6?
A: No. Missions cannot be replayed, so make a manual save before the final mission of each heist if you want to play it again.

Q: How much do GTA 6 heists pay?
A: No two guides give matching figures for the story heists yet. Confirmed smaller payouts include $20,000 for Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs and $10,000 for Afternoon Delight.

---

# GTA 6 Here, Kitty Kitty Walkthrough: Find Charles

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-here-kitty-kitty-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Here, Kitty Kitty is a Jason-only Chapter 3 mission from Tyrone, started at the apartment complex in La Perle.
- You can pay a man $20 for Charles's whereabouts or break into his Rockridge apartment and read a thrift store receipt.
- Finishing it unlocks Tyrone as a drop-off for goods, according to PowerPyx.

This GTA 6 Here, Kitty Kitty walkthrough covers a short tracking job for Tyrone: find a man called Charles, follow him through a camp and bring back what he was carrying. There is no shooting if you play it as the guides suggest. PowerPyx subtitles it Speak with Tyrone.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3)

Playable character
Jason only

Given by
Tyrone, the dealer from Dealer's Choice

Starts at
Apartment complex in La Perle, Vice City

Requirement
Part 1 of Dubious Provenance

Bring
$20 in cash if you want the quick route

Reward
Tyrone as a goods drop-off

GTABase lists a separate entry called Tyrone just before this one, described as Jason going to see Tyrone about work; PowerPyx treats that visit as the start of this mission.
Objectives

Go to Charles' apartment.
Find out where Charles is.
Go to the camp in La Perle.
Chase after Charles.
Approach Charles.
Search Charles' body.

Step-by-step
1. Charles' apartment
Tyrone wants Charles found and says he lives in Rockridge. At the apartment you have two options.

Option
What to do

Pay
Give the man in the doorway $20 for a tip. You need the cash on you.

Break in
Nobody is home. Inspect the Aline's Thrift Store receipt in the bedroom; Jason asks Tyrone, who supplies an address.

2. The camp
Go to the homeless camp on the north-west edge of La Perle and break open the door on the ground floor.
3. The chase
Charles runs when he sees you. Follow him up the stairs on the far side of the building. If anyone attacks on the way, use your fists.
4. The top floor
Charles goes over the wall at the top. Take the stairs back down and search him. You pick up a bag of Kitty Litter, and the mission ends.
Where players fail

Arriving with no cash. The $20 tip is only offered if you are carrying the money. Cash in your pocket is also at risk if you are wasted, so do not carry more than you need.
Using guns in the camp. Melee keeps the chase simple, and both guides advise it.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Unlock
Tyrone as a drop-off for goods (PowerPyx)

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Jason's other mission at this point is Boobie Time, which unlocks a second fence, Yasmani. For where each kind of loot sells best, see how to make money in GTA 6. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Here, Kitty Kitty walkthrough mission?
A: Finish the first part of Dubious Provenance, then visit Tyrone at the apartment complex in La Perle as Jason.

Q: How do you find out where Charles is?
A: Either pay the man in the doorway of his Rockridge apartment $20, or break in and inspect the Aline's Thrift Store receipt in the bedroom. Tyrone then gives you an address.

Q: Should you shoot the people at the camp?
A: No. PowerPyx and GTABase both say to knock out anyone who attacks with melee.

Q: What do you get for Here, Kitty Kitty?
A: PowerPyx lists Tyrone as a new drop-off for goods. GTABase lists one unlock without naming it.

# GTA 6 Hit Avery Pawn Walkthrough: Rob the Pawn Shop

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-hit-avery-pawn-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Hit Avery Pawn is an optional Chapter 2 robbery at the pawn shop in Port Gellhorn, marked after Coffee Break.
- Threatening the staff can reveal the code for the back safe; breaking a display case or the door brings a two-star wanted level.
- The mission is complete once you escape; selling the bag at Dunk's trailer is what turns the loot into cash.

This GTA 6 Hit Avery Pawn walkthrough shows how to empty the pawn shop in Port Gellhorn and get away with a full bag. It is the first proper store robbery you plan yourself, and a tutorial for the loop that funds the rest of the chapter: threaten, grab, escape, fence.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Hit Avery Pawn (Chapter 2, optional)

Playable characters
Jason or Lucia

Given by
Lucia

Starts at
The pawn shop, Port Gellhorn

Requirement
Finish Coffee Break

Reward
Cash, depending on how much you steal and sell

Tip: park a fast motorbike outside before you start. Both guides name it as the best getaway.
Objectives

Rob the pawn shop.
Lose the cops.
Fence the stolen goods (optional).

Step-by-step
1. Threaten the staff
Walk in, draw your gun and aim at the staff. Keeping them under threat may get you the combination for the safe in the back.
2. Smash the display cases
Break the cases and take the jewelry.
3. Open the back safe
Break the door to the back room and enter the code on the safe. PowerPyx's code was 6499, with a warning that it may be randomized, so use the one the staff give you.

Action
Consequence

Breaking a display case or the door
The police are called: two-star wanted level

Leaving quickly
You can be gone before they arrive, with less loot

Staying for everything
More loot, and the police at the door

4. Lose the cops
Get out of the search area. A quick motorbike that can weave through traffic works well, and so does heading off-road. See how the wanted level works.
5. Fence the loot
Carry the bag to Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn. This step is not required to finish the mission, but an unsold bag is worth nothing. PowerPyx lists what fences take: jewelry, narcotics and marked bills.
Where players fail

Leaving the getaway to chance. Sort the vehicle first.
Leading the police to Dunk. Lose the wanted level before you drive to the trailer.
Skipping the fence. The payout only arrives when the goods are sold.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Cash
Varies with what you take; neither guide gives a figure

Fence
Dunk's trailer, available after Slam Dunk

100%
GTABase marks the mission as counting towards 100%

The sister job is tougher: Hit Kingpin Bowling. Both feed the $15,000 for Prepare for Vice City; more ways to earn are in how to make money in GTA 6. Order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What is the safe code in the GTA 6 Hit Avery Pawn walkthrough?
A: It may differ for each player. PowerPyx got 6499 but warns the code may be randomized; threaten the staff and they may give you yours.

Q: Where do you sell the loot from Avery Pawn?
A: Take the bag to Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn. Dunk works as a fence once you have finished Slam Dunk.

Q: Do you have to fence the goods to finish Hit Avery Pawn?
A: No. PowerPyx and GTABase both say fencing is optional for completing the mission, but it is where the money comes from.

Q: What wanted level do you get in Hit Avery Pawn?
A: Two stars, triggered when you break a display case or the door.

---

# GTA 6 Hit Kingpin Bowling Walkthrough: Let's Go Bowling

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-hit-kingpin-bowling-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Hit Kingpin Bowling is an optional Chapter 2 raid on a bowling alley in Port Gellhorn held by the Kolts gang.
- Loot all three key valuables for the Let's Go Bowling trophy: the Luxury Watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the office safe.
- Bring sticky bombs for the safe, body armor and five Zombix; you leave with a two-star wanted level.

This GTA 6 Hit Kingpin Bowling walkthrough lists what to buy before the raid and where each of the three key valuables is. Unlike the pawn shop job, this one is a gunfight from the first step: the bowling alley belongs to the Kolts, and they do not hand anything over. It carries a bronze trophy, Let's Go Bowling.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2, optional)

Playable characters
Jason or Lucia

Given by
Lucia

Starts at
The bowling alley, Port Gellhorn

Requirement
Finish Coffee Break

Reward
Cash from fenced loot, a unique shotgun, a collectible watch, a trophy

Preparation
Both guides give the same shopping list.

Prepare
Where
Why

Call your partner
Hold Right on the D-pad and ask to meet up
A second gun

Five Zombix
Any convenience store
Healing

Body armor
Ammu-Nation
Refill it with the clerk

Sticky bombs
Ammu-Nation
The only way into the safe

Objectives

Rob the compound.
Flee the compound.

Step-by-step
1. Shoot your way in
There is no quiet option in either guide. Enter and clear the Kolts room by room, with your partner covering.
2. Collect the three key valuables

Valuable
Where

Luxury Watch (a collectible)
South-east room

Gutterball Moreland 850 (unique shotgun)
On the pool table in the north-east corner

Safe
Small office in the north-east corner; open it with a sticky bomb

Tip: all three are needed for the trophy. Count them off before you walk out.
3. Flee
Leaving the building gives you a two-star wanted level. Take the nearest vehicle and get out of the search area. The trophy appears shortly after you have driven away.
If you miss something
The bowling alley has a long cooldown. Both guides say it becomes available again in Chapter 3, a few in-game weeks later, and that you can then pick up whatever you left; the trophy still unlocks.
Where players fail

No sticky bombs. Without them the safe stays shut.
Going in alone and unarmored. The building is full of gang members.
Leaving after the safe. The watch and the shotgun are in other rooms.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Trophy
Let's Go Bowling (bronze), for all three valuables; see the trophy guide

Gutterball Moreland 850
Unique shotgun

Luxury Watch
Counts as a collectible; see GTA 6 collectibles

Cash
Depends on what you take and sell to a fence (PowerPyx)

100%
GTABase marks the mission as counting towards 100%

Neither guide gives prices for the supplies or a payout figure. The easier robbery of the pair is Hit Avery Pawn. Both help with Prepare for Vice City. Order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where are the three valuables in the GTA 6 Hit Kingpin Bowling walkthrough?
A: The Luxury Watch is in the south-east room, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun is on the pool table in the north-east corner, and the safe is in the small office in the north-east corner.

Q: How do you open the safe in Kingpin Bowling?
A: Blow it open with a sticky bomb. Buy them at Ammu-Nation before you start.

Q: Is the Let's Go Bowling trophy missable?
A: No. PowerPyx and GTABase say the bowling alley respawns in Chapter 3 after a few in-game weeks, so you can return for anything you missed.

Q: What wanted level do you get after Kingpin Bowling?
A: Two stars when you leave the building.

# GTA 6 How Do I Look? Walkthrough: Buy a New Outfit

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-how-do-i-look-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- How Do I Look? is a quick Chapter 2 mission: Lucia buys a new outfit.
- You need one top and one pair of pants or shorts; any items count.
- Bargain World, in the south of Port Gellhorn, is the cheap store the mission points you to.

This GTA 6 How Do I Look? walkthrough covers the second half of Lucia's makeover: after the haircut in New Look, she needs clothes. It is a shopping mission with a single objective and no way to fail, and it is a good moment to learn how clothing stores work.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
How Do I Look? (Chapter 2)

Playable character
Lucia

Given by
Lucia (self-started)

Location
Bargain World, south Port Gellhorn

Requirement
Finish Girl's Trip

Reward
None listed

Objectives

Buy a new outfit: a top and pants.

Step-by-step
1. Go to Bargain World
The store is in the south of Port Gellhorn. The mission description offers a choice between shopping around and getting cheap clothes here; both guides send you to Bargain World.
2. Buy a top
Browse the tops and buy one. There are plenty of options and none is required.
3. Buy pants or shorts
Add a pair of pants or shorts. With both pieces bought, the mission completes.
Tip: the objective needs two separate items. A top alone will not finish it.
If you are short of cash
PowerPyx repeats the advice from New Look: mug someone or rob another store's register. If you have finished Moses, selling an untracked car is the lower-risk way to fund both errands.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail condition. The usual hold-up is buying only one of the two pieces.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None (PowerPyx)

Prices
Not listed by either guide

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

What you buy goes into Lucia's wardrobe; swapping outfits later is explained in how to change clothes and hair in GTA 6. While you wait for the next story call, see Painkiller Supplier. Chapter order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where do you buy clothes in the GTA 6 How Do I Look walkthrough?
A: At Bargain World, a clothing store in the south of Port Gellhorn. The mission text says you can also shop around.

Q: What do you need to buy to finish How Do I Look?
A: A top and a pair of pants or shorts. PowerPyx and GTABase both say any choice works.

Q: When does How Do I Look? unlock?
A: After Girl's Trip in Chapter 2, at the same time as New Look.

# GTA 6 Impounded Vehicle Walkthrough: Get Lucia's Car Back

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-impounded-vehicle-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Impounded Vehicle is an optional Chapter 2 mission: Lucia's personal car is impounded automatically after Breakfast Run.
- The car is a green icon near the police station in Port Gellhorn; driving through the fence brings two stars.
- It doubles as a tutorial: later, the Scooter Bros app can return an impounded vehicle for a fee.

This GTA 6 Impounded Vehicle walkthrough covers the quickest of the four jobs that follow Coffee Break: stealing Lucia's own car back from the police. It takes a couple of minutes and teaches a rule that matters for the rest of the game, which is what happens to a registered car you abandon at a crime scene.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Impounded Vehicle (Chapter 2, optional)

Playable characters
Lucia or Jason

Given by
Lucia

Location
Impound lot near the police station, Port Gellhorn

Requirement
Finish Coffee Break

Reward
Lucia's personal vehicle back

Objectives

Steal Lucia's personal vehicle from the impound.

Step-by-step
1. Find the green car icon
Lucia's car, the one registered in Moses, is impounded automatically after the robbery spree in Breakfast Run. It appears as a green car icon in Port Gellhorn, next to the police station.
2. Go through the fence
Drive through the fence around the lot. Two officers see you, and you get a two-star wanted level.
3. Swap cars and leave
Jump into Lucia's car and get out of the search area. Off-road trails work well around Port Gellhorn; see how the wanted level works.
Tip: arrive in a vehicle you do not mind losing. You leave it in the lot when you switch.
How impounding works afterwards
Both guides treat the mission as a tutorial and give the same rules.

Rule
Details

What gets impounded
A personal vehicle used in a crime and left in the police search area

What does not
Stolen, unregistered vehicles

Getting it back the easy way
The Scooter Bros app on your phone returns it instantly for a fee

Premium tier
$12,500; includes daily credits for free returns

Neither guide states the standard fee.
Why it matters: for robberies, a stolen car is the better getaway vehicle. Keep the registered one out of the search area.
Where players fail

Lingering in the lot. The officers are already on you; switch and go.
Using a second registered car to break in. It can end up impounded in turn.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Access to Lucia's personal vehicle again (PowerPyx)

100%
GTABase marks the mission as counting towards 100%

The other three jobs from the same scene are Thrillbillies, Hit Avery Pawn and Hit Kingpin Bowling. Order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where is the car in the GTA 6 Impounded Vehicle walkthrough?
A: At the impound lot near the police station in Port Gellhorn. It shows on the map as a green car icon.

Q: How do you get a car out of the impound in GTA 6?
A: In this mission you drive through the fence and take it, which brings a two-star wanted level. Afterwards you can also pay a fee in the Scooter Bros app to have an impounded vehicle returned at once.

Q: Why does a car get impounded in GTA 6?
A: Both guides say a personal vehicle used in a crime and left inside the police search area is eventually found and impounded.

# GTA 6 Just Moved In Walkthrough: Buy the Supplies

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-just-moved-in-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Just Moved In is a short Chapter 2 errand for Lucia: buy eight supplies for the motel room and bring them back.
- The shop is the convenience store at the gas station across the road from the Starlet Motel; items are paid for as you take them.
- Collecting everything and returning to the room raises the relationship between Jason and Lucia.

This GTA 6 Just Moved In walkthrough lists the eight supplies Lucia has to buy and the quickest way to finish the errand. Jason cannot leave the motel bed, so Lucia stocks the room. It is a shopping trip with no enemies, but one item list differs between guides and there is a small catch on the way back.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Just Moved In (Chapter 2)

Playable character
Lucia

Given by
Jason and Lucia

Starts at
Starlet Motel, Kelly County

Requirement
Finish What's in the Bag?

Reward
Relationship increase

Objectives

Buy supplies.
Return to the motel.

Step-by-step
1. Cross the road
Go to the gas station opposite the motel and enter its convenience store. PowerPyx and GTABase call it the Alpha convenience store; VGC just says the grocery store.
2. Collect the eight items
The items show on the minimap. PowerPyx notes that this depends on minimap markers being switched on in the interface settings.

Item
PowerPyx and GTABase
VGC

Yes
Yes

Six items match everywhere. The fruit is the same thing under two names; for the last one, simply follow the final marker.
Tip: VGC suggests Focus Mode (press L3 and R3 together) if you cannot spot an item on the shelves.
3. Walk out
Each item is charged the moment you take it. There is no need to queue at the counter.
4. Return to the room
Take the supplies back to your room at the motel and speak to Jason.
VGC adds a warning: if you drove and you wreck the vehicle or wander too far from it, you are sent back to the store. The shop is across the street, so walking avoids the problem.
What happens next
VGC's guide continues the scene: the motel manager comes to talk about the rent, and Jason asks for stronger painkillers, which sends Lucia to Vicki in Room 10. PowerPyx and GTABase treat those as separate missions: Overnight Charges and Girl's Trip.
Where players fail

Missing an item. Count eight before you leave.
Losing the car. Keep any vehicle intact and close, or go on foot.
Minimap markers off. Turn them on if nothing appears.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Relationship increase (PowerPyx, VGC)

Cost
Charged per item; no guide lists the prices

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Lucia also keeps checking on Jason through the chapter: see Take Care of Jason. The order of Chapter 2 is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where is the store in the GTA 6 Just Moved In walkthrough?
A: At the gas station across the street from the Starlet Motel. PowerPyx and GTABase name it the Alpha convenience store.

Q: What items do you need to buy in Just Moved In?
A: Eight: soda, protein bars, gauze, a bandana, hair clippers and a makeup bag, plus fruit and one more item that guides list as either soup or soap.

Q: Do you have to pay the clerk in Just Moved In?
A: No. All three guides say each item is paid for when you pick it up, so you can walk straight out.

Q: What do you get for finishing Just Moved In?
A: A relationship increase, according to PowerPyx and VGC. VGC says you need all the groceries for it.

# GTA 6 Mami Knows Best Walkthrough: Mia's House Flip

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-mami-knows-best-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Mami Knows Best is a Lucia-only Chapter 3 mission from her mother, Mia, starting in Peacock Bay.
- You clear junk from a house for sale in Hamlet, save Mia from an alligator in the pool and smash the neighbours' property with an excavator.
- There is no reward; GTABase marks the mission as required for 100%.

This GTA 6 Mami Knows Best walkthrough covers Lucia's first mission with her mother in Vice City, which starts as yard work and ends with an excavator. It is easy, with one moment where you have to react quickly. PowerPyx subtitles it Catch Up With Mia.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Mami Knows Best (Chapter 3)

Playable character
Lucia only

Given by
Mia Caminos

Starts at
Peacock Bay, Vice City

Requirement
Finish Dealer's Choice

Reward
None

Objectives

Drive to the house.
Follow Mia.
Explore the house.
Help Mia.
Clear the junk from the front lawn.
Follow Mia.
Grab the mattress.
Save Mia.
Get in the excavator.
Smash up the gang member's property.
Get in Mia's car.
Drive to Mia's office.

Step-by-step
1. Drive to Hamlet
Meet Mia in Peacock Bay, get in her car and drive to the marked neighbourhood in Hamlet, where she has a house to sell.
2. Look around
Follow Mia inside and walk through the rooms while she inspects them. The place is in no state to sell. Go back towards the entrance and interact with Mia to help her up.
3. Clear the lawn
Pick up each piece of junk on the front lawn, carry it to the blue dumpster and press R2 (RT on Xbox) to throw it in. Keep going while Mia is on the phone.
4. The mattress and the alligator
Follow Mia to the backyard and interact with the mattress in the pool. Hold L2 + R2 (LT + RT) and tap X (A) to drag it out.
An alligator comes out with it and grabs Mia's leg. Shoot it quickly.
5. The neighbours
Members of the M7 gang from the house next door hold you at gunpoint, tell you to stay away and leave.
6. The excavator
Mia points you to an excavator across the street. Drive it to the gang's house and damage the building and the cars in the driveway. Press R1 (RB) to close the claw; you can pick the cars up and throw them around.
7. Back to the office
When enough is destroyed, get back in Mia's car and drive to her office nearby to finish.
Where players fail

Reacting slowly at the pool. Have a gun ready before you touch the mattress. Alligators are one of more than 170 species in the game; see GTA 6 animals.
Leaving the excavator early. The prompt to return to the car only appears after enough damage.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Payment
None

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Follow-up
Mia returns later in Chapter 3 in South Leonida Real Estate, listed by both guides

Other missions open at the same point: Dubious Provenance for both characters and Here, Kitty Kitty for Jason. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Who can play the GTA 6 Mami Knows Best walkthrough mission?
A: Only Lucia. Meet Mia in Peacock Bay after finishing Dealer's Choice.

Q: How do you pull the mattress out of the pool?
A: Hold L2 and R2 together (LT and RT on Xbox) and tap X (A on Xbox).

Q: How do you save Mia from the alligator?
A: Shoot it straight away. It jumps out of the pool and grabs her leg as soon as the mattress moves.

Q: Does Mami Knows Best give a reward?
A: No. PowerPyx lists the reward as none.

# GTA 6 Map: All Confirmed Regions of Leonida

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-map/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 is set in the fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida.
- Six regions are officially named: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
- Rockstar has not published an official map image or a map size.

GTA 6 is set in Leonida, a fictional state modelled on Florida. Rockstar's official site names six regions. Here is what each one is.
Interactive GTA 6 map
Click a region (or pick it from the list) to see what it is and jump to our guides for that part of Leonida.

Where each region is

Mount Kalaga National Park runs along the northern border of the state.
Port Gellhorn sits on the west coast.
Ambrosia is inland, next to Lake Leonida.
Grassrivers covers the swampy south-west.
Vice City is on the south-east coast.
Leonida Keys stretch south of Vice City.

These positions are what Rockstar's descriptions and several mapping guides agree on. Exact borders and distances will only be clear once a full in-game map is documented, so our map above is a schematic, not a to-scale copy.
Confirmed GTA 6 locations

Region
What it is

Vice City
The main city: beaches, nightlife and neon, inspired by Miami

Leonida Keys
A chain of tropical islands off the mainland, inspired by the Florida Keys

Grassrivers
Swamp and wetland wilderness, inspired by the Everglades

Port Gellhorn
A run-down coastal town on Leonida's forgotten coast

Ambrosia
An industrial heartland town built around a sugar refinery

Mount Kalaga National Park
Forested hills and backcountry in the north of the state

Vice City
Vice City returns for the first time since 2002's GTA: Vice City, now as a modern city. Expect the dense urban centre of the map here, along with the beach districts shown in the trailers.
Leonida Keys
The Keys are where Jason Duval is based at the start of the story, working for local drug runners.
Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga
These regions make up the rest of the state: wetlands, a faded coastal town, an industrial town and a national park. They give the map its countryside, in the way Blaine County did for GTA 5.
What is not confirmed

Map size. No official figure exists.
A full map image. Maps shared online before launch are fan-made from trailers and screenshots.
Interiors and exact landmarks. We will document these on separate pages once verified in the game.

We will add location guides for collectibles, shops and activities to this section after release.

Q: Where does GTA 6 take place?
A: GTA 6 takes place in the fictional US state of Leonida, which includes Vice City and the surrounding regions. It is inspired by Florida.

Q: What cities are in GTA 6?
A: Vice City is the main city. Rockstar has also named the towns and areas of Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia, plus the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga National Park.

Q: How big is the GTA 6 map?
A: Rockstar has not given an official size. Comparisons with GTA 5 that you see online are fan estimates.

Q: Is there an official GTA 6 map?
A: Rockstar has described the regions on its website but has not released a full official map image before launch.

# GTA 6 Meet the Heders Walkthrough: Dockyard Container Job

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-meet-the-heders-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Meet the Heders is a Chapter 3 mission from Brian that starts at the bag of clothes in the Bayside apartment bedroom.
- Lucia cuts into the top SCOOP container at the dockyard, then chases the trailer on a bike and drives the car out of it.
- The reward is the cut-off tool, which both Jason and Lucia keep for opening SCOOP containers around the map.

This GTA 6 Meet the Heders walkthrough covers a dinner that turns into a car theft: Lucia breaks into a shipping container and drives a very fast car out of a moving trailer. It also hands you a permanent tool. PowerPyx subtitles the mission Meet Brian & Lori.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Meet the Heders (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason at dinner, Lucia for the job

Given by
Brian Heder

Starts at
The bag of clothes in the bedroom, Bayside apartment

Requirement
Dealer's Choice, Cal's visit about the hard drive, then a wait of a day or two

Reward
Cut-off tool

Objectives

Go to the restaurant.
Meet Brian at the bar.
Go to the van.
Open the van's rear doors.
Go to the dockyard.
Search the dockyard for the SCOOP containers.
Break into the container.
Steal the car from the container.
Break the car out of the container.
Lose the cops.
Drive to the lockup.

Step-by-step
1. Dinner on the rooftop
Drive Lucia to the restaurant on the east side of Vice City and take the elevator up. At the bar you can pick up the two drinks and hand one to Lucia, then follow everyone to the table.
Tip: when the waiter comes, order the Surf and Turf that Lucia asked for. Both guides report a relationship bonus. More on that system in GTA 6 romance.
2. Talk to Brian
When the women leave, join Brian at the railing. He offers a cigar; accept or decline. When prompted, switch to Lucia: hold Right on the D-pad, then press R1 (RB on Xbox).
3. The van
As Lucia, cross the bridge. A white van sits in the parking lot on the right. Open its rear doors. Lucia changes into a disguise and ends up in the driver's seat.
4. Into the dockyard
Drive south to the dockyard gate and wait a few seconds to be let in. Park nearby.
5. Find and cut the container
Look for the yellow SCOOP containers. The target is the one on top of the central stack. Interact with its door to use the cut-off tool, and hold R2 (RT) so the bar stays inside the marked section, which cuts faster.
The lower containers open the same way. The first has a cigar and $600 in small boxes.
6. Chase the trailer
A scene shows gang members hauling the container away on a trailer. Take a nearby bike and catch up; men in the truck bed shoot at you. Get close to the back of the container and hold Square (X) to jump on.
7. Break the car out
Interact with the car inside and hold L2 (LT) until it breaks free and reverses out.
8. Lose the police and deliver
The car is very fast. Both guides give the same advice: stay on the highway, do not crash and keep driving until the police give up. Then take it to the lockup in the north-west corner of the city and drive inside.
Where players fail

Leaving the highway during the escape. Side streets make a crash more likely in a car this quick. For how the search works, see GTA 6 wanted level.
Hanging back from the trailer. The jump prompt only appears close to the container.
Letting the cutting bar drift. Keeping it in the marked zone is what speeds up the cut.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Cut-off tool
Kept by both characters; opens SCOOP containers around the map

Side loot
Cigar and $600 in the first lower container

Relationship
Bonus for ordering the Surf and Turf

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

About a day later Raul messages Lucia from a blocked number, which starts Car Service. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you unlock the GTA 6 Meet the Heders walkthrough mission?
A: Finish Dealer's Choice, wait for Cal to check the hard drive at the apartment, then wait a day or two of game time for Brian to get in touch. The mission starts at the bag of clothes in the bedroom.

Q: What should you order at dinner in Meet the Heders?
A: The Surf and Turf. Lucia asks for it, and both PowerPyx and GTABase say ordering it gives a relationship bonus.

Q: Which container do you open in Meet the Heders?
A: The yellow SCOOP container on top of the central stack. The lower ones can be opened too; the first holds a cigar and $600.

Q: What does the cut-off tool do in GTA 6?
A: It cuts the locks on SCOOP containers. Both characters keep it after this mission, so you can open the containers you find around Leonida.

# GTA 6 Mission List and Walkthrough Hub

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-mission-list/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: live

- GTA 6 opens with the Prologue; Chapter 1 runs from Gone Fishing to Discharge Time, and the story has five chapters.
- We add each mission to this list in story order once its name, objectives and steps are verified.
- Every walkthrough covers objectives, a step-by-step route, common fail points and optional goals.

This page is the home of our GTA 6 mission list. Rockstar Games has not published a list of missions, so we add missions here in story order as each one is verified in at least two independent walkthroughs. The first 54 are listed below, each with a walkthrough.
How the mission list works

Story order. Missions are listed in the order the story unlocks them, grouped by the character or contact who gives them.
One page per mission. Each mission gets its own walkthrough, linked from this list.
Verified first. A mission appears only when its name, objectives and steps have been checked against the game.

What each walkthrough includes

Before you start: where the mission begins, which protagonist you play, and anything worth buying first.
Objectives: the on-screen goals in order.
Step-by-step route: what to do at each stage, with the safest approach.
Where players fail: the usual causes of a mission failure and how to avoid them.
Optional goals and rewards: bonus objectives and what the mission unlocks.

What is confirmed about the story

You play as two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
The story is set across the state of Leonida; see the GTA 6 map guide.
Rockstar describes the launch game as a single-player experience; see GTA 6 online.

Mission list
The story is split into a Prologue and numbered chapters. The missions below are the ones whose names and order match in at least two independent walkthroughs. # GTA 6 Money Cheat: The $250,000 Code and How to Unlock It

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-money-cheat/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: partly

- The reported GTA 6 money cheat is Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right.
- It gives $250,000 and unlocks only after you finish the main story.
- Using it disables saving and trophies for that session.

The GTA 6 money cheat is Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right, and it adds $250,000 to your cash. It is entered on the D-pad through the in-game phone and is the same on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The catch is timing: like every cheat in the game, it only works after you have finished the story. This page covers the code, the exact steps, what it switches off, and what to do for money before the credits.
The code matches on every cheat list we have compared since launch, including GTABase, Red Bull and Beebom. Rockstar has not published an official list, so the page stays marked partly confirmed.
GTA 6 money cheat at a glance

Detail
Info

Code
Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right

Effect
Adds $250,000

Platforms
PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; D-pad only, so identical on both

Unlock condition
Finish the main story

Extra unlock task
None reported

Saving
Disabled while a cheat is active

Trophies and achievements
Disabled for the session

Works online
No; the game launched without an online mode

How to enter the money cheat

Finish the main story. The Cheats section appears under the Progress tab after the credits.
Save your game, because an active cheat turns saving off. See how to save in GTA 6.
In free roam, press Up on the D-pad to open the phone.
Hold L1 + R1 on PS5 or LB + RB on Xbox Series X|S. Some guides word it as holding L1 (LB) and then pressing R1 (RB).
Enter: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right.

Tip: the code is a simple pattern. The first four inputs go clockwise around the D-pad from Up; the last four go anticlockwise from Up.
Why it is locked until the end
Launch guides agree that the Cheats menu does not exist until the credits have rolled, and that entering a code before then does nothing. The money cheat is one of the few with no further task: finishing the story is its only condition.
Why it matters: the cheat cannot solve the problems money causes during the story, such as the motel debt in Behind on Payments or the $15,000 that GTABase lists for the Chapter 2 mission Prepare for Vice City. It is a free-roam reward. How far away that is depends on the count you use; see how many chapters are in GTA 6.
What it costs you

Effect
While a cheat is active

Saving
Disabled

Trophies and achievements
Disabled for the session

Story progress
Not affected, since the story is already finished

GTABase adds the detail that matters most for this particular cheat: because saving is off until you quit, anything you do after entering a code is lost when you leave the session, and loading your earlier save restores trophies.
Why it matters: if that description is right, the $250,000 is spending money for the current session rather than a permanent top-up to your save. We have not seen a second guide spell this out, so test it with a spare manual slot before you rely on it either way.
Can you use it more than once?
No guide we have checked states a limit or a cooldown, and none confirms that repeated entries stack. We will add the answer when two sources report the same result. Beebom alone says a cheat can be switched off by entering its code again, which would not apply to a one-off cash payment in any case.
Tip: whatever the answer, enter the code only after a manual save, so you can return to a clean file with trophies enabled.
How it compares with older GTA games

Game
Money cheat

GTA 3 and GTA: San Andreas
Yes, available from the start; San Andreas also gave $250,000

GTA 4
No direct money cheat

GTA 5
No money cheat in story mode

GTA 6
Yes: $250,000, after the story

GTA 6 brings the money code back but treats it as a reward for finishing rather than a shortcut. The same goes for the other 60 cheats, most of which also ask for a separate task such as shooting-range medals or stunt jumps. The full list is on our GTA 6 cheats page.
Money before the credits: what works instead
Until the cheat unlocks, the income has to be earned. Our money guide covers the methods that at least two launch guides agree on:

Method
Available from
Reported payout

Store hold-ups
Start of the game
Small

Selling stolen cars to Moses
Early Chapter 2
About $1,000 or a little more per ordinary car

Daily Driver for Moses
Chapter 2
$1,250, plus $500 for good condition

Jewelry store robberies
Chapter 3
About $10,000 to $20,000

Bank vault robberies
Late Chapter 4
$100,000 or more per job

Tip: cash you carry is lost when you are wasted or busted. Open the bank account in Buck Me and deposit at an ATM before anything risky. That habit is worth more than any single job.
What is not confirmed

An official code list. Rockstar has not published one; every code comes from launch guides.
Repeat use. Whether the cheat can be entered again and again in one session.
Whether the cash can be kept. The reports that saving stays off until you quit suggest it cannot, but only one guide says so directly.
A PC version. The game is not out on PC, so there are no console commands or typed codes.

Checklist before you use it

Story finished and the Cheats section visible under Progress.
Manual save made in a slot you will not overwrite.
In free roam, not in a mission.
Phone open with Up on the D-pad, shoulder buttons held.
Code entered: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right.
When you are done, quit and reload the manual save to get saving and trophies back.

What this means for you
If you have just started, forget the money cheat for now; it is dozens of hours away and the story is balanced around earning. If you have finished, it is a quick way to try the expensive cars, weapons and properties in a throwaway session. Either way, the wanted system still applies to whatever you do with the cash: see how the wanted level works.
What we will add to this page

Our own test of the code in the released game, on both consoles.
Whether the cheat stacks and whether the money survives a reload.
Rockstar's official list, if one is published.
Any change to the code after a title update; patches are tracked in GTA 6 updates.

Q: What is the money cheat in GTA 6?
A: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right on the D-pad gives $250,000, according to several launch guides.

Q: Can you use the GTA 6 money cheat at the start of the game?
A: No. The Cheats menu is reported to unlock only after the main story is finished.

Q: Does the money cheat work in GTA 6 online?
A: No. Cheats are for story mode, and the game launched without an online mode.

# GTA 6 Moses Walkthrough: Register Your First Car

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-moses-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Moses is the Chapter 2 mission that teaches car theft: scanning for trackers with WAiNK and opening doors with the Slim Jim.
- Moses only accepts a car with no tracker that was not stolen next to his garage; the main road through Port Gellhorn is a safe place to find one.
- You leave with the Slim Jim, the Scooter Bros delivery app and a registered personal vehicle for Lucia.

This GTA 6 Moses walkthrough covers the mission that gives Lucia her own car and turns stolen vehicles into income. Moses runs a garage in Port Gellhorn. He shows you how to tell which cars are safe to take, hands you a tool for quiet break-ins and registers your first vehicle. PowerPyx lists the mission as Take a Vehicle to Moses.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Moses (Chapter 2)

Playable character
Lucia, solo

Given by
Moses

Starts at
Moses's garage, Port Gellhorn

Requirement
Finish Girl's Trip

Rewards
Slim Jim, Scooter Bros app, a registered personal vehicle

Objectives

Bring a car to Moses.
Follow Moses and scan the vehicles with WAiNK.
Pick up the Slim Jim and break into the Montagne XL.
Follow Moses back inside.
Steal a suitable vehicle (only if yours was rejected).
Register your new personal vehicle.

Step-by-step
1. Drive into the garage
Any car starts the mission. Whether Moses keeps it depends on step 5.
2. Scan the three cars in the yard
Moses leads you behind the garage, where three vehicles are parked. Bring up the WAiNK app and scan each one. PowerPyx gives the quick input: hold Up on the D-pad, then hold R1 (RB on Xbox). The result appears in the bottom-right corner; VGC adds that the scan also shows what garages will pay for the car.

Scan result
What it means

No tracker
Safe to steal, sell and register. Usually cheap cars

Standard tracker
Police are told where the car was stolen. Usually mid-range cars

Advanced tracker
Police are called if you drive too slowly. Usually supercars; needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3

3. Slim Jim
Pick up the Slim Jim beside Moses and use it on the Montagne XL.

Step
PS5
Xbox

Start at the car door
Triangle
Y

Find the spot
Tilt the right stick until the bar turns from white to pink
Same

The Slim Jim opens a locked car without an alarm. VGC notes it does not work on keyless cars, mostly high-end models.
4. Back to the garage
Moses offers to register a stolen car for you.
5. If your car is rejected
Moses turns away tracked cars and cars taken too close to his shop. Go to the big main road through the middle of Port Gellhorn, scan until you find one with no tracker, and drive it back.
Tip: scan before you steal. It costs nothing and saves a wasted trip.
6. Respray and register
Choose a new colour, then select Register. The car becomes Lucia's personal vehicle.
Where players fail

Bringing a tracked car. You will be sent out again.
Stealing on Moses's street. He refuses cars taken near the garage.
Rushing the Slim Jim. Move the stick slowly and stop when the bar turns pink.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Slim Jim
Quiet break-ins on locked cars

Scooter Bros app
Delivers your registered vehicle to you near a road

Personal vehicle
The first registration is free

Selling cars
Moses buys untracked stolen cars; the garage shuts for a minute or two after each sale

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

To register more cars you need more garage slots or have to sell a registered one. Selling to Moses is the fastest income at this stage of Chapter 2; more methods are in how to make money in GTA 6. Moses's next job is Daily Driver. Chapter order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What car should you bring in the GTA 6 Moses walkthrough?
A: Any car without a tracker. If yours has one, Moses sends you to fetch another; PowerPyx and GTABase suggest the main road through the middle of Port Gellhorn.

Q: How do you use the Slim Jim in GTA 6?
A: Press Triangle on PS5 or Y on Xbox at the car door, then tilt the right stick until the bar turns from white to pink. It opens the car without setting off the alarm.

Q: What does the Moses mission unlock?
A: The Slim Jim, the Scooter Bros app that delivers your registered car, a free registered vehicle for Lucia, and the option to sell untracked stolen cars to Moses.

Q: Can Moses register cars with trackers?
A: No. Cars with an advanced tracker need the Key Cloner, which PowerPyx and GTABase say comes in Chapter 3.

# GTA 6 New Look Walkthrough: Change Lucia's Hair

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-new-look-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- New Look is a one-minute Chapter 2 mission: Lucia changes her hair at the Pearl House Hair Salon in Port Gellhorn.
- Buying any hairstyle completes it at once; there is no required style.
- It unlocks after Girl's Trip and has no listed reward.

This GTA 6 New Look walkthrough is short because the mission is: Lucia needs a different hairstyle, and one purchase ends it. After the escape that closes Chapter 1 she has to look less like herself. The mission pairs with How Do I Look?, which does the same for her clothes.
Before you start

# GTA 6 Overnight Charges Walkthrough: See Linda, the Manager

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-overnight-charges-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Overnight Charges is a one-step Chapter 2 mission: leave the room and talk to Linda, the motel manager, at reception.
- If Jason bought the necklace in Chapter 1, Lucia hands it over as collateral and the mission ends at once.
- Inspect the map on the reception wall before you leave: it uncovers the Port Gellhorn area on your map.

This GTA 6 Overnight Charges walkthrough covers Lucia's first meeting with Linda, the manager of the Starlet Motel. The room has to be paid for, Lucia has almost no money, and the conversation sets up a debt you clear later in the chapter. It takes about a minute, but two things in the reception are worth doing before you walk out.
Before you start

Step-by-step
1. Walk to reception
Leave the motel room. The reception is on your left.
2. Talk to Linda
Linda is not friendly and wants the room paid for now. GTABase puts the bill at $900, the rent plus 10%, and says Lucia starts Chapter 2 with only $146.
3. The necklace
If Jason bought the necklace during Chapter 1 (the optional task Buy Lucia a Necklace, covered in the Coming Home walkthrough), Lucia hands it to Linda as collateral. That satisfies her for now and the mission ends.
PowerPyx describes a timed "Give the necklace" prompt and says letting it run out changes nothing: Lucia gives the necklace anyway.
Why it matters: the necklace is not lost. Both guides say it comes back when you pay the $900 in Behind on Payments.

Optional goals and rewards

Q: How do you finish the GTA 6 Overnight Charges walkthrough?
A: Walk out of the motel room, enter the reception on your left and speak to Linda at the front desk. The conversation ends the mission.

Q: Can you keep Lucia's necklace in Overnight Charges?
A: Not at this point. PowerPyx says Lucia gives it up even if you let the timer on the prompt run out. You get it back when you pay the room in Behind on Payments.

Q: How much do you owe Linda in GTA 6?
A: $900. GTABase describes it as the rent plus 10%, and PowerPyx gives the same total in the follow-up mission Behind on Payments.

# GTA 6 Painkiller Supplier Walkthrough: Wait for Dunk's Call

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-painkiller-supplier-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Painkiller Supplier is a waiting mission in Chapter 2: Dunk phones Lucia when he has a lead on pills for Jason.
- It has no map marker and completes by itself; playing other missions is the fastest way to bring on the calls.
- After the first call it is renamed Dunk Will Be in Touch; the second call starts the mission Slam Dunk.

This GTA 6 Painkiller Supplier walkthrough explains a mission with one instruction: wait for a call. At the end of Girl's Trip, Dunk promises to ask his supplier for painkillers. The mission sits in your list until he phones, and players often think it is bugged because nothing on the map points to it. GTABase's mission list shows the same entry as Got Pills?.

Q: Why is Painkiller Supplier not on the map?

# GTA 6 Prepare for Vice City Walkthrough: Earn $15,000

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-prepare-for-vice-city-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Prepare for Vice City is a passive Chapter 2 objective: earn at least $15,000 by any means.
- Afternoon Delight pays $10,000 and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab pays $2,000, so the marked jobs cover most of it.
- With $15,000 and the other main missions done, the motel room is marked for the chapter finale, Checking Out.

This GTA 6 Prepare for Vice City walkthrough is a money plan: the mission has one objective, and it is to have $15,000. It sits in your list from Coffee Break until the end of Chapter 2 and is the first place where the story stops for players who are broke. The good news is that the jobs already on your map pay almost all of it.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Prepare for Vice City (Chapter 2)

Playable characters
Jason and Lucia

Given by
Lucia

Starts at
The coffee room of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County

Requirement
Finish Coffee Break

Reward
None; it unlocks the chapter finale

Objectives

Earn at least $15,000.

Where the $15,000 comes from
Both guides recommend the same seven marked jobs. The payouts below are the ones the guides state.

Job
Payout
Notes

Afternoon Delight
$10,000
Paid by Vicki via BuckMe the next day; main mission

Thrillbillies
Up to $2,500
First place in the race

Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab
$2,000
Needs Thrillbillies first

Hit Avery Pawn
Varies
Fence the loot with Dunk

Hit Kingpin Bowling
Varies
Fence the loot; also a trophy

Impounded Vehicle
None
Gets Lucia's car back

Veteran Hunted
Not stated
Jason only, per PowerPyx

Earlier income counts too: $1,700 from Dunk after Slam Dunk and up to $1,750 from Daily Driver.
Tip: the three fixed payouts alone come to $14,500 with a race win. One fenced bag from either robbery, or a couple of cars sold to Moses, takes you over the line.
Step-by-step
1. Work through the marked jobs
Do them in any order. Afternoon Delight needs a call from Vicki, which comes some time after Coffee Break.
2. Bank as you go
Both guides say to deposit cash in BuckMe as you earn it, because money you carry can be lost if you die. The account is explained in the Buck Me walkthrough.
3. Top up if needed
Sell untracked cars to Moses or see how to make money in GTA 6.
4. Watch for the motel marker
When you have $15,000 and the other main missions are finished, the Starlet Motel room is marked. That is the start of Checking Out.
Where players fail

Carrying everything in cash. One death during a robbery can undo an hour.
Spending on cars and clothes first. Registration and outfits come out of the same pot.
Walking into the finale unprepared. Both guides warn that Checking Out ends Chapter 2 and that the Starlet Motel is gone as a home for good. Finish what you want in Port Gellhorn before you enter the room.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None directly (PowerPyx)

Unlocks
Checking Out, the last mission of Chapter 2

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

How the chapters fit together is in how many chapters are in GTA 6; the full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How much money do you need in the GTA 6 Prepare for Vice City walkthrough?
A: At least $15,000. PowerPyx and GTABase both give the same figure.

Q: What is the fastest way to get $15,000 in Chapter 2?
A: Do the marked jobs. Afternoon Delight pays $10,000, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab $2,000 and a Thrillbillies win $2,500; the two robberies add fenced loot.

Q: What happens when you reach $15,000?
A: Once the other main missions are also finished, the room at the Starlet Motel is marked on the map. Going there starts Checking Out, the last mission of Chapter 2.

Q: Does the $15,000 have to be in the bank?
A: Neither guide says where the money must be held. Both recommend depositing it in BuckMe so you do not lose it if you die.

# GTA 6 Reviews: Scores, Metacritic and What Critics Say

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-reviews/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: live

- GTA 6 holds a Metacritic score of 99 as of November 19, 2026, with no mixed or negative reviews.
- IGN, GameSpot, VGC, Eurogamer, GamesRadar+ and Game Informer all gave it their top score.
- The main complaints are the 30 FPS target and minor performance dips.

GTA 6 reviews are overwhelmingly positive: the game has a Metacritic score of 99 as of November 19, 2026. Reviews went live on November 18, the day before launch. This page collects the aggregate scores, what individual outlets gave it, the few low scores and their reasons, and how it ranks against the best-reviewed games ever. Scores move as more reviews arrive, so treat the numbers below as a launch-week snapshot.
Every outlet score here appears on Metacritic or in at least two review round-ups. Verdicts are our paraphrases, not quotes.
GTA 6 review score on Metacritic and OpenCritic

Site
Score on November 19, 2026
Notes

Metacritic
99
About 150 critic reviews; none mixed or negative

OpenCritic
98 to 99
As reported by review round-ups on November 18 and 19

A 99 ties the highest Metascore on record, held since 1998 by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. For comparison, GTA 4 scored 98, and GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 each scored 97.
Metacritic's review count differed slightly between parts of its page when we checked, and round-ups quote between 146 and 156 reviews. User scores were not yet open.

Each score above appears in at least two review round-ups or on Metacritic. The verdicts are our paraphrases, not quotes.
What critics praise

The world. The scale, density and detail of Leonida and Vice City is the most common point of praise.
Jason and Lucia. Reviewers describe the two-lead story as more personal than earlier GTA games.
Systems that connect. Driving, traffic, police response and robberies are singled out for how they work together.
Polish. Several reviews note how finished the game feels for its size.
Driving. IGN's review, as summarised by TheGamer, singles out the car handling and traffic as the best in the series.
Themes. The New York Times review praises the story's depth, according to the same round-up.

Why it matters: the praise is spread across systems, story and world, which is unusual. Most open-world games are reviewed as strong in one and weaker in the others. Our own summary of what changed is in GTA 6's new features.
What critics criticise
Complaints are few, and none of them pulled a major score below 9.

30 FPS. The game targets 30 FPS on every console, with no performance mode. See GTA 6 60 FPS.
Minor performance dips. VGC's review mentions them and says they do not spoil the game.
No online mode at launch. GTA 6 launched as a story game only; see GTA 6 online.
Length and pacing. One top-score review on Metacritic says the story could lose a few hours, and ScreenHub found the opening slow.

Tip: if the frame rate is your worry, the settings that make 30 FPS feel smoother are listed on our 60 FPS page, and assists for harder missions are in GTA 6 difficulty settings.
The lowest scores, and why
The spread is narrow, but it is not zero.

Outlet
Score
Reservation

TheSixthAxis
9/10
The lowest among the well-known outlets we saw

The New York Times
9/10
Listed in TheGamer's round-up; praised the game's themes

GameStar
97
Says the game meets and exceeds expectations

ScreenHub
80
Calls large parts of it epic but says other sections are boring and too restricted, with a slow start

ScreenHub's 80 was the lowest score visible on Metacritic's page when we checked. An 80 still counts as a positive review on Metacritic, which is why the site showed no mixed or negative reviews.
Why it matters: the criticisms that do exist are about pacing in the opening hours and about the frame rate, not about bugs or missing content. If you bounce off slow openings, give it until the world opens up in Chapter 2; see how many chapters are in GTA 6.
How GTA 6 compares with other top-rated games

Game
Metascore

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
99

GTA 6 (2026)
99

GTA 4 (2008)
98

GTA 5 (2013)
97

Red Dead Redemption 2 (2018)
97

GTA 3 (2001)
97

GTA: San Andreas and GTA: Vice City
95

Several headlines called GTA 6 the highest-rated game of all time. Strictly, it is tied: Ocarina of Time also holds a 99. VICE's round-up makes the case that GTA 6's 99 rests on far more reviews.
Why it matters: "best ever" depends on how you break the tie. What is not in dispute is that no Rockstar game has scored higher.
User reviews
Metacritic's page said user reviews would open at 12:00 pm Pacific time on November 20, the day after launch. Critic and user scores often differ for big releases, so we will add the user score once it has enough ratings to be meaningful, and we will not quote an early number.
Tip: when user scores arrive, read a few of the middling reviews before the highest and lowest ones. They are usually the most informative about everyday annoyances.
Is GTA 6 good?
By the reviews, yes. No critic listed on Metacritic gave it a mixed or negative score on launch day. If a steady 60 FPS matters to you more than anything else, that is the one reason reviewers give to hesitate. The story is long, too; see how long GTA 6 is.
Launch issues and the day-one patch

Day-one patch. Version 01.002.001 rolled out before launch, at about 602 MB on PS5, and is larger on Xbox. Rockstar has not published patch notes. Install size is covered in GTA 6 file size.
PS5 system update. PlayStation Support said on November 17 that a PS5 system software update is required before playing GTA 6.
PSN sign-in problems. On November 18, hours before launch, outage trackers logged more than a thousand reports of PlayStation Network problems. Sony's status page later showed services restored. Neither Sony nor Rockstar linked it to GTA 6.

What is not confirmed

The final review count. Metacritic's own page showed 151 in one place and 158 in another, and round-ups quote between 144 and 156.
The user score. Not open when this page was last checked.
The lowest critic score overall. Only a handful of the 150-plus reviews are visible without paging through the full list.
Reviews of the Xbox version. Almost all launch reviews were of the PS5 version; Metacritic listed 14 for Xbox Series X.

Should you buy it? A quick checklist

You liked GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2: yes, on the strength of these reviews.
You need 60 FPS: wait, or accept 30. There is no performance mode.
You only want online play: wait. There is no online mode yet.
You are short of time: note the length, about 80 hours by one Rockstar developer's own playthrough.
You are choosing an edition: compare them in GTA 6 price and editions.

What this means for you
Reviews this uniform are rare, and they remove most of the risk from a $79.99 purchase. The remaining questions are personal ones: frame rate, time, and whether you were waiting for multiplayer. None of the critics found a broken game.
What we will add to this page

The Metacritic user score once it has settled.
OpenCritic's final average and recommendation rate.
Any notable re-reviews after patches.

Q: What are the GTA 6 reviews like?
A: Almost entirely top scores. GTA 6 sits at 99 on Metacritic as of November 19, 2026, and every critic review listed there is positive.

Q: What is the GTA 6 Metacritic score?
A: 99 out of 100 on launch day, from about 150 critic reviews. The score can move as more reviews are added.

Q: Is GTA 6 good?
A: Critics say yes, with very few reservations. The usual caveats are the 30 FPS frame rate on every console and the lack of an online mode at launch.
