# GTA 6 Romance: How Jason and Lucia's Relationship Works

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-romance/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has one romance: Jason and Lucia. Rockstar says it is optional and grows only if you look after it.
- PC Gamer's launch guide describes a four-step relationship meter, from Running on Empty to Hot Together, raised by small everyday actions.
- You cannot romance Mandy, Vicki or anyone else, and six cheats unlock through time and activities with your partner.

GTA 6 romance comes down to one couple: Jason and Lucia are the only relationship in the game, it is optional, and it moves up or down depending on how you treat your partner. There are no girlfriends to collect as in San Andreas and no dating site as in GTA 4. Instead a relationship level follows the two leads through the whole story. This guide explains how that level works, what raises it, who you cannot romance, and what the relationship unlocks.
Statements from Rockstar come from interviews with Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North. Gameplay details come from launch guides; where only one guide reports something, we name it.
GTA 6 romance at a glance

Question
Answer

Who can you romance?
Only your partner: Jason with Lucia, Lucia with Jason

Is it required?
No. Rockstar calls it optional

How is it tracked?
A relationship level with four steps (PC Gamer)

How do you raise it?
Time together, small gestures, texts, shared activities and jobs

Can you romance Mandy?
No

Can you romance Vicki?
No

Can you cheat on your partner?
No. Reviewers found no way to kiss anyone else

Does it unlock anything?
Six cheats need time or activities with your partner

When can both be together in free roam?
From Chapter 2

The romance is optional, and Rockstar says so
In an interview with IGN ahead of the Netflix extended look, reported by TechRadar in August 2026, Rob Nelson said players who like the idea will find the romance worth it and players who do not can leave it alone, adding that it is not something the studio wants to "foist upon players". The story keeps the two together either way: at the very least they get through it as partners in crime.
Speaking to Edge magazine, as reported by GamesRadar+ on November 1, Nelson put it more sharply: the pair begin the game wanting to be together, and after that the relationship is yours to keep or lose. He traced the idea back to Arthur Morgan's inner conflict in Red Dead Redemption 2.
Why it matters: you are not graded on being a good partner, and no mission asks for a minimum level in any guide we have read. Treat it as a side system with its own rewards.
The four relationship levels
PC Gamer's romance guide, published the day before launch, describes a four-point meter:

Level
Name

1/4
Running on Empty

2/4
Partners in Crime

3/4
Crazy in Love

4/4
Hot Together

According to the same guide, the couple start Chapter 1 in fairly good shape, reaching 4/4 takes a while, and each gain is marked by a chime and a small heart at the right of the screen.
PC Gamer is the only outlet we have seen list the level names, so treat the wording as reported rather than confirmed. The system itself is not in doubt: Rockstar has described it, and mission guides list "relationship increase" as a reward.
Tip: your first chance to move the meter comes before Lucia is even out of prison. The four repairs in Jason's house projects affect where the relationship starts, and they close for good when she is released.
What raises the relationship
PC Gamer's list is long, and most of it is ordinary behaviour rather than set-piece dates:

Type
Actions

Everyday gestures
Holding hands, greeting each other, starting a conversation, a kiss or hug when the heart prompt appears, opening the car door

At home
Sitting on the couch together, going to bed at the same time, choosing Go Out when both are home

Going out
Minigolf, scuba diving, dancing at a club, getting hair done together, parachuting from a plane together

Shopping
Buying clothes or accessories with both of you in the store, complimenting a new outfit or haircut, buying food or drinks for your partner

On the phone
Answering texts, checking in, sending selfies, saying goodnight when apart

Work
Successful crimes together, paying money into the shared BuckMe savings account

TechRadar's summary of the IGN interview mentions the same kind of thing: trips, holding hands, walks on the beach and crimes as a pair.
Tip: the cheapest gains are the ones you would otherwise skip. Answer texts when the phone buzzes, hold hands when you walk somewhere together, and go to bed at the same time when you save. The savings account is introduced in Buck Me.
Story missions that move the meter
Several early missions list a relationship increase as their reward. In Chapter 2, Lucia stocks the motel room in Just Moved In; PowerPyx and VGC both report a relationship boost, and VGC says you need to collect all the groceries to get it. The background mission Take Care of Jason rewards regular visits to the motel room in the same way.
Chapter 1 also has a run of optional errands before Lucia's release, including buying flowers and a necklace. They are covered in the Coming Home walkthrough.
Why it matters: if you ignore the dating side completely, the story still nudges the level up now and then. You have to neglect your partner actively to sink it.
What lowers it
Two sources agree on neglect. GamesRadar+, citing the Edge interview, says ignoring too many late-night calls from your partner causes problems, and Insider Gaming says Rockstar has indicated that neglecting the relationship for too long can end it.
Tip: when you play long stretches as one character, send a text now and then. Switching between the two leads is explained in how to switch characters in GTA 6.
Can you romance Mandy?
No. Mandy appears in the Chapter 1 mission Pipework, where Jason visits her house over unpaid rent and she makes her interest obvious. VGC tested it: however long Jason stays, nothing happens. He can ask for the plunger, turn her down, and keep talking until her lines repeat; eventually she tells him to leave. After the mission she sends one text, and there is no way to follow it up.
Why it matters: there is no hidden branch here, so you lose nothing by finishing the mission quickly.
Can you romance Vicki?
No. Vicki is a side character in Chapter 2 who works at the Delights club in Kelly County and lives at the same motel as Lucia. You spend most of Girl's Trip with her. VGC's guide says Lucia cannot romance her whatever the relationship level, and that after the chapter she is mostly heard from by text or phone.
Can you cheat on Jason or Lucia?
Not in any way reviewers have found. Dexerto's launch report collects the evidence: Bloomberg's Jason Schreier said a visit to a strip club was the closest thing to cheating he found and that you cannot kiss anyone except your partner; Shacknews reported that picking up sex workers, possible since GTA 3, is gone; and The Guardian's review confirmed that private dances remain, alone or as a couple. Strangers around Leonida still flirt with Jason, but it goes no further.
Rockstar's explanation, quoted in the same report, is that it kept the features that fit this story, which the studio describes as a couple in a bind.
Why it matters: this is the first mainline GTA built around a committed pair. If you were looking for the girlfriend missions of San Andreas, they are not here. Other differences are in GTA 6's new features.
What the relationship unlocks
The clearest rewards are cheats. Six of the game's 61 cheats have unlock tasks that need your partner:

Cheat
Unlock task

Golden Hour (screen filter)
Spend 4 hours holding hands

Dollhouse (screen filter)
Spend 8 hours with your partner

Videotape (screen filter)
Complete 50 activities with your partner

Faded Glory (screen filter)
Rob 50 stores with your partner

Pinhole (screen filter)
Clear 25 gang operations with your partner

Drunk
Spend $2,500 on alcohol; it affects both of you

All of them stay locked until the story is finished, like every cheat. The full table with codes is on our GTA 6 cheats page.
PC Gamer also describes practical help on jobs: a partner who assists with aiming, controls bystanders, shoots at police tyres and carries loot. And the guide says intimate scenes appear only at set moments, marked by a double-heart icon over your home on the map or a timed prompt; you cannot start them at will.
Tip: the holding-hands and time-together counters are slow. Start them early and they will be done by the credits without any grinding.
What is not confirmed

Whether a break-up changes the story. Nelson says the romance can be lost and that the pair then carry on as partners in crime. No launch guide we have read documents what a low level changes in missions or in the ending.
Whether a break-up can be forced. A second GamesRadar+ headline says the game will not let you split the two however badly you treat them, which sits awkwardly beside the interview. Until two guides test it, we are not stating either version as fact.
Marriage and multiple endings. Insider Gaming says Rockstar has neither confirmed nor denied marriage. Treat anything more specific as speculation.
Exact numbers. No guide lists how many points each action is worth or how fast the level falls.
Phone calls. GamesRadar+ mentions calls; PC Gamer lists only texts.

How to build the relationship: a quick routine

Finish all four house projects before the mission Coming Home in Chapter 1.
Pay into the BuckMe Family Savings account when you can spare the money. It cannot be withdrawn again, so keep enough in checking for story costs.
Answer every text from your partner, and say goodnight by text when you are apart.
From Chapter 2, when both are at home, choose Go Out for an activity.
Hold hands whenever you walk somewhere together; it also counts towards a cheat.
Shop for clothes together and compliment the result.
Take your partner on store robberies and gang operations to combine relationship gains with cheat progress and cash. See how to make money in GTA 6.
Do not go silent for days when playing solo missions.

What this means for you
If you enjoy the idea, the romance is a low-effort layer on top of things you already do: travelling, shopping, robbing stores. If you do not, Rockstar has said plainly that you can ignore it, and nobody has found a mission that punishes you for doing so. The one group who should pay attention regardless are completionists, because five screen-filter cheats depend on hours and activities spent as a couple.
To get to know the two leads, read our pages on Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
What we will add to this page

What a low relationship level changes, once two guides have tested it.
A list of couple activities by location as the map opens up in later chapters.
Any trophies or achievements tied to the relationship, checked against our trophy guide.
Corrections to the level names if a second source reports them differently.

Q: How does GTA 6 romance work?
A: Jason and Lucia start the game wanting to be together, and a relationship level tracks how it is going. Holding hands, going out, answering texts, shopping together and pulling off jobs as a pair raise it; neglect lowers it.

Q: Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?
A: No. VGC's guide says Jason cannot romance Mandy in the mission Pipework however long he stays at her house; she eventually tells him to leave.

Q: Can you romance Vicki in GTA 6?
A: No. VGC says Lucia cannot romance Vicki at any relationship level. She is a Chapter 2 side character who helps look for painkillers.

Q: Can Jason and Lucia break up in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar's Rob Nelson has said the romance is yours to keep or lose and that the two can end up as partners in crime only. What a break-up changes in the released game is not yet documented by two guides.

# GTA 6 Slam Dunk Walkthrough: Dr. Bill and the Kolts

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-slam-dunk-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Slam Dunk is the Chapter 2 mission that finally gets Jason his painkillers; it starts at Dunk's trailer after his second phone call.
- It has two escapes and one big fight: reverse out of the Kolts' docks, then clear every Kolt at the airstrip south-west of Port Gellhorn.
- Dunk sends $1,700 the next day, becomes a fence for stolen goods and marks two robbery locations.

This GTA 6 Slam Dunk walkthrough covers the hardest fight of Chapter 2 so far: Lucia, Dunk and a retired doctor against the Kolts. It closes the painkiller storyline that began in Girl's Trip. PowerPyx subtitles it Find Painkillers.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Slam Dunk (Chapter 2)

Playable character
Lucia

Given by
Dunk

Starts at
Dunk's trailer, Port Gellhorn

Requirement
Other Chapter 2 missions done, and both of Dunk's calls in Painkiller Supplier

Reward
$1,700 via BuckMe the next day; Dunk becomes a fence

Tip: both guides rely on Zombix for healing in the airstrip fight, so stock up at a convenience store before you go to the trailer.
Objectives

Follow Dunk.
Go to the docks.
Escape the compound and lose the Kolts.
Pick up Dr. Bill.
Go to the meeting spot.
Defend yourself and find Dunk.
Take Dunk to his trailer.

Step-by-step
1. Wait for Dr. Bill
Follow Dunk to a spot behind a dumpster near the convenience store. Time skips to the afternoon and Dr. Bill arrives, pretending not to know Dunk. Follow him to his car, where Dunk pulls a gun and forces him inside.
Bill explains that he has retired and can no longer write prescriptions, but that he used to supply the Kolts.
2. Drive to the docks
The Kolts let the car through the gate. Drive slowly behind the man walking ahead of you.
3. Reverse out
The gang grows suspicious because nobody expected Bill, and they start shooting. Reverse quickly, leave the compound and keep driving until you have lost them.
4. Pick up Dr. Bill
Bill phones Declan, his contact in the Kolts, then jumps out of the car and knocks himself out. Go back for him; he is put in the trunk automatically.
5. The airstrip
Drive to the meeting point at the airstrip south-west of Port Gellhorn. The Kolts shoot Bill at once and turn on you.
6. Clear the area
Kill every Kolt, including the ones inside the buildings. Stay in cover, move slowly and heal with Zombix when needed. Then enter the main building in the middle of the area, where Dunk grabs the pills in a short scene.
7. Drive Dunk home
Take Dunk back to his trailer. Lucia delivers the painkillers to Jason and you are placed outside the motel.
Where players fail

Hesitating at the docks. Reverse the moment the shooting starts.
Rushing the airstrip. Enemies are inside buildings as well as outside; clear them from cover.
Arriving without healing items. This is the first long shootout of the chapter.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Payment
$1,700 from Dunk via BuckMe the next day

Dunk as a fence
Sells stolen goods for you from now on

Robbery locations
Two are marked when Dunk calls the next day

Dr. Bill's body
About $1,000 if you loot it (both guides)

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

GTABase adds a tip for the car you leave in: weigh its sale value against its registration cost, and do not hang around, because the police arrive soon. The fence matters for the robbery jobs that follow Coffee Break. Next comes Jason's call for Breakfast Run. Chapter order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Slam Dunk walkthrough?
A: Finish the other Chapter 2 missions and wait for Dunk to call twice (the waiting mission Painkiller Supplier). Slam Dunk is then marked at Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn.

Q: Where is the meeting spot in Slam Dunk?
A: At the airstrip south-west of Port Gellhorn. The Kolts open fire there; Dunk is in the main building in the middle of the area.

Q: What is the reward for Slam Dunk in GTA 6?
A: $1,700 from Dunk through BuckMe the next day. Dunk also becomes a fence, and his next call marks two robbery locations. Looting Dr. Bill's body gives about $1,000 more.

# GTA 6 Strip Club Locations: All 3 Clubs and What You Can Do

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-strip-club/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: partly

- Launch guides list three strip clubs in GTA 6: NINE1NINE and the Jack of Hearts in Vice City, and Delights in Port Gellhorn.
- Three guides agree a private dance at NINE1NINE costs $300 with $50 tips; prices at the other two clubs come from one guide only.
- Four story missions pass through the clubs, and the Jack of Hearts is the hub for Boobie Ike's missions in Chapter 3.

GTA 6 has three strip club locations: NINE1NINE and the Jack of Hearts in Vice City, and Delights in Port Gellhorn. Two of them matter to the story, one is open from the first hours, and the prices differ a lot between them. This page covers where each club is, when you can get in, what you can do there, which missions use them and which details still rest on a single guide.
A fact appears here as confirmed only when Rockstar or at least two independent guides state it. Everything else is in the section on what is not confirmed.
GTA 6 strip clubs at a glance

Club
Where
Opens
Private dance
Story role

NINE1NINE
Vice City, between Downtown and Crosstown
From the start of free roam
$300 (three guides)
None reported

Jack of Hearts
Vice City, north Crosstown
Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City
$1,000 (one guide)
Boobie Ike's club; mission hub

Delights
Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
Guides differ
$40 (one guide)
Setting of Afternoon Delight

Tips are reported as $50 at NINE1NINE by three guides.
NINE1NINE: the club you can visit first
NINE1NINE is the large venue in central Vice City. Beebom and Skycoach place it in the north of Downtown; Xbox Play and Overdrive describe the same spot as south of Crosstown. Beebom adds that it stands next to a nightclub called The Vault and has its name on the front.
Xbox Play and Overdrive both say it is free to enter and available from the start. Inside, guides describe a dance floor, a bar and a VIP area. Overdrive and Skycoach both call it a parody of a well-known Miami club.
Why it matters: if you just want to see what the clubs are, this is the only one that needs no story progress. The city itself is covered in our Vice City guide.
Jack of Hearts: Boobie Ike's club
The Jack of Hearts is in the north of Crosstown; two guides put it on the same street, though they spell the street name differently. It belongs to Boobie Ike. Rockstar's own character description gives him interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio, and he co-runs the label Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest. See GTA 6 characters.
The club opens through the story. In Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of Chapter 3, Jason and Lucia meet Dre'Quan here, are turned away by the bouncer at the front and go in through the entrance on the other side. The recording studio is upstairs.
Why it matters: this is a mission hub as much as a club. You will come back to it several times in Chapter 3, so learn the side entrance and the stairs.
Delights: the Port Gellhorn club
Delights, which several guides call Delights Cabaret, is in Port Gellhorn in Kelly County. It is where Vicki works. Beebom describes it as the cheapest club on the map.
Guides disagree on when it opens. Beebom says it is available early; Overdrive says it opens with story progress. What both mission guides agree on is that the Chapter 2 mission Afternoon Delight takes place here.
Tip: during that mission it is ladies' night and the bouncer admits only Lucia. As Jason, wait for the two bouncers to walk off and climb the fence behind the building.
What you can do inside
Across the guides, the activities are the same at each club:

Watch the stage shows.
Buy drinks at the bar.
Throw money at the stage. The story teaches this in Welcome to Vice City: hold L2 (LT on Xbox) to focus on a dancer and press R1 (RB) to throw.
Pay for a private dance in a separate VIP area.

To ask for a private dance, hold L2 (LT) to focus on a dancer and choose the option that appears. Beebom gives the button as a short hold of Triangle (Y). Beebom adds that you can also book one at the reception desk near the entrance of NINE1NINE.
Why it matters: the game is rated for adults, and the clubs are part of the reason. If you are deciding whether it is suitable for someone, read how old you have to be to play GTA 6.
Prices: what a visit costs

Cost
NINE1NINE
Jack of Hearts
Delights

Private dance
$300
$1,000
$40

Tip during a dance
$50
$50
$10

Sources
Beebom, Xbox Play, Overdrive
Beebom only
Beebom only

Only the NINE1NINE figures are confirmed by our two-source rule. Beebom's own page is not fully consistent: its general instructions quote $300, while its club sections give the three different prices above.
Tip: you pay in cash. Carried cash is lost if you are wasted or busted, so take what you plan to spend and bank the rest. The reasons are in how to make money in GTA 6.
Missions that take place in the clubs

Mission

Jack of Hearts

Why it matters: none of these require you to use the club's activities. In Welcome to Vice City, Dre'Quan offers cash to throw and both walkthroughs say you can decline.
Jason, Lucia and the relationship
GTA 6 is built around one couple, and Rockstar removed the paid encounters of earlier games to keep the focus there, as Dexerto and Beebom both report. Private dances are as far as the clubs go.
Whether a visit changes the relationship level between Jason and Lucia is less clear. Overdrive says it does not, and that the two can go together or alone, but gives no source. How the relationship meter works, and what does raise it, is in GTA 6 romance.
What Rockstar has said
Rockstar has not published a guide to the clubs. What it has confirmed is narrower:

Boobie Ike's official description ties him to a strip club, and outlets identify it as the Jack of Hearts.
Club interiors appeared in the Extended Look gameplay video in August 2026, which Rockstar said was captured on PS5.
Rob Nelson told IGN that characters across the game have more variety in height and body shape than before. IBTimes notes this was about the whole game, not the clubs specifically.

What is not confirmed

The number of clubs. Beebom and Overdrive count three. Xbox Play lists two and says more may exist. Skycoach treats NINE1NINE as a nightclub.
Prices at the Jack of Hearts and Delights. One guide only.
When Delights opens. Two guides disagree.
Effect on the relationship. One guide, unsourced.
Rules. No guide we read describes being thrown out, weapon checks or a wanted level for misbehaving. Beebom's advice to leave weapons in the car at Delights is not repeated elsewhere.
Other nightlife. Skycoach lists bars and lounges such as The Vault, Effluvia and Hoodwinks. We have confirmed only the Rusty Anchor, the Key Lento bar from the Coming Home mission.
Trophies and cheats. No trophy, challenge or cheat is reported to depend on the clubs.

How to visit a club: step by step

Deposit most of your cash at an ATM and keep what you intend to spend.
For the earliest visit, go to NINE1NINE in central Vice City. For the Jack of Hearts, reach Chapter 3 first.
Walk in on foot. If a bouncer blocks the front door during a mission, look for a second entrance.
Hold L2 (LT) to focus on a dancer for the throw and private dance options.
Leave when your cash is gone; nothing inside is needed for 100%.

What this means for you
The clubs are scenery with a few optional activities, plus two locations the story sends you to anyway. If you are playing for completion, you can ignore them outside the four missions above. If you are exploring, NINE1NINE is the one to see first, and the Jack of Hearts is the one you will know best by the end of Chapter 3. The full story order is in the GTA 6 mission list.
What we will add to this page

Second-source prices for the Jack of Hearts and Delights.
The exact point at which Delights opens.
Whether visits affect the relationship level, once a second guide tests it.
Any other venues that two guides confirm.

Q: Where is the strip club in GTA 6?
A: There are three. NINE1NINE sits between Downtown and Crosstown in Vice City, the Jack of Hearts is in the north of Crosstown, and Delights is in Port Gellhorn.

Q: How many strip clubs are in GTA 6?
A: Three according to Beebom and Overdrive. One guide lists only the two in Vice City, and another files NINE1NINE as a nightclub rather than a strip club.

Q: How much is a private dance in GTA 6?
A: $300 at NINE1NINE, with tips of $50, according to three guides. Beebom alone gives $1,000 at the Jack of Hearts and $40 at Delights.

Q: Does visiting a strip club affect Jason and Lucia's relationship?
A: One guide says it does not, without giving a source. No second guide has tested it, so treat that as unconfirmed.

# GTA 6 Take Care of Jason Walkthrough (Play Nurse)

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-take-care-of-jason-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Take Care of Jason, shown as Play Nurse when you pause, is a background mission that runs through most of Chapter 2.
- It has no map marker: check on Jason at the Starlet Motel each day, and return whenever the motel icon turns from green to pink.
- It cannot be failed or missed and completes by itself after the mission Breakfast Run.

This GTA 6 Take Care of Jason walkthrough explains the one Chapter 2 mission you cannot finish on demand. Jason is laid up in the motel room after the events that end Chapter 1, and Lucia looks after him while she works through the rest of the chapter. The game also calls it Play Nurse. There is nothing to fight and nothing to fail; the only trick is knowing how it progresses.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Take Care of Jason (Chapter 2)

Also shown as
Play Nurse (pause menu during the cutscene, per PowerPyx)

Playable character
Lucia

Given by
Jason

Location
Starlet Motel, Kelly County

Requirement
Finish What's in the Bag?

Reward
Relationship increase (PowerPyx)

Objectives

Check in on Jason regularly.

Step-by-step
1. Find it in the mission list
The mission has no icon on the map. Open Map &gt; Story to see it listed with the other main missions.
2. Visit Jason when you are near the motel
Each in-game day, go back to the room at the Starlet Motel. From time to time a short scene plays in which Lucia takes care of him, and the relationship between the two improves.
3. Watch the motel icon
At certain points in Chapter 2 the story will not move until you return. The motel marker changes from green to pink when that happens.
Tip: you do not need to camp at the motel. Play the other missions and drop in when you come back to save or sleep; see how to save in GTA 6.
4. Keep playing Chapter 2
Both guides say the mission closes by itself after Breakfast Run, late in the chapter. The missions that lead there include:

Overnight Charges

Moses

Daily Driver
Slam Dunk

Where players fail

Looking for a marker. There is none; use the Story tab.
Trying to finish it first. It stays open for most of the chapter by design.
Ignoring a pink motel icon. That is the game telling you the next story step is in the room.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Relationship increase (PowerPyx); GTABase lists one unlock without naming it

Missable
No: both guides call it mandatory

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Neither guide lists a fail state, a cost or a choice in this mission. The full order of the chapter is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you complete the GTA 6 Take Care of Jason walkthrough?
A: You cannot finish it straight away. Keep playing the other Chapter 2 missions, visit Jason at the Starlet Motel when you pass, and the mission completes automatically after Breakfast Run.

Q: Why is there no marker for Take Care of Jason?
A: The mission has no marker of its own. PowerPyx and GTABase both say it is listed under Map > Story, and the motel icon turns pink when the story needs you back there.

Q: Is Play Nurse the same mission as Take Care of Jason?
A: Yes. PowerPyx notes that pausing during the cutscene shows the name Play Nurse; mission lists use Take Care of Jason.

Q: Can you miss Take Care of Jason in GTA 6?
A: No. Both guides call it mandatory and say returning to the motel is forced at several points in Chapter 2.

# GTA 6 Thrillbillies Walkthrough: Mud Club Dirt Bike Race

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-thrillbillies-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Thrillbillies is an optional Chapter 2 mission at the Thrillbilly Mud Club that introduces Billy and his dirt bike crew.
- Rent the Sanchez rather than the Manchez: it costs more but is faster, and the better finish pays the difference back.
- First place pays $2,500 and third about $625; you do not need to win, only to avoid coming last.

This GTA 6 Thrillbillies walkthrough explains how to get through the Mud Club race and start Billy's questline. It is one of the four jobs that appear after Coffee Break, and the safest of them: no police, no shooting, and a cash prize that depends on where you finish. PowerPyx lists it as Check Out the Mud Club, the first of Billy's Strangers and Freaks missions.

Q: How do you unlock the GTA 6 Thrillbillies walkthrough mission?
A: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Wyman mentions the Mud Club on the way to the motel kitchen, and the mission is marked on the map afterwards.

Q: Which bike should you rent in Thrillbillies?

# GTA 6 Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab Walkthrough: Armored Truck

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-twist-wrist-smash-grab-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab is Billy's second mission in Chapter 2: an armored truck robbery on dirt bikes.
- Do not shoot the truck. Follow it until it crashes into a tree, then plant and detonate a charge on the rear doors.
- It pays $2,000, and you can keep the Highwayman Sanchez by parking it in a garage and registering it with Moses.

This GTA 6 Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab walkthrough covers Billy's armored truck job, the best-paid optional mission of Chapter 2 for the time it takes. The crew does the hard part. Your job is to stay on the bike, open the truck and carry the bag. PowerPyx lists it as Join Billy on a Job.

# GTA 6 Welcome to Vice City Walkthrough: Chapter 3 Opener

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-welcome-to-vice-city-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Welcome to Vice City opens Chapter 3 and starts automatically as Jason and Lucia drive into the city after Checking Out.
- You meet Dre'Quan and Boobie Ike at the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown, then move into Boobie's apartment nearby.
- Afterwards Moses texts that Pay 'n' Sprays can buy and register cars with standard trackers.

This GTA 6 Welcome to Vice City walkthrough covers the first mission of Chapter 3, which introduces the city, two new contacts and your new home. There is no combat and nothing to fail. What matters is knowing where the apartment door is and what the mission switches on afterwards.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Welcome to Vice City (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason and Lucia

Starts
Automatically, on the highway into Vice City

Requirement
Finish Checking Out

Reward
Chapter 3 apartment, Pay 'n' Spray car sales, a trophy

Objectives
PowerPyx lists eight on-screen steps; GTABase groups them into four.

Go to the Jack of Hearts.
Enter the Jack of Hearts.
Go to the back of the Jack of Hearts.
Throw money to the dancers.
Return to Dre'Quan when you are ready.
Go to the apartment.
Park at the apartment.
Go to the apartment.

Step-by-step
1. Drive to the Jack of Hearts
After a short drive Jason calls Dre'Quan, who asks to meet at the Jack of Hearts, a club in Crosstown where he runs a record label. The car stops outside on its own.
2. Use the other entrance
Talk to the bouncer at the front door, then walk round to the other side of the building. Dre'Quan comes out there. Follow him through the club to the stairs.
3. Throw money, or don't
Dre'Quan offers you cash for the dancers. If you accept, walk up to a dancer, hold L2 (LT on Xbox) to focus and press R1 (RB) to throw. When the cash runs out, go back to Dre'Quan at the stairs.
4. Meet Boobie Ike
Follow Dre'Quan upstairs. His boss, Boobie Ike, lets the couple stay in an apartment he has nearby.
5. Move in
Return to the car and drive to the apartment. Park in the covered spot. Walk round to the front of the building, climb to the second floor and enter the first door in front of you. The mission ends there.
Tip: both guides note that the door opposite the parking spots can be used as a shortcut from now on.
Where players fail
There is no fail state. The usual hold-ups are:

Waiting at the front door. The bouncer will not let you in; go round the building.
Looking for the apartment door at the back. For this mission you have to enter from the front.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Apartment
Bayside Apartments, 201 (named by PowerPyx)

Parking
Your owned cars are kept in the covered spot for the whole chapter

Pay 'n' Spray
Moses texts after the mission: Pay 'n' Sprays now buy and register cars with standard trackers

Trophy
Both guides list a trophy for completing Chapter 2

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

Selling cars is a steady earner from here on; see how to make money in GTA 6. Moses first appears in the Moses walkthrough. Next up for Jason is Dealer's Choice. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Welcome to Vice City walkthrough mission?
A: You do not need to. It begins automatically on the highway into Vice City as soon as Checking Out ends.

Q: Where is the apartment in Welcome to Vice City?
A: A short drive from the Jack of Hearts. Park in the covered spot, walk round to the front, go up to the second floor and take the first door in front of you. PowerPyx names it Bayside Apartments, 201.

Q: Do you have to throw money at the dancers?
A: No. Dre'Quan offers the cash and both guides say you can accept or decline. Neither reports any consequence.

Q: What does Welcome to Vice City unlock?
A: The Chapter 3 apartment, a parking spot for your owned cars, a trophy for finishing Chapter 2, and car sales at Pay 'n' Spray for vehicles with standard trackers.

# GTA 6 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs Walkthrough: All 3 Safe Codes

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-yasmanis-jewelry-jobs-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- Yasmani wants three items from three Vice City stores: a buffalo skull chain, a diamond ring and an amethyst necklace.
- The safe codes are 1680 at Casa de Empeno, 6815 at Richardson Jewelry and 0104 at Donovan Banks & Co.
- Deliver the first item at once to get the Snap Gun, which opens back doors silently; the three items pay $20,000.

This GTA 6 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs walkthrough gives the three safe codes, the order that makes the robberies easiest and the tool you should collect after the first one. Yasmani, the fence from Boobie Time, wants one item from each of three stores and pays $20,000 for the set.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3)

Playable characters
Jason and Lucia

Given by
Yasmani, who contacts you after Boobie Time

Area
Ocean Beach Banks, Vice City (PowerPyx)

Requirement
Finish Boobie Time

Reward
$20,000, the Snap Gun and a Yasmani pickup service

All three safe codes

Store
Target item
Safe location
Code

Casa de Empeno
Buffalo skull chain
Small back office
1680

Richardson Jewelry
Diamond ring
North-east corner of the central room
6815

Donovan Banks & Co.
Amethyst necklace
Middle of the long back hallway room
0104

Objectives

Plan your order.
Hit Casa de Empeno.
Hit Richardson Jewelry.
Hit Donovan Banks & Co.
Sell to Yasmani.

The stores can be robbed in any order. Both guides recommend the order above.
Step-by-step
1. Casa de Empeno first
This store has no back door, so there is nothing for the Snap Gun to open. It is also the smallest of the three, which makes a fast, loud robbery practical.

Go to the small back office and open the safe with 1680.
Use the security box to the left of the safe to destroy the video footage. If you are gone before the police arrive, they do not get your description.
Smash the display cases on the way out for extra jewelry.

2. Take the chain to Yasmani
Deliver the first item straight away. Yasmani gives you the Snap Gun, which opens doors without setting off the alarm. The guides add that police take longer to arrive when you use it.
3. Richardson Jewelry

Open the back door with the Snap Gun. You enter the back room without alerting the shop floor.
Disarm security at the panel to the right of the door into the central room.
Destroy the footage at the box under the security screen in the central room.
Open the safe in the north-east corner with 6815.
Leave quietly, or go out through the shop and empty the display cases for more money.

4. Donovan Banks & Co.

Open the back door with the Snap Gun.
In the small back office, destroy the footage and disarm security.
Open the safe in the middle of the long back hallway room with 0104.
Leave quietly, or clear the display cases at the front.

5. Sell to Yasmani
Return to Yasmani's shop and sell everything. That completes the mission.
Where players fail

Doing all three before visiting Yasmani. You then rob two stores the hard way. Deliver the first item and collect the Snap Gun.
Skipping the footage. Destroying it is what keeps your description from the police. How that works is in GTA 6 wanted level.
Getting greedy at the front. The display cases are extra money but put you in view of the shop floor. Decide before you open the safe.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Payment
$20,000 for the three requested items

Extra
Money for any other jewelry you sell him

Snap Gun
Yours after the first delivery

Pickup
PowerPyx lists a Yasmani pickup from garage drop-offs as a second unlock

100%
GTABase marks it as required

This is one of the best payouts of early Chapter 3. For other earners see how to make money in GTA 6; for the bigger scores, see GTA 6 heists. Full order: GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What are the safe codes in GTA 6 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs?
A: Casa de Empeno 1680, Richardson Jewelry 6815, Donovan Banks & Co. 0104. PowerPyx and GTABase give the same three codes.

Q: Which store should you rob first for Yasmani?
A: Casa de Empeno. It has no back door, so the Snap Gun would not help there, and it is the smallest store. Deliver its item to Yasmani to get the Snap Gun for the other two.

Q: How much do Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs pay?
A: $20,000 for the three requested items, plus whatever extra jewelry you take from the display cases.

Q: Are Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs optional?
A: Guides differ. GTABase labels them an optional side mission but also required for 100%; PowerPyx counts them as a main mission.

# How Long Has GTA 6 Been in Development?

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/how-long-was-gta-6-in-development/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: partly

- Rockstar's head of development says GTA 6 has been in development since 2015, about 11 years before release.
- Most of the team moved onto the game after Red Dead Redemption 2 shipped in October 2018.
- Bloomberg reported that Rockstar grew from 2,441 staff in 2018 to 4,711 in August 2026.

GTA 6 has been in development for about 11 years, counting from the first work in 2015 to its release on November 19, 2026. That is the longest answer. Most of the team only joined after 2018, so the main production took about eight years. Both numbers are right; they count different things. This page sets out each way of counting, the dated timeline, how big the studio became, how that compares with Rockstar's earlier games and what is still not on record.
Dates below come from Rockstar's own announcements. Everything about the early years comes from named Rockstar staff or from reporting that at least two outlets carried, and is labelled as such.
GTA 6 development time at a glance

Counted from
Length
Why people use it

GTA 5's release, September 2013
13 years
The gap between the two games. It is not development time.

Early work, 2015
About 11 years
Rockstar's Rob Nelson says the game has been in development since 2015.

After Red Dead Redemption 2, late 2018
About 8 years
When most of the team moved onto GTA 6.

Public confirmation, February 2022
4 years 9 months
How long players knew it was being made.

When did GTA 6 start development?
In 2015, in a small way. Rob Nelson, Rockstar's head of development, told the French outlet TroisCouleurs that the game has been in development since 2015, as GamesRadar+ reported in September 2026.
Bloomberg's Jason Schreier described the same starting point in his October 2026 feature on the making of the game. According to reports on that feature, Rockstar staff began research trips to Miami in 2015, and the project carried the code name Project Americas. The early plan was wider than the finished game and was later cut back to Vice City and the state of Leonida. These details come from Bloomberg's reporting, not from a Rockstar announcement.
Why it matters: "11 years" does not mean thousands of people worked on GTA 6 for 11 years. The first years were research and planning by a small group while the rest of the company built another game.
When did full production begin?
Rockstar has never given a date. The evidence points to late 2018.

Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in October 2018, and most of Rockstar worked on it until then.
A former Rockstar North environment artist, David O'Reilly, said in a video that he worked on GTA 6 from 2018 to 2023, after Red Dead Redemption 2 wrapped. GamesRadar+ and Push Square reported this in May 2025.
Reports on the Bloomberg feature put the main development at more than eight years, which matches a 2018 start.

So "since 2018" is a well-supported estimate, not an official statement.
Tip: when you see "8 years" and "11 years" in different headlines, they are not in conflict. Check which starting point the article uses.
The 13-year gap is not development time
GTA 5 came out on September 17, 2013, and GTA 6 on November 19, 2026: thirteen years and two months apart. Rockstar spent the first five of those years on other work, above all Red Dead Redemption 2 and the ongoing GTA Online.
Why it matters: the gap explains the hype, and the development time explains the cost. They are separate questions, and the second is covered in how much GTA 6 cost to make.
GTA 6 development timeline

Date
What happened
Source

Every trailer is listed in GTA 6 trailers, and the last steps before launch are in GTA 6 release date.
How the delays added to the total
The game moved twice: from a 2025 window to May 26, 2026, and then to November 19, 2026. Together that is about a year. The second step alone was 177 days.
Rockstar's public reason both times was more time for polish. Without the two moves, the count from 2015 would have been about ten years.
Why it matters: the delays are a small part of the total. Even on the original 2025 plan, this would have been Rockstar's longest project. The details are in how many times GTA 6 was delayed.
How big is the GTA 6 dev team?
There is no official count of the people who worked on GTA 6. What we have is the size of Rockstar as a whole, from Bloomberg's October 2026 feature:

When
Rockstar employees

2018, at Red Dead Redemption 2's release
2,441

August 2026
4,711, across 12 offices

The company nearly doubled while GTA 6 was being made. Bloomberg also reported that Rockstar set up a Los Angeles studio dedicated to creating the game's non-player characters, and that Rob Nelson said the studio added staff when it saw how many characters had to be written and animated.
Why it matters: not every Rockstar employee works on GTA 6 directly, so 4,711 is an upper limit, not a team size.
How it compares with Rockstar's earlier games
Rockstar does not publish development times, so the fairest comparison uses release dates, which are on record.

Game
Released
Gap since the previous game in its series

Grand Theft Auto V
September 17, 2013
About 5 years after GTA IV

Red Dead Redemption 2
October 26, 2018
About 8 years after Red Dead Redemption

Grand Theft Auto VI
November 19, 2026
About 13 years after GTA V

Each gap is longer than the last, and each game was delayed at least once on the way.
Why it matters: the pattern is useful if you are waiting for anything Rockstar has not dated, such as a PC version. See GTA 6 PC release date.
Why it took so long
Rockstar's public reason for both delays was polish. The Bloomberg feature, as reported, and Rockstar's own descriptions of the game add the rest:

A late start. Most of the studio was finishing Red Dead Redemption 2 until October 2018.
The size of the world. Rockstar's developers describe Leonida as about twice the size of GTA 5's map; see GTA 6 map size.
The number of characters. Enough that Rockstar opened a studio for them.
Density. More than 170 animal species and far more interiors than earlier Rockstar games; see GTA 6 new features.
Length. A story that one Rockstar studio head put at about 80 hours in his own playthrough; see how long GTA 6 is.

What is not confirmed

An official start date. 2015 comes from one Rockstar executive in an interview and from Bloomberg; Rockstar has not put it in an announcement.
The date full production began. Late 2018 is an estimate.
The size of the GTA 6 team. Only company-wide headcount is reported.
The code name and the wider early plan. Reported by Bloomberg, not confirmed by Rockstar.
What the extra year of delays was spent on. Rockstar has only said polish.

How to read a "years in development" claim

Find the starting point: 2013, 2015 or 2018.
Check whether it counts research and planning or only full production.
Look for the source: a named Rockstar employee, Bloomberg's reporting, or neither.
Remember the two delays add about one year to any count made before 2025.
Treat team sizes as company headcount unless the source says otherwise.

What this means for you
The short answer to "how long has GTA 6 been in development" is eleven years from first work and eight years of full production. For players, the practical point is the pace: Rockstar now takes most of a decade per game, so what you are playing has to last. That is one reason the launch game is as large as it is, and one reason reviews were so strong; see GTA 6 reviews.
What we will add to this page

Any start date or team size Rockstar states on the record.
Details from post-launch interviews with the developers.
Dates for a PC version or an online mode, if they are announced, since both extend the project beyond launch.

Q: How long has GTA 6 been in development?
A: About 11 years, counting from early work in 2015 to release on November 19, 2026. Counted from 2018, when most of the team joined, it is about eight years.

Q: When did GTA 6 start development?
A: Early work began in 2015, including research trips to Miami, according to Rockstar's Rob Nelson and Bloomberg. Rockstar first confirmed the game publicly on February 4, 2022.

Q: How big is the GTA 6 dev team?
A: Rockstar has not given a number for the GTA 6 team alone. Bloomberg reported that Rockstar as a whole had 4,711 employees across 12 offices in August 2026.

---

# How Many Chapters Are in GTA 6? Chapter List and What Locks

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/how-many-chapters-in-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-21
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 has five numbered chapters, opened by a playable Prologue.
- Guides count between 91 and 122 missions depending on whether short tasks and optional errands are included; VGC's recap-based list has 95.
- Chapter ends are the points of no return: Chapter 1 closes Jason's house projects and two missable errands, and Chapter 2 asks for $15,000 before the move to Vice City.

There are five chapters in GTA 6, and a playable Prologue comes before Chapter 1. Every major walkthrough divides the story the same way. What they do not agree on is how many missions those chapters hold, because the game mixes full missions with one-line tasks and optional errands. This page lays out the chapters without story spoilers: where each is set, how big it is, what it unlocks and what closes when it ends.
We compared four independent mission lists (VGC, PowerPyx, GTABase and Dexerto). A fact is stated here only when at least two agree; where they differ, the table shows each count.
GTA 6 chapters at a glance

Chapter
Setting and premise (spoiler-light)
Missions (VGC)
Missions (Dexerto)

Prologue
Lucia; the opening
counted in Chapter 1
counted in Chapter 1

Chapter 1
Jason in the Leonida Keys, preparing for Lucia's release
22
22

Chapter 2
Kelly County: the Starlet Motel and Port Gellhorn
13

Vice City
28
26

The two leads go undercover
25
25

Chapter 5

7

Total

95

The one-line premises are VGC's, from its spoiler-free chapter guide. Chapters are numbered in VGC's list rather than named.
Why the mission count ranges from 91 to 122
You will see several different totals quoted:

Source
Total
What it counts

Dexerto
91
Main missions

VGC
95
Main missions in the order of the in-game story recap

PowerPyx
Not totalled; the longest list
Main missions plus optional and missable tasks, each with its own entry

GTABase
122 numbered entries
Every story entry, including short tasks such as paying a fee or waiting for a call

The difference is bookkeeping. Chapter 2 shows it well: VGC lists 13 missions there, while PowerPyx lists 27 entries because it gives separate pages to one-step tasks such as Overnight Charges, New Look and Behind on Payments, plus nine optional jobs.
Why it matters: when a guide says "mission 31" and another says "mission 25", they usually mean the same mission. Our GTA 6 mission list follows VGC's numbering and notes the alternatives.
Prologue
The game opens with a Prologue played as Lucia. PowerPyx and GTABase list it before Chapter 1; VGC and Dexerto count it as the first mission of Chapter 1. Either way it is a single mission, covered in our Prologue walkthrough.
Tip: nothing in the Prologue is missable, so play it at your own pace and use it to learn the controls.
Chapter 1: the Keys
Chapter 1 belongs almost entirely to Jason. It runs from Gone Fishing to Discharge Time, on both PowerPyx's and VGC's lists, and teaches the basics: driving, shooting, the phone, banking and the wanted level. Lucia is playable only in parts of a few missions.
What closes at the end:

Jason's house projects. All four repairs have to be done before Lucia is released; see Jason's house projects.
Two missable errands. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter as missable.
Free roam, for a while. The last three missions play back to back.

Tip: read the checklist in the Recalibration walkthrough before starting Tourist Trap, the first of the three.
Chapter 2: Kelly County
Chapter 2 moves the story north to the Starlet Motel and Port Gellhorn, with Lucia in the lead while Jason recovers. It is the shortest of the middle chapters by mission count, but it switches on several systems:

Unlock
Where

Slim Jim, car registration, selling stolen cars
Moses

Scooter Bros vehicle delivery app
Moses

First garage and the Vice City Real Estate app
After Daily Driver

Switching freely between Jason and Lucia
During the chapter; see how to switch characters

The chapter also has a money gate. GTABase lists Prepare for Vice City, near the end, as needing $15,000 to unlock.
Why it matters: this is the first point where being broke stops the story. Start selling cars to Moses early; other methods are in how to make money in GTA 6.
Chapter 3: Vice City
Chapter 3 opens with the move to Vice City and is the largest chapter on every list: 28 missions for VGC, 26 for Dexerto, 38 entries for PowerPyx. Both PowerPyx and GTABase show it building towards a multi-part heist, with separate missions for scouting and preparation before the job itself. Some missions are marked for Jason only or Lucia only, so expect to switch often.
New tools arrive too: PowerPyx and GTABase both place the Key Cloner, which deals with advanced car trackers, in Chapter 3.
One optional street-racing mission in this chapter is flagged as time-sensitive and missable by both PowerPyx and GTABase.
Tip: when a side contact's mission is labelled time-sensitive, do it before the next main mission. Missions cannot be replayed later; see can you replay missions in GTA 6.
Chapter 4: undercover
VGC sums up Chapter 4 as Jason and Lucia going undercover. It has 25 missions on VGC's and Dexerto's lists and 39 entries on PowerPyx's, and it follows the pattern of Chapter 3: a long run of preparation missions leading to a second major heist. It contains the other time-sensitive optional mission that both PowerPyx and GTABase mark as missable, this one for Lucia.
Why it matters: Chapters 3 and 4 together hold more than half of the main missions on every list. If you are pacing yourself, the end of Chapter 2 is roughly the one-third mark by mission count, not the halfway point.
Chapter 5: the finale
Chapter 5 is short: 7 missions for VGC and Dexerto, 10 entries for PowerPyx and GTABase. VGC redacts three of its titles to avoid spoilers, and so do we.
Tip: make a separate manual save before starting Chapter 5. With no mission replay, it is the only way to see the ending again without a new game. How to save in GTA 6 explains manual slots.
What unlocks after the story
Finishing Chapter 5 is the condition for the Cheats menu: all 61 cheats stay hidden until the story is done, and each then has its own unlock task. The list and the codes published so far are on our GTA 6 cheats page. Free roam continues, which is where cheats, challenges and collectibles are finished.
Why it matters: the story is only one line of the 35 on the in-game checklist, so the credits are a midpoint for completionists. See the 100% completion checklist.
How this compares with GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2

Game
Story structure

GTA 5
No chapters; missions unlock by contact and character

Red Dead Redemption 2
Six chapters and a two-part epilogue

GTA 6
A Prologue and five chapters

GTA 6 borrows the Red Dead approach: each chapter has its own home base and its own cast of contacts, and moving on means leaving a place behind. In GTA 5 almost nothing closed as the story advanced. Here, the end of a chapter can shut a location for a while; VGC notes, for example, that the motel from Chapter 2 is out of reach for a time once that chapter is over.
Why it matters: if you played GTA 5 by ignoring side content until the end, change the habit. Finish what interests you in a region before its chapter finale. More differences are in GTA 6's new features.
What is not confirmed

Chapter titles. VGC numbers the chapters only. One list shows titles for each chapter; we have not been able to verify them against a second source, so we are not repeating them.
Hours per chapter. Per-chapter times circulated before launch came from leaks. The only figure from Rockstar is about 80 hours for one studio head's full playthrough; see how long is GTA 6.
An epilogue. Some pre-launch articles expected one. None of the four launch lists has a separate epilogue.
An official mission count. Rockstar has not published one.

What to do before each chapter ends

Chapter 1: finish the four house projects and the optional errands, bank your cash, then start Tourist Trap.
Chapter 2: build up $15,000 for Prepare for Vice City, register a car with Moses, and clear the optional jobs around Port Gellhorn you care about.
Chapter 3: do time-sensitive side missions as soon as they appear.
Chapter 4: the same, and keep a manual save before the heist.
Chapter 5: make a fresh manual save before the first mission.
Every chapter: keep one manual save from its start. It is your only replay option.

What this means for you
Five chapters sounds brief, but they are uneven: two medium chapters to learn the game, two very large ones in Vice City, and a short ending. The ends of Chapters 1 and 2 are where players lose things, so slow down there. Past that, the main risk is skipping a time-sensitive side mission in Chapters 3 and 4.
GTABase notes that the missable optional missions are not needed for trophies or 100%, so a missed one is a lost scene rather than a lost completion.
What we will add to this page

A mission count per chapter from our own list once every mission has a verified walkthrough.
Hours per chapter when two guides publish matching times.
Chapter titles if a second source confirms them.
A full table of missable content by chapter.

Q: How many chapters are in GTA 6?
A: Five. PowerPyx, VGC, GTABase and Dexerto all divide the story into Chapters 1 to 5, with a Prologue at the start.

Q: How many missions are in each GTA 6 chapter?
A: By VGC's count, which follows the in-game story recap: 22 in Chapter 1 including the Prologue, 13 in Chapter 2, 28 in Chapter 3, 25 in Chapter 4 and 7 in Chapter 5, for 95 in total.

Q: Which is the longest chapter in GTA 6?
A: Chapter 3 has the most missions on every list we compared, with Chapter 4 close behind. No guide has published reliable hours per chapter yet.

Q: Can you go back after finishing a chapter in GTA 6?
A: The map stays open, but some things close. Jason's house projects and two optional errands end with Chapter 1, and missions cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save before each chapter finale.

---

# GTA 6 Ambulance Chaser Walkthrough: Burn the Evidence

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-ambulance-chaser-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Ambulance Chaser is an early Chapter 2 mission for Lucia: destroy the ambulance used in the hospital escape before the police find it.
- Locals drive off in it; chase them on the quad bike from the barn until the ambulance hits a tree.
- Pour the red gas can over it and ignite it, then leave: the explosion alerts the police.

This GTA 6 Ambulance Chaser walkthrough covers Lucia's first job in Chapter 2: the ambulance from the hospital escape is hidden near the motel, somebody else has found it, and it has to burn. PowerPyx lists it as "Ambulance Chaser (Move the Ambulance)". It is a short chase with one decision at the end.
Before you start

Detail

Step-by-step
1. Go to the barn
The ambulance is in a barn a short way east of the motel. Go round the back and up the stairs to the platform; VGC notes there is also a side door. Inside, a group of locals has found the ambulance, and they drive off in it.
2. Take the quad bike
A quad bike is parked inside the barn. Drop down, get on and follow.
Tip: PowerPyx's advice is simply to stay close and not crash. VGC adds that you can shoot while riding and that aiming for the ambulance's tyres can end the chase sooner.
3. The crash
If you only follow, the ambulance eventually leaves the road and hits a tree further south.
4. Deal with the thieves
VGC describes a choice once the ambulance has stopped: kill and rob them, or let them run. Neither guide reports a consequence. Either way the ambulance still has to be destroyed.

The explosion draws the police. Get out of the area straight away. If you pick up stars, see how the wanted level works.
Where players fail

Crashing the quad. Falling too far behind is the main risk in the chase.
Standing next to the fire. Light it and back off.
Waiting around afterwards. The police are already on the way.

How the ambulance got here is in Discharge Time. More Chapter 2 missions will be added to the GTA 6 mission list as second sources confirm their order.

Q: Where is the ambulance in the GTA 6 Ambulance Chaser walkthrough?
A: In a barn just east of the Starlet Motel. Take the stairs at the back of the barn; the mission marker appears the first time you leave the motel room.

Q: How do you destroy the ambulance in Ambulance Chaser?
A: Pick up the red gas can behind the crashed ambulance, hold R1 (RB on Xbox) to pour fuel over it, then use the Ignite prompt with Triangle (Y). You can also throw the can in the back and shoot it.

Q: Can you shoot the ambulance during the chase?
A: VGC says yes: you can fire from the quad bike and aim for the tyres to end the chase early. If you do not, the thieves crash into a tree on their own.

# GTA 6 Buck Me Walkthrough: Set Up the BuckMe Bank App

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-buck-me-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Buck Me is a short Chapter 1 mission with no combat: Jason and Lucia are refused a normal account and get the BuckMe app instead.
- PowerPyx reports a $100 welcome gift in checking, which you move into Family Savings to finish the mission.
- Money in Family Savings cannot be lost and cannot be withdrawn; pocket cash is lost when you die.

This GTA 6 Buck Me walkthrough covers the mission that gives Jason and Lucia a bank account: a visit to the bank in Key Lento, a refusal, and the BuckMe app that handles your money for the rest of the game. PowerPyx lists it as "Buck Me (Set Up Bank Account)". There is no combat and no driving challenge, but the banking rules it introduces matter for every job afterwards.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Buck Me (mission 13 in our list, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Set Up Bank Account

Playable character
Jason; Lucia joins at the bank

Starts at
Fleeca bank, Key Lento (PowerPyx), after Lucia's call

Requirement
About half a day after Coming Home

Reward
BuckMe app; $100 welcome gift (PowerPyx)

Next mission
Down to Earth

VGC places Buck Me before Clean Up After Donnie; PowerPyx places it after. You can treat the two as a pair.
Objectives

Ask about setting up a bank account.
Speak to the manager.
Open BuckMe.
Move money into the Family Savings account.

Step-by-step
1. Talk to the teller
Go into the bank and speak to the teller behind the counter. She sends you to the manager.
2. Follow the manager
PowerPyx says he sits at the table in the right-hand corner. Follow him into his office, where Lucia joins the conversation.
3. The refusal
The two of them cannot open a normal account; PowerPyx says the manager checks their credit and it is too poor. VGC adds a dialogue choice when he asks about savings: say you have nothing, or say you keep cash at the house. He offers the BuckMe app instead.
4. Open BuckMe at home
A cutscene takes you to Jason's house and a tutorial explains the phone. Open the phone and choose the purple "B" icon. PowerPyx says $100 has been placed in checking as a welcome gift.
5. Move the money
In the app, open Checking Account from the top menu and choose Buck Yourself to move the $100 into Family Savings. VGC ends the mission with the pair watching TV and going to bed.
BuckMe rules worth knowing
These come from PowerPyx's notes on the app:

Rule
What it means

Family Savings is locked
Money moved there can never be withdrawn, but it cannot be lost either

Savings goals
Each goal unlocks perks that lower prices, and raises your checking limit

Checking limit
When checking is full, incoming payments wait until you spend or move money

Purchases over $1,000
Paid through BuckMe, because vendors take pocket cash only up to $999

Deposits
Use the app's ATM Finder to set a destination, then deposit at any ATM

Dying
You lose your pocket cash; a smaller part of checking is lost too

Tip: deposit pocket cash before anything risky. It is the only money you lose in full.
Where players fail
There is no fail state here. The usual mistake comes later: carrying cash into a mission and losing it.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
BuckMe app and a $100 welcome gift (PowerPyx)

Long-term goal
"Save for the Future" savings goals, which PowerPyx describes as optional for the story

More on earning and keeping cash: how to make money in GTA 6. Next up is Brian's job at the marina, Down to Earth.

Q: How do you complete the GTA 6 Buck Me walkthrough mission?
A: Talk to the teller, follow the manager to his office, then at home open the BuckMe app on the phone and move money from checking into Family Savings.

Q: Where is the bank in Buck Me?
A: PowerPyx gives it as the Fleeca branch in Key Lento, Mariana County. Lucia calls about half a day after Coming Home to meet there.

Q: Can you withdraw money from Family Savings in GTA 6?
A: PowerPyx says no: money in Family Savings can never be withdrawn, but it also cannot be lost. Checking can be withdrawn at an ATM.

# How to Change Clothes and Hair in GTA 6

URL: https://gta6box.com/characters/gta-6-change-clothes-and-hair/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- You change clothes at your safehouse wardrobe, where everything you buy or pick up is stored.
- Outfits can be saved to the trunk of Jason's or Lucia's car and swapped in the field, which helps you lose the police.
- Hair is changed at barbers and stylists; Lucia also has beauty parlours, marked with a lip icon, for makeup and nails.

To change clothes in GTA 6, use the wardrobe at your safehouse; to change hair, visit a barber or stylist. Clothing is more than cosmetic in this game, because your outfit is part of what the police use to recognise you. This page covers where to change, how saved outfits work, and what is different for Jason and Lucia.
Clothes and hair at a glance

What
Where

Change clothes
Wardrobe at your safehouse

Try and change in a shop
Fitting rooms in some clothing stores (PPE.pl)

Quick change in the field
An outfit saved to your car trunk

Haircut, hair colour
Barber shops and stylists

Facial hair (Jason)
Barbers

Makeup and nails (Lucia)
Beauty parlours, lip icon on the map

How to change clothes
Everything you buy or collect goes to the wardrobe in your safehouse, and that is where you put outfits together. VGC points out one catch: an item you take in the world, such as a hat from someone you knocked out, is not kept until you have been back to the safehouse.
Clothing stores are the other place to change. PPE.pl describes fitting rooms at the back of some shops where you can try items and walk out wearing them.
Saved outfits and the car trunk
You can keep more than one outfit in the trunk of Jason's or Lucia's car. Two things to know:

It is not automatic. VGC says you assign an outfit to the car from the safehouse wardrobe menu, even for clothes you have just bought.
There are limits. PPE.pl reports up to 10 named outfits in the wardrobe and up to 5 in the trunk. No second source gives those numbers yet.

Tip: put a plain spare outfit in the trunk before any robbery.
Why your outfit matters to the police
The red heat icons under your wanted stars show what the police know: your face, your clothes and your vehicle. Changing clothes removes one of those. VGC calls it the quickest way to bring a wanted level down, and PPE.pl says the game itself suggests grabbing an outfit from the nearest clothing store if you are being chased with nothing to change into.
The full system is explained in GTA 6 wanted level.
How to change hair
Go to a barber shop or stylist and pay for the change. VGC lists what is on offer:

Character
At barbers and stylists
Extra

Jason
Haircuts, hair colour, facial hair
-

Lucia
Haircuts, hair colour
Beauty parlours (lip icon) for makeup and nails

Each lead has signature hairstyles alongside the standard ones. Not every style is sold everywhere: VGC notes that some cuts are only available at certain locations.
You get one haircut early as part of the story: a visit to the barber is one of the optional errands before Coming Home.
Free outfits from the story
Some clothes come from missions. In Day Release Lucia picks a dress that VGC says she keeps, and in Home Sweet Home one escape route ends with a unique jacket.
Pre-order and edition items
Hairstyles and outfits from the pre-order pack can be selected at the same barbers and wardrobes once you own them, according to VGC. What is in each pack is covered in Vintage Vice City Pack and GTA 6 Ultimate Edition.
What is not confirmed

Prices. No guide lists what clothes or haircuts cost.
Tattoos. A tattoo shop was named before launch; how tattoos work in the released game is not documented in the guides we checked.
Button prompts. Only one guide gives fitting-room controls, without naming the platform.
Unlock timing. No guide says exactly when each shop type opens.

We will add shop names, locations and prices when two sources agree on them.

Q: How do you change clothes in GTA 6?
A: Go to the wardrobe in your safehouse. Everything you have bought or collected is kept there. You can also change in the fitting rooms of some clothing stores, or from an outfit saved in your car trunk.

Q: How do you change your hair in GTA 6?
A: Visit a barber shop or stylist and pay for a new cut or colour. Jason can also change facial hair there. Lucia has beauty parlours, shown with a lip icon on the map, for makeup and nails.

Q: Does changing clothes lower your wanted level in GTA 6?
A: It helps. Your outfit is one of the things the police know about you, and VGC calls changing it the quickest way to bring a wanted level down.

# GTA 6 Clean Up After Donnie Walkthrough: Donnie's Drop

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-clean-up-after-donnie-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Clean Up After Donnie is the first job after Lucia's release: Jason recovers a lost package from the Kingfishers in the Hamlet swamps.
- The cocaine is inside a shack downriver, guarded by Kingfishers; more arrive by boat after you take it.
- PowerPyx lists a $600 reward that arrives later in the mailbox, and the mission opens Donnie's trailer as a place to sell narcotics.

This GTA 6 Clean Up After Donnie walkthrough covers Jason's first job after Lucia comes home: tracking a lost package into the Hamlet swamps, taking it back from the Kingfishers and dropping it at Donnie's trailer. PowerPyx also lists it as "Donnie's Drop". It is short, but it is the first real gunfight on the water and it opens an early way to earn money.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Clean Up After Donnie (mission 12 in our list, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Donnie's Drop

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Swamps south-west of Hamlet, Vice Dale County, after Donnie's call

Requirement
Finish Coming Home; Donnie calls the next morning

Reward
$600 (PowerPyx), sent later to the mailbox at Jason's house

Next mission
Buck Me

Bring a full pistol or a long gun. You fight from a boat with very little cover.
Objectives

Search the area for the package.
Examine the package.
Search the shack for the cocaine.
Deliver the cocaine to Donnie's trailer.

Step-by-step
1. Find the package
Drive to the pink search area on the riverbank. PowerPyx says to ask the fisherman on the dock, who points to the package on the shore under a roof. VGC simply sends you to the water's edge. Either way, the package is there and it is empty.
2. Examine it
Inspect the package. The trail leads to a shack downriver that the Kingfishers gang is using.
3. Take the boat to the shack
A boat is tied up next to the package; VGC identifies it as a fan boat. Drive it south to the marked shack.
4. Deal with the Kingfishers
PowerPyx counts three gang members at the shack. VGC notes you can talk to them first, but they turn hostile soon after and the section cannot be finished without a fight.
Tip: VGC warns that the fan boat gives you almost no protection. Start shooting early rather than waiting on the water for them to open fire.
5. Grab the cocaine
Go through the shack door and pick up the package. VGC says a sniper rifle is inside too, and that more Kingfishers then arrive by boat. Take them out before you leave.
6. Deliver it to Donnie's trailer
VGC has Jason phone Donnie, who tells him to leave the package in the old tool box behind his trailer. PowerPyx marks the trailer in Key Lento with a green fence icon. Drive the boat there and put the bag in the container to finish.
Where players fail

Fighting from open water. The boat is poor cover. Close the distance or pick targets off quickly.
Leaving right after the pickup. VGC reports a second group arriving by boat once you have the package.
Expecting the cash straight away. PowerPyx says the $600 turns up later in the mailbox at Jason's house.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
$600 by mail (PowerPyx)

Pickup
Sniper rifle inside the shack (VGC)

Unlocks
Selling narcotics at Donnie's trailer; VGC calls it an early money-maker and says Donnie later sends more package locations

For more ways to earn early on, see how to make money in GTA 6. Next, Lucia calls about a bank account: Buck Me. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Clean Up After Donnie walkthrough mission?
A: Donnie phones the morning after Coming Home. The mission marker appears in the swamps south-west of Hamlet, in Vice Dale County, and Jason starts it.

Q: Where is the cocaine in Clean Up After Donnie?
A: In a shack a short boat ride downriver from the empty package. Take out the Kingfishers outside, then go through the door.

Q: What is the reward for Clean Up After Donnie?
A: PowerPyx lists $600, delivered later to the mailbox at Jason's house. VGC adds that you can sell narcotics at Donnie's trailer from this point.

Q: Is Clean Up After Donnie also called Donnie's Drop?
A: Yes. PowerPyx lists the mission as Clean Up After Donnie (Donnie's Drop). VGC uses only the first name.

# GTA 6 Clear Skies Walkthrough: Escort, Airstrip and Rescue

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-clear-skies-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Clear Skies is a flying and shooting mission: escort a plane to a swamp airstrip, then rescue Donnie from the Final Chapter biker gang.
- Two things send you back to a checkpoint: wrecking the seaplane on landing and letting Donnie die.
- It runs straight into a short scene at Jason's house, which PowerPyx lists separately as Building a Life.

This GTA 6 Clear Skies walkthrough covers Donnie's job in the air: an escort flight over the ocean, a deal at a swamp airstrip that goes wrong, a rescue through several buildings and a motorbike escape. PowerPyx lists it as "Clear Skies (Join Donnie On A Job)". It is the biggest gunfight of Chapter 1 so far.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Clear Skies (mission 16 in our list, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Join Donnie On A Job

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
The seaplane in Southwind, Mariana County, in the afternoon

Requirement
A call after Down to Earth

Reward
None listed

Stock up on ammo and armor at a gun shop first. The airstrip fight comes in several waves.
Objectives

Talk to Brian.
Taxi the plane into the water and take off.
Fly to the intercept point.
Catch up to Pilot Pete's plane and escort it to the landing strip.
Fly to the next airstrip.
Follow Donnie and observe the deal.
Find and rescue Donnie.
Escape with Donnie.
Hold off the Final Chapter.
Grab a bike, catch up with Donnie and get in the plane.

Step-by-step
1. Brian, then the plane
Donnie is at the seaplane and sends you to Brian at the tiki bar up the street. Come back and taxi the plane.
Tip: PowerPyx recommends rolling the plane off the side of the road into the water and taking off from there. Taking off from the road works but is riskier.
2. The escort
Fly to the intercept point, marked over the ocean in the south-east corner of the map. Pilot Pete's plane appears flying low. Catch up and hold position directly above it all the way to the swamp airstrip.
3. Land at the second airstrip
Once Pete is down, fly on to the next marker in the north-west of the swamps and land. VGC lists destroying the plane here as a fail state, so take the approach slowly.
4. The deal
Taxi, then follow Donnie on foot to meet his contact. The Final Chapter biker gang arrives, the deal collapses, they drag Donnie away and open fire.
5. Clear the airstrip
Fight from cover. VGC warns that the bikers try to flank you, so deal with them quickly rather than sitting still.
Tip: PowerPyx points out that the bikers leave a row of different motorcycles here, which you can scan with the WAiNK app once the area is quiet.
6. Rescue Donnie
Head for the next building up the strip; VGC says to go left and break through a door. Rooms along the way have gang members inside. Donnie is tied to a chair. Untie him.
7. Protect him on the way out
More enemies appear as Donnie leads you back to the runway, and VGC shows a second "rescue Donnie" moment in a hangar. Shoot whoever is attacking him first. If Donnie dies you go back to the checkpoint.
8. Hold the line, then ride
Donnie boards the seaplane and a large group arrives. Hold them off until he is away, then take one of the bikes and follow. PowerPyx says enemies keep spawning during the ride and you can ignore them.
9. Meet the plane
The meeting point is on the water east of Watson Bay. Get into the plane to end the chase.
10. Back at the house
The game moves straight to Jason's house. VGC includes a short scene here in which you help Lucia build a coffee table with a quick button prompt; PowerPyx lists the scene as its own entry, Building a Life.
Where players fail

Crashing the landing. The plane has to survive.
Losing Donnie. Prioritise the enemies closest to him, twice.
Stopping to fight on the bike. Keep moving.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed (PowerPyx)

Optional
Scan the bikers' motorcycles with WAiNK

With this, Day Release and Building a Life done, Brian's next job opens: Swamped.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Clear Skies walkthrough mission?
A: After Down to Earth a call opens it. Go to the seaplane in Southwind in the afternoon; at other times PowerPyx says you can hold X (A on Xbox) to wait. Donnie sends you to Brian at the tiki bar.

Q: How do you escort Pilot Pete's plane in Clear Skies?
A: Fly to the intercept point over the ocean, catch up with the low-flying plane and stay directly above it until it lands at the swamp airstrip. PowerPyx says flying above it hides its radar signature.

Q: Where is Donnie in Clear Skies?
A: In a building further up the airstrip, tied to a chair, with Final Chapter members inside. Clear the room, untie him, then protect him on the way back to the plane.

# GTA 6 Coming Home Walkthrough: Lucia's Release and the Bar

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-coming-home-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Coming Home is the eleventh mission in GTA 6: Jason collects Lucia from prison and they spend the night at the Rusty Anchor.
- Five optional errands beforehand improve the relationship; the necklace costs $425.
- The night ends with a fist fight against D-Man and a run from the police. After it, Lucia lives at Jason's house.

This GTA 6 Coming Home walkthrough covers the eleventh mission, the night Lucia gets out: the errands worth doing first, the pickup at the prison, and a long evening at the Rusty Anchor that ends in a fight. PowerPyx also lists it as "Lucia's Release". It is the longest mission so far and the point where the game's second lead joins Jason.
Before you start

Step-by-step
