2. Drive to the Rusty Anchor
The bar is marked north of Key Lento. If you brought her clothes, Lucia changes when you arrive. Cal is inside, and Donnie, the seaplane pilot, turns up.
3. Buy the drinks
Use the bartender prompt (L2 + Triangle on PS5, LT + Y on Xbox) and order two beers; PowerPyx gives the price as $6. One goes into your hand, so pick up the second from the counter and carry both out to Lucia on the deck behind the bar.
4. Hang out
After a scene between the two leads, the evening opens up. The "hang out with your friends" objective moves on once you have done a few interactions. The ones the guides describe:

Cal asks for help with a dating app. No consequence.
Donnie offers cocaine. You can accept or decline; PowerPyx found no effect either way.
Rhonda has lost her pet lizard (VGC). Use focus mode; it is in a bush across the street.

Kat, Lucia's former cellmate, and her boyfriend Mattia arrive during the evening. Lucia mentions that Mattia may have work for you.
5. Dance with Lucia
Approach Lucia when the dance prompt appears. VGC says you can decline, but dancing gave an early relationship boost, so do it.
6. Pool with Mattia
Find Mattia outside behind the bar and get him a drink. He suggests a game of pool: take a cue from the wall and play. The result does not matter. A group of military men, who have been bothering Donnie, interrupt and it goes outside.
7. Deal with D-Man
This is a fist fight.

Action
PS5
Xbox

Attack
Square
X

Block
Hold Cross
Hold A

PowerPyx's tip: watch the shoulders. When they start to rotate, a punch is coming, so block and then hit back.
8. Run
The police arrive. Follow Lucia away from the bar to the beach. A cutscene takes the two of them home, and the mission ends.
Where players fail

Leaving the clothes behind. Collect them and put them in the trunk before you drive to the prison.
Mashing attack against D-Man. Block first, then counter.
Staying to fight the police. The objective is to follow Lucia, not to win.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Lucia is released and lives at Jason's house

Optional
The five errands, the house repairs, the bar interactions

Relationship
Shown in the "Jason & Lucia" menu (PowerPyx)

The next morning Donnie calls with a job, which leads into Clean Up After Donnie. To see how Lucia ended up inside, go back to the Prologue. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What should you do before the GTA 6 Coming Home walkthrough starts?
A: Five optional errands: pick up groceries, buy flowers, buy Lucia a necklace ($425), get a haircut and collect her clothes. Both guides say they help the relationship with Lucia.

Q: How do you beat D-Man in Coming Home?
A: It is a fist fight outside the bar. Attack with Square (X on Xbox) and hold Cross (A) to block. PowerPyx's tip is to watch his shoulders and block when they start to turn.

Q: Do you have to dance with Lucia in Coming Home?
A: The guides differ. PowerPyx lists the dance as an objective; VGC says you can accept or decline and that dancing gave an early relationship boost.

Q: Why has Coming Home not started after Feng Shui?
A: You have to wait for Lucia's second call. PowerPyx suggests sleeping at the house until morning, and sleeping again or driving around if the call has not come.

# GTA 6 Cover Art: What Is on It and Who the Cover Girl Is

URL: https://gta6box.com/news/gta-6-cover/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Rockstar revealed the official GTA 6 cover art on June 18, 2026, together with the June 25 pre-order date.
- It is a panel collage in the series' usual style, with Jason and Lucia in the centre and an alligator, a helicopter, a speedboat and a motorbike around them.
- Rockstar has not named the woman people call the GTA 6 cover girl.

The GTA 6 cover is a panel collage in the classic Grand Theft Auto style, with Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in the centre. Rockstar Games revealed it on June 18, 2026, in the same post that announced pre-orders for June 25. This page explains what is in the panels, what is and is not known about the "cover girl", and where to find the artwork. We describe the cover rather than show it: this is a fan site and we do not host Rockstar's images.
GTA 6 cover at a glance

Detail
Info

Revealed
June 18, 2026

Where
Rockstar's social media, with the pre-order announcement

Style
Multi-panel collage, as on earlier GTA covers

Centre
Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos

Other panels
Alligator, helicopter, speedboat, motorbike, sports car, supporting characters

Official download
On Rockstar's GTA VI site

When and how Rockstar revealed it
Rockstar did not hold an event for it. On June 18, 2026 it posted that pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI would begin on June 25 at digital storefronts and other select retailers, and added the official cover art, also offered as downloadable artwork. Outlets noted that no new trailer came with it. The post was widely read as a sign that the November 19 date was safe; see our release date history.
What is on the cover, panel by panel
Rockstar has not published a description of the panels. The list below is what several outlets independently reported seeing:

Panel subject
Reported by

Jason and Lucia, in the centre
PC Gamer, GTABase, GTABoom, Shacknews

An alligator
PC Gamer, GTABase, GTABoom, Kotaku, Shacknews

A helicopter
PC Gamer, GTABase, GTABoom

A speedboat
PC Gamer, GTABase, GTABoom

PC Gamer, GTABase, GTABoom

A sports car
PC Gamer, GTABase

Boobie Ike
GTABase, GTABoom, Shacknews

Raul Bautista
GTABase, GTABoom

A woman in a bikini
PC Gamer, GTABoom

Boobie Ike and Raul Bautista are both characters Rockstar introduced before launch; they are covered in GTA 6 characters. Their names on the cover come from the outlets' reading of the artwork, not from a Rockstar caption.
The alligator is no surprise. Leonida's wildlife has been part of the marketing since the first trailer; see GTA 6 animals.
Who is the GTA 6 cover girl?
GTA covers have long included a panel that fans call the cover girl, and GTA 6 keeps the habit: one panel shows a woman in a bikini who is not one of the named cast.

Rockstar has not named her. No official source says who she is or whether she appears in the game.
GTABoom's analysis lists her as an unnamed character.
PC Gamer reads a tattoo near her bikini strap as "Vice Baby". That is the outlet's reading of the image.

What is different this time is that the cover's most prominent woman is a playable lead. Lucia Caminos stands in the centre with Jason.
How it compares with earlier GTA covers
The grid of panels is the series' established look, and GTA 6 does not break from it. Shacknews describes it as the traditional picture-collage format. PC Gamer and Kotaku both compare it directly with the cover of GTA: Vice City, which fits: GTA 6 goes back to Vice City.
The GTA 6 logo
The cover carries the game's VI logo. Rockstar has not published design notes or credits for the logo or the cover illustration, and none of the reports we checked name an artist. We will add a credit here if Rockstar gives one.
Is the cover on a real box?
Yes, but the box does not hold a disc. The boxed edition contains a download code; details are in GTA 6 physical copy. For what each edition includes, see price and editions.
Where to get the cover art

Go to Rockstar's official GTA VI site, where the cover is offered as downloadable artwork.
Avoid "4K cover" downloads from unofficial sites; they are often altered or fan-made.

What is not confirmed

The identity of the woman in the bikini panel.
Who drew the cover.
Whether every panel shows a scene that is in the game.

We will update this page if Rockstar says more about the artwork. For the videos released before launch, see all GTA 6 trailers.

Q: What is on the GTA 6 cover?
A: A collage of panels with Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in the middle, surrounded by an alligator, a helicopter, a speedboat, a motorbike, a sports car and supporting characters that outlets identify as Boobie Ike and Raul Bautista.

Q: Who is the GTA 6 cover girl?
A: Rockstar has not said. One panel shows a woman in a bikini who is not one of the named characters, and no official source identifies her. Lucia, one of the two leads, is in the centre of the cover.

Q: When was the GTA 6 cover art revealed?
A: On June 18, 2026. Rockstar posted it on social media with the news that pre-orders would open on June 25.

Q: Is the GTA 6 logo on the cover?
A: Yes, the game's VI logo is on the cover. Rockstar has not published any notes about the logo's design, and we do not host the image.

# GTA 6 Day Release Walkthrough: The Yacht and Vice City

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-day-release-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Day Release is the first mission where you control Lucia alongside Jason: a day on Mattia's yacht and a night in Vice City.
- Nothing here is hard to pass; the choices that matter raise the relationship, such as sharing a jet ski and dancing.
- Lucia picks one of Kat's dresses; VGC says the one you choose stays unlocked for her.

This GTA 6 Day Release walkthrough covers the long social mission with Mattia and Kat: a speedboat to a yacht, a jet ski race, a drive through Vice City at night and a club. PowerPyx lists it as "Day Release (Meet Mattia & Kat)". It is the first time you play as Lucia since the Prologue, and almost every choice in it affects the relationship rather than success or failure.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Day Release (mission 15 in our list, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Meet Mattia & Kat

Playable characters
Jason at the start and end, Lucia for most of the party

Starts at
The Rusty Anchor, Key Lento

Requirement
A call after Down to Earth

Reward
No cash; one dress for Lucia (VGC)

Objectives

Get in the speedboat.
Drive to the yacht.
Race the jet ski.
Shoot the champagne bottles.
Find Mattia.
Keep up with Mattia and drive to Huxley Motel.
Follow Mattia.
Dance with Jason.
Find Jason.

Step-by-step
1. Speedboat to the yacht
At the Rusty Anchor, trigger the cutscene and board the boat behind the bar. Lucia's ankle monitor comes off before you leave; PowerPyx says Mattia's man Burim removes it. The yacht is marked off the coast and the trip is long.
2. Jet skis
After the party scene you choose how Lucia rides: alone, or with Jason.
Tip: ride with Jason. Both guides say it raises the relationship. Mattia then challenges you to a race back to the yacht with ramps along the way, and the result does not matter.
3. Champagne bottles
As Lucia, shoot the bottles in focus mode (L3 + R3). Hitting all three only changes a line of dialogue.
4. Choose a dress
Lucia goes to see Kat, who lets her pick a dress. VGC says your choice is unlocked permanently and calls it the earliest free formal outfit; the others can be bought later.
5. Find Mattia
He is in a room on the lowest deck, two decks below where you start (PowerPyx). VGC lists two optional photos on the yacht: some documents you can send to Cal, and the front of the boat, which raises the relationship.
6. Drive through Vice City
A cutscene puts you in a sports car at night. Follow Mattia, then follow the route to the Huxley Motel. VGC says he stops at a hotel to collect drugs and the next stretch is driven with a filter that makes the road harder to read.
Tip: if you crash, reset the car. PowerPyx says that repairs it fully.
7. The club
Follow Mattia into the club, which PowerPyx names as Nine1Nine. You can hold hands with Jason on the way in (PowerPyx shows R2, RT on Xbox). Talk to Mattia at his table, then move close to Jason with the left stick and dance. VGC says dance flourishes with L2, when prompted, raise the relationship.
8. The apartment
The party moves upstairs. Find Jason at the end of the hallway; PowerPyx says to take the right-hand door. Security turns up, and the two leave over the balcony. Hold hands again when the prompt appears.
You wake back in Key Lento as Jason.
Where players fail

Wrecking the car. It is the only fail state VGC lists.
Riding solo. Not a failure, but you miss a relationship boost.

Optional goals and rewards

Choice
Effect

Jet ski with Jason
Relationship up

Photo of the boat's bow
Relationship up (VGC)

Dance flourishes, holding hands
Relationship up

Dress
Kept by Lucia (VGC)

Champagne bottles, race result, Mattia's handshake
No lasting effect

Wondering when you can play as Lucia freely? See how to switch characters in GTA 6. The other mission open at this point is Clear Skies.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Day Release walkthrough mission?
A: It opens with a call after Down to Earth. Go to the Rusty Anchor in Key Lento; PowerPyx says to order a drink from the bartender at the back to trigger the cutscene.

Q: Does it matter if you win the jet ski race in Day Release?
A: No. PowerPyx says winning or losing changes nothing. Riding the jet ski with Jason instead of alone does raise the relationship.

Q: Which dress should you pick in Day Release?
A: Any. VGC says the dress you choose is permanently unlocked for Lucia and the others can be bought later, so pick the one you like most.

Q: Can you fail Day Release?
A: VGC says the two driving sections fail only if the car is destroyed. PowerPyx adds that you can reset the car after a crash, which repairs it.

# How Many Times Was GTA 6 Delayed? Full Delay Timeline

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-delays/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 was delayed twice before it launched on November 19, 2026.
- The first delay moved it from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026.
- The second moved it to November 19, 2026, and that date held.

GTA 6 was delayed twice: first from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026, and then to November 19, 2026, the date it actually launched. There was no third delay, despite a year of rumours. This page gives the full delay timeline, what Rockstar and Take-Two said each time, how long each delay really was, how it compares with Rockstar's earlier games, and what players are still waiting for now that the game is out.
Every date here comes from Rockstar's own announcements or from at least two news reports that agree.
GTA 6 delay timeline at a glance

Announced
Release target
What changed

December 2023
2025
Trailer 1 gives a 2025 window

May 2, 2025
May 26, 2026
First delay

November 6, 2025
November 19, 2026
Second delay

November 19, 2026
Released
The date held

The original plan: 2025
Trailer 1, in December 2023, ended with a single year: 2025. Rockstar never attached a day to it. Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company, later narrowed it to fall 2025 in its financial reporting, and that is the window most reports use when they describe the first delay.
Why it matters: the game never had a public 2025 date to miss, only a window. That is why some counts say "delayed once" and others say "twice". Counting from the first window Rockstar itself showed, it is twice.
The first delay: to May 26, 2026
On May 2, 2025, Rockstar announced that GTA 6 would release on May 26, 2026. It was the first time the game had an exact day. The studio said it needed more time to deliver the quality players expect.
Four days later, on May 6, 2025, Rockstar released Trailer 2 and added character and location pages to its site, which softened the news. See all GTA 6 trailers.
The second delay: to November 19, 2026
On November 6, 2025, Rockstar moved the game again, from May 26 to Thursday, November 19, 2026. The announcement was posted on X on the same day as Take-Two's quarterly results.
The message opened with an apology for adding more time to an already long wait, and gave the reason as extra months to finish the game with the level of polish players "have come to expect and deserve".
Tip: one news report from that day gives November 22 in its body text. That was a typo in the article; Rockstar's date was always November 19.
How the second delay was announced
The news did not arrive as a surprise press conference. Three details from that day are worth knowing:

It came with earnings. GamesRadar, Windows Central and TechRadar all note that the announcement landed alongside Take-Two's quarterly results, which is when the publisher has to update investors on its release schedule anyway.
It was a short statement. Most outlets cite a post on X; GadgetGuy describes a brief post on Rockstar's own site. Either way it was a few sentences, not a video or a trailer.
Fans noticed first. Tom's Hardware reported that players had spotted the May 26 date disappearing from Rockstar's website shortly before the statement went out.

Many fans had been hoping that week would bring a third trailer instead. That trailer never came; the next video was the Extended Look, nine months later.
Did the delays affect pre-orders?
No. Pre-orders had not opened when either delay was announced; TechRadar confirmed that at the time of the second one. They opened on June 25, 2026, with November 19 already fixed, so nobody had a pre-order moved or needed a refund because of a date change.
Tip: if you bought a console or a bundle early in 2026 expecting the May date, nothing about that purchase changed. The game runs the same on a console bought in March as on one bought in November: see GTA 6 platforms.
What Take-Two said about the second delay
Take-Two's chief executive, Strauss Zelnick, spoke about the move around the earnings call:

Outlet
What Zelnick said, in substance

IGN, via GamesRadar
He was highly confident in the new date and did not expect another delay

Windows Central
The extra time came from wanting to release a "perfect" product

TechRadar
The company was excited and confident about delivering a blockbuster

GamesRadar pointed out that he had sounded just as confident about May 26. This time the date held.
How long each delay was

Step
From
To
Length

First delay
Fall 2025
May 26, 2026
Roughly six to eight months, depending on where in the fall you count from

Second delay
May 26, 2026
November 19, 2026
177 days, just under six months

Total slip
Fall 2025
November 19, 2026
About a year

From Trailer 1 to release, the wait was just under three years.
Was there a third delay?
No. After November 2025 the date did not move. Through 2026, rumours of another delay, including a slip to 2027, appeared regularly, and each time the public milestones kept arriving on schedule:

Date
Milestone

June 25, 2026
Pre-orders open, with prices and editions confirmed

August 6, 2026
Rockstar announces An Extended Look

August 27, 2026
The Extended Look premieres on Netflix and YouTube

November 10, 2026
Pre-loading begins

November 13 and 16, 2026
Two pre-launch updates

November 19, 2026
Release

Take-Two also repeated the November 19 date in its financial updates through the year.
Why it matters: pre-orders are the clearest signal. A publisher does not take money against a date it expects to move, and from June 25 onwards a third delay was very unlikely. More on those steps: price and editions, GTA 6 on Netflix and GTA 6 updates.
Why Rockstar delayed it
Rockstar gave the same reason both times: more time to finish the game to the standard players expect. It did not name a specific problem, a platform or a feature. Anything more detailed than that, such as claims about a particular system being unfinished, did not come from the studio.
The result is at least consistent with the reason. The game launched to very high review scores, with frame rate the main complaint: see GTA 6 reviews and how long GTA 6 was in development.
How this compares with other Rockstar games
Two delays is normal for Rockstar's biggest releases:

Game
First target
Released
Delays

Grand Theft Auto V
Spring 2013
September 17, 2013
One

Red Dead Redemption 2
Fall 2017
October 26, 2018
Two

Grand Theft Auto VI
2025
November 19, 2026
Two

Why it matters: if you are waiting for something Rockstar has not dated yet, such as a PC version, history suggests treating the first date you hear as a target rather than a promise.
How the delays affected other games
When the second delay was announced, Windows Central wrote that many developers would be relieved, because May 2026 was suddenly free of the biggest release in years, and wondered whether smaller games planned for late 2026 would move out of the way instead. That was commentary at the time, not a list of confirmed moves.
What is not confirmed

A detailed reason. Rockstar has only ever said "polish".
Internal dates. Reports about earlier internal targets are not official.
What was cut or changed. Nothing on record says the delays removed or added specific features.

What players are still waiting for
The delays are over, but three things have no date:

A PC version. Not announced. See GTA 6 PC release date.
An online mode. Rockstar describes the launch game as single-player. See GTA 6 online.
A 60 FPS option. Every console targets 30 FPS. See does GTA 6 run at 60 FPS.

If you are deciding whether to buy now or wait for one of these, decide on what exists today.
How to judge the next Rockstar date

Look for an exact day. A year or a season is a window, and GTA 6's window moved. Its exact days moved once.
Watch the earnings calendar. Both the second delay and most date confirmations came with Take-Two's quarterly results.
Wait for pre-orders. Once money is being taken, the date is as firm as it gets.
Ignore unsourced "internal" dates. None of the 2027 rumours came from Rockstar or Take-Two, and none came true.

The short version
GTA 6 slipped twice, by about a year in total, and then arrived on the day Rockstar last promised. For the complete history of announcements, see GTA 6 release date and delay history. For launch-day timing by region, see what time GTA 6 came out.
What we will add to this page
If Rockstar dates a PC version or an online mode, we will add those to the timeline, along with any later change to them.

Q: How many times has GTA 6 been delayed?
A: Twice. From fall 2025 to May 26, 2026, and then to November 19, 2026.

Q: Did GTA 6 get delayed again?
A: No. After the November 2025 announcement the date did not move, and the game launched on November 19, 2026.

Q: Was GTA 6 delayed to 2027?
A: No. Claims of a 2027 delay were rumours. The game came out in 2026.

# GTA 6 Discharge Time Walkthrough: The End of Chapter 1

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-discharge-time-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Discharge Time is the last mission of Chapter 1 and follows Home Sweet Home with no break.
- You find Jason on the second floor of Vice City Hospital, then shoot from a wheelchair and from the back of an ambulance.
- It ends at a motel, where Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag?

This GTA 6 Discharge Time walkthrough covers the final mission of Chapter 1: Lucia finds Jason in Vice City Hospital, the people hunting them arrive, and the two shoot their way out in a wheelchair and an ambulance. It starts the moment Home Sweet Home ends, so you cannot prepare for it separately.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Discharge Time (mission 22 in our list, the last of Chapter 1)

Playable characters
Lucia first, then Jason for the shooting

Starts at
Vice City Hospital

Requirement
Starts automatically after Home Sweet Home

Reward
None listed

Next mission
What's in the Bag? (Chapter 2)

Everything you needed to do before this point is in the checklist on our Tourist Trap walkthrough.
Objectives

Go to the second floor, find Jason and go to his room.
Defend yourself.
Crawl to the gun.
Defend the ambulance.

Step-by-step
1. Find Jason
From the entrance, go left and up the stairs. PowerPyx notes you can ask the receptionist, then follow the pink line on the floor through the door on the left to room 203. Wake Jason.
2. The wheelchair
Lucia puts Jason in a wheelchair and pushes him toward the exit. You control Jason's aim while she steers. Enemies come out of doors along the whole route.
Tip: VGC's advice is to use focus mode as often as it is available, because the number of enemies makes it very easy to die here.
3. Alone in the ambulance bay
Lucia leaves to find a vehicle. PowerPyx describes the next beat: a man with a shotgun comes at Jason, Jason takes it from him and uses it, and each shot rolls the wheelchair backwards. Then nearby gas canisters are hit and Jason is thrown to the floor.
4. Crawl to the gun
Crawl forward to the weapon on the ground. Lucia arrives in an ambulance and ends the fight.
5. Defend the ambulance
You are now in the back of the ambulance as Jason, with Lucia driving and vehicles in pursuit.

Target
Effect

The driver
Stops that car

The passenger firing at you
Reduces incoming damage

Engine or wheels
Disables the car; VGC says a car with shot wheels can swerve into the ones behind it

After a few minutes a cutscene takes over.
6. The motel
You wake the next day in a motel. PowerPyx says the pair fled west to Kelly County. Chapter 2 begins.
Where players fail

Saving focus for later. There is no later; use it in the corridors.
Shooting bodywork in the chase. Wheels, engines and drivers stop cars. Doors do not.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed (PowerPyx)

Trophy
Paradise Lost, for finishing Chapter 1, unlocks in the next mission according to PowerPyx and GTABase

Chapter 2 opens with a very short scene: What's in the Bag?. See the trophy guide for the rest of the list.

Q: Where is Jason in the GTA 6 Discharge Time walkthrough?
A: On the second floor of Vice City Hospital. PowerPyx gives room 203: go left from the entrance, up the stairs and follow the pink line on the floor. VGC describes the ward as the ICU.

Q: How do you survive the hospital fight in Discharge Time?
A: Use focus mode as much as you can. VGC warns that it is very easy to die here because enemies come through every door while Lucia pushes Jason's wheelchair.

Q: What is the best way to stop cars in the ambulance chase?
A: Shoot the driver, the shooter, or the engine and wheels. VGC says shooting the wheels can send one car into the others and clear the road quickly.

Q: Is Discharge Time the last mission of Chapter 1?
A: Yes. Both VGC and PowerPyx end Chapter 1 here. You wake up the next day in a motel at the start of Chapter 2.

# GTA 6 Don Gone Walkthrough: Donnie's Trailer and the .38

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-don-gone-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Don Gone is a short clean-up job for Brian: pack Donnie's things, drive his car out of Key Lento and destroy it.
- Five items go in the bag: a photo, the flight schedule, clothes, Donnie's ID and the map on the fridge.
- Open the trunk before you destroy the car: PowerPyx says a unique pistol, Donnie's H&L .38, is inside and can be missed.

This GTA 6 Don Gone walkthrough lists every item you need in Donnie's trailer, what to do about the three men waiting outside, and the one thing you can miss for good: a unique pistol in the trunk. PowerPyx lists it as "Don Gone (Head to Donnie's Trailer)". It follows directly from the events of Swamped.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Don Gone (mission 18 in our list, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Head to Donnie's Trailer

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Donnie's trailer, Key Lento

Requirement
Starts automatically after Swamped

Reward
Donnie's H&L .38 (missable)

Brian wants the trailer to look as if Donnie packed up and left town.
Objectives

Find and collect Donnie's bag.
Pack Donnie's belongings.
Get in the car and leave Key Lento.
Destroy Donnie's car.

Step-by-step
1. The flag and the bag
VGC starts with taking down the flag outside the trailer. Inside, the bag is on the bed. Pick it up.
2. Pack the trailer
Tip: PowerPyx says focus mode (L3 + R3) highlights what you still need.

Item
Where

Photo
On the wall next to the TV

Flight schedule
By the "Patriot" neon sign, on the nightstand

Clothes
Near the bed: a shelf (PowerPyx), drawers or wardrobe (VGC)

Donnie's ID
On a shelf: right of the door (PowerPyx), across from the fridge (VGC)

Map
On the fridge

Two extras are in the room. PowerPyx lists a message to play on the phone. Both guides mention an optional prompt to "do one for Donnie"; PowerPyx says the drug lowers health, briefly boosts stamina and has no effect on the mission.
3. The three men outside
When you step out, the three military men from the bar fight in Coming Home are waiting. VGC treats the fist fight as required and says they are a little more aggressive than before. PowerPyx says you can also run to Donnie's car and drive off.
If you fight: block first, then counter, as you did against D-Man.
4. Leave Key Lento
Load up and drive Donnie's car out of the region, following the route north.
5. Open the trunk first
Before you do anything to the car, open the trunk and take Donnie's H&L .38. PowerPyx marks it as a missable unique weapon variant.
6. Destroy the car
Pick a quiet spot. Any of these works:

Take the gas can from the car, pour it over the car and light it.
Shoot the engine until it explodes (VGC).
Drive it into the ocean and let it sink (PowerPyx).

VGC ends the mission with a call from Brian as you leave the area.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail state. The real risk is destroying the car with the pistol still in the trunk.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Missable
Donnie's H&L .38, in the trunk (PowerPyx)

Optional
The phone message; "do one for Donnie"

PowerPyx lists a follow-up task next, Donnie's Lost Drugs, before Lucia calls to start Recalibration. For other guns, see GTA 6 weapons.

Q: Where are all the items in the GTA 6 Don Gone walkthrough?
A: The bag is on the bed. The photo is on the wall next to the TV, the flight schedule is by the Patriot neon sign, the clothes are near the bed, Donnie's ID is on a shelf and the map is on the fridge.

Q: How do you get Donnie's H&L .38 in Don Gone?
A: Open the trunk of Donnie's car before you destroy it. PowerPyx lists the pistol as a missable unique weapon variant.

Q: How do you destroy Donnie's car in Don Gone?
A: Use the gas can in the car to burn it, shoot the engine until it blows (VGC), or drive it into the ocean and let it sink (PowerPyx).

---

# GTA 6 Down to Earth Walkthrough: Seaplane Drops for Brian

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-down-to-earth-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Down to Earth is the first seaplane mission: Jason and Lucia collect a package at Bobcat Bay and make a series of drops.
- Land gently: VGC warns that hitting the water too hard destroys the plane and fails the mission.
- It ends with hiding the drugs in the washing machine before Lucia's parole officer arrives, and unlocks the first meditation spot.

This GTA 6 Down to Earth walkthrough covers Brian's first flying job: a boat to clean, a seaplane run to Bobcat Bay with Lucia, a deal that turns into a gunfight, and a race home before her parole officer finds the drugs. PowerPyx lists it as "Down to Earth (Meet Brian)". Both PowerPyx and VGC count it as the fourteenth mission.
Before you start

Step-by-step

Guide
Pressure washer input

PowerPyx

VGC
"R2 or R1", like firing a weapon

Lucia turns up partway through and wants to see the job.
2. Fly to Bobcat Bay
Board the seaplane with Lucia and fly to the marker. PowerPyx places it in the far north-west of Mariana County. Land on the water beside the waiting boat.
3. The pickup and the fight
PowerPyx describes the smugglers throwing a package into the water, with Lucia steering while you fish it out. They expect payment and you have none, so it turns into a gunfight.
Tip: PowerPyx notes that shooting arms and legs leaves enemies alive and builds a "professional" reputation, while killing them builds a "violent" one. It says either approach finishes the mission.
4. Make the drops
Fly to each marked spot. PowerPyx counts three: you land for the first two and Lucia drops the package for you. After the second, the coastguard becomes suspicious, so the third is dropped from the air. VGC describes this last one as flying alongside a boat.
5. Get home
Lucia finds a pile of missed calls from her parole officer, who is on the way to the house. Fly back and land near the dock.
6. Hide the drugs
Put the package in the washing machine in the shed below the house, then join Lucia at the front while she talks the officer round.
7. Meditation
After the cutscene, PowerPyx says Lucia shows Jason how to meditate on the terrace, which unlocks the first of 18 meditation spots.
Where players fail

Hard water landings. VGC: hit the water too fast and the plane explodes, which fails the mission. Come in low and slow.
Landing too far from a drop. Once you are down, the plane steers like a boat for a short distance, so taxi closer.

The first of 18 meditation spots (PowerPyx); 50 meditations unlock a cheat

PowerPyx lists an optional task next, depositing cash into BuckMe. After that, two calls open Day Release and Clear Skies. See the GTA 6 mission list for the full order.

Q: How do you land the seaplane in the GTA 6 Down to Earth walkthrough?
A: Slow down as you approach the water; VGC recommends holding L2. Hitting the water too hard makes the plane explode and fails the mission. Once down, you can steer it like a boat for a short distance.

Q: How do you use the pressure washer in Down to Earth?
A: Pick it up from the floor next to the boat and spray until the grime is gone. PowerPyx gives L2 + R2 on PS5 (LT + RT on Xbox); VGC describes it as firing like a weapon.

Q: Where do you hide the drugs in Down to Earth?
A: In the washing machine in the shed below Jason's house. Then go to Lucia at the front of the house while she talks to her parole officer.

# GTA 6 Fast Travel: How RydeMe and Taxis Work

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-fast-travel/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 fast travel works through rides: order one on the phone, set a destination and pay $100 to skip straight there.
- The RydeMe app is the main method; PowerPyx also describes calling Paradise Taxi from your contacts early in Chapter 1.
- The skip fee is $100 on top of the normal fare, so it is a convenience rather than a free teleport.

GTA 6 fast travel is done by ordering a ride on your phone and paying to skip it: there is no map teleport, but a $100 skip gets you anywhere a car can reach. With a map about twice the size of GTA 5's, you will use it a lot. Here is how each method works, what it costs and when it opens up.
Fast travel at a glance

Method
How
Available

RydeMe app
Phone &gt; RydeMe &gt; choose a destination
With the bank account (VGC) or from Chapter 2 (PowerPyx)

Paradise Taxi
Phone &gt; Contacts &gt; All Contacts &gt; Paradise Taxi
After Gone Fishing (PowerPyx)

Skip the ride
Talk to the driver and pay
$100 on top of the fare

How to use RydeMe

Press Up on the D-pad to open the phone.
Open the RydeMe app.
Choose where to go. VGC lists three options: your current safehouse, your map marker, or New Destination, which opens the map so you can pick a spot.
Wait for the car. It shows as a white car icon on the minimap, so check there if you cannot see it.
Get in.
Hold L2 (LT on Xbox) to talk to the driver and press Triangle (Y) to pay $100 and skip to the destination. Or do nothing and ride along.

VGC mentions a middle option as well: paying to speed the ride up without skipping it entirely.
How to call a taxi without the app
PowerPyx describes an older-style route that works before RydeMe:

Open the phone and go to Contacts &gt; All Contacts &gt; Paradise Taxi.
Wait for the line to answer and for the taxi to arrive.
Set a marker on the map. PowerPyx says the marker can be placed on parts of the map you have not uncovered yet.
Get in, hold L2 / LT to speak to the driver, and press Triangle / Y to skip for $100.

PowerPyx adds that the same number still works later if RydeMe has no driver available. VGC, for its part, calls RydeMe the only traditional fast travel, so treat the phone call as a fallback.
What it costs

Charge
Amount

Fare
Not listed by any guide; PowerPyx says it rises with distance on RydeMe

Skip
$100, regardless of distance, on top of the fare

Tip: early in Chapter 1, $100 is real money. Once the BuckMe account is open and jobs pay better, it stops mattering. Ideas for getting there: how to make money in GTA 6.
When it unlocks
The two launch guides do not agree:

PowerPyx: taxis by phone from the end of Gone Fishing; the RydeMe app from Chapter 2.
VGC: RydeMe unlocks with Buck Me, because the app needs a bank account.

What both agree on is that you cannot use RydeMe in the first few missions. If the app is missing from your phone, call the taxi number instead.
Limits

The ride is cancelled if the car cannot reach you (VGC). Walk to a road and order again.
No guide describes fast travel during a mission or with a wanted level. Assume you need to be in free roam and clear of the police.
Buses and trains are not documented as fast travel in the guides we checked.

Tips

Set a map marker first, then open RydeMe: "map marker" is one tap.
After swapping characters, VGC notes the lead you left may take a RydeMe of their own. See how to switch characters.
Use rides to open up the map early; the full region guide is in GTA 6 map.

New to the game? The other basics are in our beginner's guide.

Q: How do you fast travel in GTA 6?
A: Press Up on the D-pad to open the phone, order a ride with the RydeMe app, set a destination, get in and pay $100 to skip the journey. You can also sit through the ride.

Q: How much does fast travel cost in GTA 6?
A: Skipping a ride costs $100 on top of the fare. PowerPyx says the RydeMe fare itself rises with distance; no guide lists exact fares.

Q: When does fast travel unlock in GTA 6?
A: Guides differ. PowerPyx says you can call Paradise Taxi after Gone Fishing and that RydeMe arrives in Chapter 2. VGC says RydeMe unlocks with the Buck Me mission, because it needs a bank account.

# GTA 6 Feng Shui Walkthrough: Furniture and the Two Games

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-feng-shui-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Feng Shui is the tenth mission in GTA 6: Jason and Cal get the house ready before Lucia comes home.
- You move four pieces of furniture, then play two games on the console: Tenebrae Lux and Street Trash III.
- Neither game needs to be beaten; the mission moves on by itself and ends the next morning.

This GTA 6 Feng Shui walkthrough covers the tenth mission, a quiet evening at Jason's house with Cal before Lucia is released. PowerPyx also lists it as "Meet Cal". There is nothing to fight and nothing to fail: you move furniture, play two games-within-the-game and wake up to a phone call.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Feng Shui (mission 10, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Meet Cal

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Jason's house in Key Lento

Requirement
Finish Island Dreams

Reward
None listed

Next mission
Coming Home, after a set of optional errands

PowerPyx reports that a text message arrives after Island Dreams and a marker then appears on the house. Walk in to begin.
Objectives

Sit on the couch.
Move the TV, the coffee table, the couch and the chair.
Play Tenebrae Lux.
Play Street Trash III.

Step-by-step
1. Get a beer and sit down
Take a beer from the fridge and sit on the couch with Cal. He decides the place is not good enough for Lucia after her time inside and that the room needs rearranging.
2. Move the furniture
Help Cal carry four things, in this order: the TV, the coffee table, the couch and the chair.
After the coffee table you can say it is fine or offer to move it again. PowerPyx tried both: if you move it again, Cal cannot make up his mind and has you shuffle it back and forth until it is where it started. Nothing changes.
3. Play Tenebrae Lux
Sit back down and the console comes on. The first game, Tenebrae Lux, is a slow black-and-white first-person game.

Source
What it reports

PowerPyx
Head for the locked door on the right and try to climb the hill. The game cannot be finished and ends by itself after a while

VGC
It has small chessboard-style puzzles where you clear the board. Finish the first two and Jason asks to play something else

Either way, a few minutes of play is enough. Jason gets bored and the game switches.
4. Play Street Trash III
The second game is an arcade shooter; VGC describes it as a twin-stick shooter. PowerPyx notes an on-screen timer and says it cannot be won. Play until you are killed, or let yourself die straight away if you want to move on.
5. The morning after
A cutscene shows the two of them up through the night. In the morning Jason gets the call that Lucia is about to be released, which sets up Coming Home.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail state. The only time sink is trying to beat the two games:

Tenebrae Lux has no ending to reach in this mission.
Street Trash III always ends in a loss.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed in either guide

Optional goals
None listed

Unlocks
The console at the safe house, usable at any time (VGC)

What to do before the next mission
Feng Shui is the last mission before Lucia returns, and the game gives you a set of optional errands first: groceries, flowers, a necklace, a haircut and collecting her clothes. Both guides say these affect the relationship between the two leads, so they are worth doing. Our Coming Home walkthrough lists them with the one price the guides give.
The full story order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you finish the games in the GTA 6 Feng Shui walkthrough?
A: You do not have to. Tenebrae Lux ends after a short while and Street Trash III ends when you die or the timer runs out. PowerPyx says dying at once is the quickest way through.

Q: How do you start Feng Shui in GTA 6?
A: Finish Island Dreams. A marker then appears at Jason's house, and the mission begins when you walk in.

Q: Does the coffee table choice matter in Feng Shui?
A: No. If you agree to move it again, Cal has you shift it back and forth until it is where it started. The result is the same.

Q: Can you play the console again after Feng Shui?
A: Yes. VGC notes that the JoyStation at the safe house can be used at any time.

# GTA 6 File Size: How Many GB on PS5 and Xbox

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-file-size/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Rockstar says the GTA 6 pre-load needs up to 212 GB, depending on your console.
- The PS5 download is about 210 GB; the Microsoft Store lists just under 210 GB on Xbox.
- Boxed copies contain a download code, so they need the same space.

The GTA 6 file size is about 210 GB, and Rockstar says to have up to 212 GB of free storage. Sony gives PS5 owners the same 212 GB figure as a minimum. That makes GTA 6 one of the largest console installs so far, and it is the same whether you bought it digitally or in a box. Below: the size on each console, the updates released so far, how long the download takes, and the quickest ways to make room.
How we checked: the 212 GB figure is Rockstar's own, and the per-console sizes and update sizes are each reported by at least two outlets.
GTA 6 file size at a glance

Console
Download
Free space to plan for

PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro
About 210 GB
212 GB

Xbox Series X and Series S
About 209.9 GB (Microsoft Store listing)
212 GB

PC
No PC version
Not applicable

Rockstar's wording is "up to 212 GB depending on your device", and it has not given a separate number for each Xbox model. Planning for 212 GB on any console is the safe choice.
The updates so far
Two updates were released between pre-load and launch. Neither came with patch notes.

Update
Date
PS5
Xbox Series X|S

01.002.000
November 13, 2026
About 1 GB
Not reported

01.002.001
November 16, 2026
About 602 MB
About 1.6 GB

Why it matters: updates need working room while they install, so a drive with exactly 212 GB free can still refuse a patch. Keep a few gigabytes spare beyond the game itself.
Why the boxed copy does not save space
The physical edition of GTA 6 has a download code in the box instead of a disc. You redeem the code and download the full game, so a boxed copy takes exactly as much space as a digital one, and it cannot be installed without an internet connection. Boxed copies reached shops from November 12, a week before launch. More in GTA 6 physical copy.
Tip: a boxed copy as a gift still means a 210 GB download on the day. Redeem and download it ahead of time if you can.
How much of your console that is

Console
Usable space when new
Share GTA 6 takes

PS5 (launch model, 825 GB drive)
Roughly 667 GB
Close to a third

Xbox Series S (512 GB model)
Roughly 364 GB
More than half

Xbox Series X (1 TB)
Roughly 800 GB
About a quarter

Usable space is always lower than the number on the box, because the system software takes its share.
Why it matters: on a 512 GB Series S, GTA 6 and one other large game are about all that fits. If that is your console, an expansion card is worth considering before anything else. Our best console for GTA 6 comparison weighs storage alongside price and picture quality.
How long the download takes
These are simple calculations for a 210 GB download at a steady speed. Real downloads are slower at busy times.

Connection speed
Approximate time

50 Mbps
About 9 hours 20 minutes

100 Mbps
About 4 hours 40 minutes

300 Mbps
About 1 hour 35 minutes

500 Mbps
About 55 minutes

1 Gbps
About 30 minutes

Tip: use a network cable if you can, and start the download before you go to bed. Both consoles keep downloading in rest mode when that option is switched on.
How to make room

Open storage settings and sort games by size.
Delete large games you are not playing. You can download them again later.
Move PS4 or older Xbox games to an external USB drive. Current-generation games must run from internal or official expansion storage.
If you are still short, add an M.2 SSD on PS5 or a Storage Expansion Card on Xbox.
Clear old video captures; they add up quickly.
Leave a few gigabytes above 212 GB free for updates.

If the download gets stuck
Launch week put heavy load on the stores, and PS5 owners had PlayStation Network sign-in errors on November 18. If your download stalls:

Pause and resume first. Cancelling throws away what has already been downloaded.
Check the service status page for PlayStation or Xbox before changing anything on your console.
Update the console. On PS5, a system software update is required before GTA 6 will start.
Check the account. You must be signed in to the account that owns the game. On PS5, if the game shows as not owned, use Settings, Users and Accounts, Other, Restore Licenses.
Only then delete and download again.

Is there a way to install less?
Not at the moment. Rockstar has not offered separate packs, such as leaving out some audio languages, and the game is a single download. GTA 6 is also single-player only at launch, so there is no separate online component to skip; see GTA 6 online.
What is not confirmed

A PC file size. There is no PC version and no PC requirements; see GTA 6 PC requirements.
Exact sizes per Xbox model. Rockstar gives one "up to" figure for all devices.
Future growth. Updates will add to the size over time, but Rockstar has announced none after launch.

What this means for you
If you have a PS5 or a Series X with a few other games installed, expect to delete two or three of them. If you have a 512 GB Series S, plan around GTA 6 being most of your drive. Either way, sort out storage before you sit down to play: the download is the slow part, not the install.
When you could download it
Pre-loading opened on November 10, 2026 for digital pre-orders, and the game unlocked at local midnight on November 19. For the timing in each region, see what time GTA 6 came out. Prices and editions are in our editions guide, and the supported consoles are listed in GTA 6 platforms.
What we will add to this page
The size of each post-launch update as it is released, any change to the base install, and the PC size if a PC version is announced.

Q: How many GB is GTA 6?
A: Up to 212 GB of free space, according to Rockstar. The download itself is about 210 GB on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Q: Is the GTA 6 file size different on Xbox?
A: Barely. The Microsoft Store lists about 209.9 GB, close to the roughly 210 GB download on PS5.

Q: Does the physical copy of GTA 6 save storage space?
A: No. The boxed edition contains a download code, not a disc, so it uses the same space as a digital copy.

# GTA 6 First-Person Mode: Is There One and How to Use It

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-first-person-mode/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 has no full first-person mode at launch: you cannot walk, run or fight in first person.
- A limited first-person view exists when you stand still (hold L2 and click R3), when you aim a weapon with a sight, and when you drive with the phone out.
- Rockstar has not announced a first-person mode; GTA 5 only gained its mode in the 2014 re-release.

GTA 6 does not have a full first-person mode: you cannot walk, run or fight through the character's eyes as you can in GTA 5. What it has instead is a set of limited first-person views that most players never find. This page explains each one, the buttons for PS5 and Xbox, and what is still unknown.
First-person views at a glance

Situation
PS5
Xbox
Limit

Standing still
Hold L2, click R3
Hold LT, click the right stick
Ends when you move

Aiming a weapon with a sight
Aim with L2, click R3
Aim with LT, click the right stick
Needs an optic on the gun

Driving
Up on the D-pad (phone out)
Up on the D-pad
The phone covers part of the screen

The standing view
Stand still, hold L2 and click R3. The camera moves to first person and you can look around freely. As soon as you walk, it returns to third person.
VGC words the input slightly differently: press L2 to zoom, then click L3 and R3 together. It also explains why the order matters: clicking both sticks without holding L2 first starts focus mode and drains the focus meter. If one version does not work for you, try the other.
Tip: VGC recommends this view for looking closely at details in the world.
Aiming down sights
With a weapon that has a sight, aim with L2 and click R3 to look through it. PowerPyx and GamerFuzion both say you need an optic fitted, which you buy from the clerk at a gun store. See GTA 6 weapons for what is on sale and Gear Up for your first visit to a gun shop.
Driving with the phone out
Press Up on the D-pad while driving to take out the phone. The camera goes to a first-person view from the driver's seat. PowerPyx says this is the only way to drive in first person; GamerFuzion notes the drawback, which is the phone itself in the middle of your view. VGC adds that the camera goes first-person in certain vehicles, without naming them.
What you cannot do

Walk, run, swim or fight in first person.
Lock the camera to first person in the settings. Insider Gaming points to Settings &gt; Camera, but the option there is third-person camera height.
Play a whole mission in first person.

Claims we could not confirm
Insider Gaming says holding Down on the D-pad cycles through three camera modes. GamerFuzion checked the control layouts and found Down assigned to quick navigation instead. With one source for and one against, we are leaving it out of the table.
Will a first-person mode be added?
Rockstar has not announced one. Two guides speculate that it could come later, and both say plainly that it is a guess. The only relevant history is GTA 5: it launched in 2013 without first person and gained it with the PS4 and Xbox One version in 2014. A PC version of GTA 6 has not been announced either.
Settings worth changing instead
If you wanted first person for a closer, more immersive view, try lowering the third-person camera height under Settings &gt; Camera. For everything else in the first hours, see the beginner's guide; for what the pad can do, see GTA 6 controller.

Q: Does GTA 6 have a first person mode?
A: Not a full one. Four launch guides agree that you cannot play GTA 6 in first person the way you can in GTA 5. There are limited first-person views when standing still, aiming with a sight and driving with the phone out.

Q: How do you go first person in GTA 6?
A: Stand still, hold L2 (LT on Xbox) and click the right stick. Moving ends the view. VGC describes it as L2 followed by clicking both sticks.

Q: Can you drive in first person in GTA 6?
A: Only with the phone out. Press Up on the D-pad while driving and the camera moves to a first-person view with the phone on screen, according to PowerPyx and GamerFuzion.

---

# GTA 6 Hey Arnold! Walkthrough: Chase and the Arnold Choice

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-hey-arnold-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Hey Arnold! is the eighth mission in GTA 6: Jason, Brian and Cal confront Brian's broker, and it turns into a chase.
- The chase crosses a broken bridge with a stunt jump and ends on foot at the docks.
- Killing or sparing Arnold makes no difference to the story; either way he is gone for good.

This GTA 6 Hey Arnold! walkthrough covers the eighth mission: a meeting with Brian's broker that goes wrong, the first proper car chase with shooting, and the first choice between killing and sparing someone. PowerPyx also lists it as "Meet Brian". The choice at the end does not change the story, so play it the way you prefer.
Before you start

Detail

Arnold is one of Brian's contacts. He has gone quiet since the trouble with the Kingfishers in Gone Fishing, and Brian wants to know why. Bring a gun with ammo: you will be shooting from the car.

A pink search area appears further south. It shrinks as you get closer. Arnold is at the radar station, standing in front of a small building. Reaching him starts a cutscene.

L1 (LB) draws your weapon in the car, R1 (RB) fires.
L3 + R3 slows time so you can aim.

The route crosses a bridge with a missing section. Keep your speed up and the ramp carries you across; PowerPyx notes the stunt jump happens automatically.
5. The foot chase
Arnold eventually leaves his car and runs. Chase him to the docks, where he gives up.
VGC adds a harder alternative: you can destroy his car and kill him during the driving section, before he ever gets out.

At the docks you decide.

Source

PowerPyx

Kill him

VGC

Both guides agree there is no lasting effect on the story.
Where players fail

Losing Arnold in the car. Stay close and let the bikers come to you rather than slowing to aim at them.
Braking before the bridge. The gap needs speed.
Hanging around after a loud kill. VGC warns that if you shoot Arnold, you should leave before the police arrive. See GTA 6 wanted level.

Tip: PowerPyx notes that stunt jumps stay marked on your map; filter the map to the Exploration icons to see them. Stunt jumps count toward 100% completion and toward a cheat unlock, covered in GTA 6 cheats.
Next is Island Dreams, a diving job for Kenton. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Should you kill or spare Arnold in the GTA 6 Hey Arnold walkthrough?
A: It does not change the story. PowerPyx reports that Arnold leaves the game either way, and VGC shot him and saw no consequence beyond a change to Jason's criminal profile.

Q: Where is Arnold in Hey Arnold!?
A: At the radar station. After you pick up Cal at the liquor store, a search area appears to the south; Arnold is outside a small building there.

Q: How do you start Hey Arnold! in GTA 6?
A: Finish Pipework and wait a few minutes for Brian to call, then meet him at the pool bar in the south of Key Lento.

Q: How do you shoot while driving in GTA 6?
A: Press L1 (LB) to draw your weapon and R1 (RB) to fire. Pressing L3 and R3 together slows time to help you aim.

# GTA 6 Home Sweet Home Walkthrough: Escape the Manhunt

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-home-sweet-home-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Home Sweet Home is played as Lucia and starts the moment Tourist Trap ends: two intruders are in Jason's house and it is on fire.
- After the fight you escape a police search of Key Lento on foot, by car or by water.
- VGC reports that reaching Andy's car earns a unique jacket; every route leads into Discharge Time.

This GTA 6 Home Sweet Home walkthrough covers the second of Chapter 1's three closing missions: Lucia alone at Jason's house, two intruders, a fire and a police search of Key Lento to slip through. It is short and mostly about stealth. It starts automatically after Tourist Trap, so there is nothing to prepare.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Home Sweet Home (mission 21 in our list, Chapter 1)

Playable character
Lucia

Starts at
Jason's house, Key Lento

Requirement
Starts automatically after Tourist Trap

Reward
No cash; a unique jacket on one escape route (VGC)

Next mission
Discharge Time, the last mission of Chapter 1

You cannot free roam between these missions. See the warning in our Tourist Trap walkthrough.
Objectives

Grab Jason's stash and escape the house.
Escape the area.

Step-by-step
1. Enter the house
Lucia has come back to collect some of Jason's things before the two leave town. Inside are two masked intruders who have wrecked the place, are after the stash and have started a fire.
2. Fight the intruders
Beat both of them.
Tip: keep away from the flames. VGC warns that catching fire drains health very quickly, so pull the fight toward the parts of the room that are not burning.
3. Get out
Leave by the front door at once. PowerPyx says there is not enough time to reach the cash before the house explodes. VGC mentions grabbing the photos by the door on the way out, and that the blast throws Lucia off the balcony.
4. Escape the search area
Lucia wakes up with police on the way and a search area on the map. The guides describe three ways out:

Route
How
Notes

Andy's car
Call Andy, then sneak through the neighbourhood to the car
VGC: Andy takes Lucia to the hospital and gives her a unique jacket

The main road
Crouch through the dark to the road through the middle of Key Lento, steal a car or keep walking (PowerPyx)
VGC says open roads are very hard, with a helicopter overhead

The water
Take a boat or jet ski from the docks by the houses
VGC: stealing one alerts the police further

Tip: stay crouched and stay off open ground. VGC notes that trailers and buildings can be cut through, though most have to be broken into first.
5. The edge of the area
As you near the edge of the search area a cutscene takes over and leads straight into Discharge Time. VGC says the other routes play a slightly different scene but end at the same place, the hospital.
Where players fail

Standing in the fire. It is the quickest way to die in the house.
Lingering inside. Leave as soon as the second intruder is down.
Being seen by the police. PowerPyx lists being spotted as what ends the escape. For how detection works, see GTA 6 wanted level.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed (PowerPyx)

Route reward
A unique jacket from Andy if you reach the car (VGC). VGC does not say whether the other routes give it

Next is Discharge Time, which closes Chapter 1; we will add its walkthrough to the GTA 6 mission list next.

Q: How do you escape the police in the GTA 6 Home Sweet Home walkthrough?
A: Stay crouched and out of sight, and head for the edge of the search area. You can sneak to Andy's car, steal a car on the main road through Key Lento, or take a boat or jet ski from the docks.

Q: Can you save Jason's stash in Home Sweet Home?
A: The guides do not describe a way to keep it. PowerPyx says there is no time to reach the cash after the fight and you must leave by the front door before the house explodes.

Q: Who do you play as in Home Sweet Home?
A: Lucia. Jason was wounded in Tourist Trap, and this mission begins as soon as she returns to his house.

# How to Save in GTA 6: Manual Saves, Autosave and Slots

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-how-to-save/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- To save in GTA 6, open the pause menu, go to Game and choose Save Game; you can do it anywhere in free roam.
- There are 15 manual slots and a single autosave slot that is overwritten each time.
- Saving is locked during missions, and KeenGamer reports it is also locked in the prologue and after any cheat is used.

To save in GTA 6, pause the game, open the Game section and choose Save Game: you get 15 manual slots and can save anywhere in free roam. Because missions cannot be replayed, your saves are the only way back to an earlier point, so it pays to use the slots with a plan.
Saving at a glance

Menu path
Pause &gt; Game &gt; Save Game

Pause button
Options (PS5), Menu (Xbox Series X|S)

Manual slots
15

Autosave
One slot, overwritten each time

Where
Anywhere in free roam; no safehouse needed

Locked
During missions; also the prologue and after cheats (KeenGamer)

How to save manually

Make sure you are not in a mission.
Press Options on PS5 or Menu on Xbox.
Go to Game.
Choose Save Game.
Pick an empty slot, or overwrite one you no longer need.
Let the save finish before you quit.

To load, use the same Game tab and choose Load Game.
How autosave works
The game keeps one autosave. KeenGamer says it updates after you finish missions and open-world events; all three guides agree it lives in its own slot and replaces itself every time. Beebom confirms that an autosave never overwrites a manual save.
Why it matters: the autosave only ever holds your most recent moment. If you want to go back further than that, only a manual save will do. PowerPyx also warns that loading an older manual save replaces the autosave.
When you cannot save

Situation
Source

During any mission
All three guides (PowerPyx: "usually greyed out")

The whole prologue, until Jason reaches his house after the first job for Brian
KeenGamer

After using any cheat, even a screen filter, until you restart the game
KeenGamer

The cheat rule matches what cheat lists report: an active cheat switches off saving and trophies. Make a clean save first. Details: GTA 6 cheats.
Do beds and safehouses save the game?
No. KeenGamer says sleeping in the bed at Jason's house skips the night and restores health and stamina, but saving is done from the menu, wherever you are.
How to organise 15 slots
PowerPyx and KeenGamer suggest the same structure for the five-chapter story:

Slots
Use

10
Start and end of each chapter

5
Rotating free-roam saves and saves before big choices

Tip: alternate at least two slots after every mission. If something goes wrong in one save, you lose a few minutes instead of hours.
Saves worth making early

After the prologue, as soon as saving unlocks.
Before Lucia's release. Beebom gives the house repairs as an example of content that closes: see Jason's house projects.
Before Tourist Trap, the point of no return in Chapter 1: see the Tourist Trap walkthrough.
Before entering any cheat code.

Cloud saves
KeenGamer notes that PS5 saves back up to PlayStation Plus cloud storage and Xbox saves sync to the cloud automatically. That is console behaviour rather than a GTA 6 setting.
For the rest of the basics, see how to play GTA 6.

Q: How do you save in GTA 6?
A: Press Options on PS5 or Menu on Xbox, open the Game section, choose Save Game and pick a slot. It works anywhere in free roam; you do not need to be at a safehouse.

Q: How many save slots does GTA 6 have?
A: 15 manual save slots, plus one autosave slot. Every guide we checked gives the same number.

Q: Does GTA 6 autosave?
A: Yes, into one slot that is overwritten each time. KeenGamer says it triggers after missions and open-world events. It never overwrites your manual saves.

Q: Why can't I save in GTA 6?
A: You are probably in a mission, where saving is greyed out. KeenGamer adds two more cases: the whole prologue, and any session in which a cheat has been used.

---

# GTA 6 Island Dreams Walkthrough: Treasure Dive and the Shark

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-island-dreams-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Island Dreams is the ninth mission in GTA 6: Jason leads a bachelor party on a wreck dive for Kenton.
- You use a metal detector to find treasure, free a diver called Dobbs and shoot a shark with a harpoon.
- It pays $400 and opens up treasure diving: Kenton buys what you bring up from this and other wrecks.

This GTA 6 Island Dreams walkthrough covers the ninth mission, the game's diving tutorial: a guided wreck dive that doubles as a treasure hunt. PowerPyx also lists it as "Work for Kenton". It introduces scuba gear, the metal detector and the harpoon gun, and it opens one of the early ways to earn money.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Island Dreams (mission 9, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Work for Kenton

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Kenton's shop, Island Dreams, by the beach in Key Lento

Requirement
Finish Hey Arnold!

Reward
$400 (PowerPyx)

Next mission
Feng Shui

Kenton buys treasure from the waters around Leonida. He will lend Jason his boat and scuba gear, but first Jason has to take a bachelor party out to a wreck.
Objectives

Go to the diving spot.
Change into the scuba gear.
Escort the bachelor party through the trench.
Search for treasure near the wreck.
Rescue Dobbs.
Escort the bachelor party to the boat.

Step-by-step
1. Talk to Kenton and take the boat out
Speak to Kenton in his shop. After the cutscene, board the boat with the bachelor party and drive it to the marker out at sea.
2. Put on the scuba gear
Interact with the scuba gear at the back of the boat, then jump in.

Action
Control
Source

Dive
Hold R1 (RB)
PowerPyx

Surface
X
PowerPyx

Swim faster
L3
VGC

Strafe
L2
VGC

Oxygen is the green bar at the top left. PowerPyx says you have plenty for this dive.
3. Lead the group through the trench
Swim down through the trench, which looks like an underwater tunnel. The divers follow you to the shipwreck.
4. Find the treasure
Open the weapon wheel and select the Metal Detector. Aim it with L2 (LT) and sweep the pink search area, which is outside the wreck. The light turns from red to green near treasure and, per VGC, flashes faster the closer you get. When you are on the spot, a prompt appears to collect it.
PowerPyx shows three treasure spots here and says the next step starts when all three are found. VGC describes picking up a couple of gold doubloons before the rescue prompt appears, and notes that you can come back later for anything you miss.
5. Free Dobbs
One of the divers, Dobbs, gets stuck under a grate on the wreck. Swim to him, lift the grate, and head for the boat.
6. Stop the shark
A shark shows up on the way back. Equip the harpoon gun, listed as the Arras Bullhead, from the weapon wheel and shoot it.

PowerPyx: two hits and it leaves.
VGC: aim for the head and get close, because the shot drops sharply over distance.

Then surface. A cutscene ends the mission.
Where players fail

Searching inside the wreck. The treasure in this mission is outside it.
Firing the harpoon from too far away. The shot falls short. Close the distance first.
Standing around on land in scuba gear. VGC notes the gear, the metal detector and the harpoon gun unequip themselves if you spend too long out of the water.

Does it matter if Dobbs dies?
No. PowerPyx reports that if you do not shoot the shark it takes Dobbs, and that the only difference is the dialogue in the closing cutscene. The bachelor party does not come back later in the story either way.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
$400 (PowerPyx; VGC does not list one)

Unlocks
Kenton's boat and shop; treasure diving at this and other wrecks

Optional
Study fish with R1 to add them to your animal list

Tip: PowerPyx points out that studying sea life while you are down here counts toward the animal line of the 100% checklist; see GTA 6 animals. Treasure you sell to Kenton is covered in how to make money in GTA 6.
Next is Feng Shui. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you find the treasure in the GTA 6 Island Dreams walkthrough?
A: Pick the Metal Detector from the weapon wheel, aim it with L2 (LT) and swim around the marked area outside the wreck. The light goes green and flashes faster as you get close, then a prompt appears.

Q: Can Dobbs die in Island Dreams?
A: Yes, according to PowerPyx: if you do not shoot the shark, it gets him. It changes only the dialogue in the final cutscene.

Q: How do you kill the shark in Island Dreams?
A: Equip the harpoon gun (the Arras Bullhead) and shoot the shark. PowerPyx says two hits drive it off; VGC advises getting close, because the shot drops quickly.

Q: What is the reward for Island Dreams in GTA 6?
A: PowerPyx lists $400. After the mission you can come back to Kenton's shop, use his boat and sell him treasure.

# GTA 6 Jason's House: How to Fix All 4 Projects

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-jasons-house-projects/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Jason's house has four repair projects: the front steps, the leaky roof, the back railing and the bedroom wall.
- They can only be done before Lucia is released in Coming Home; after that the chance is gone.
- Finishing them raises the starting relationship with Lucia; VGC says the meter starts much lower if you skip them.

Jason's house in GTA 6 has four repair projects, and all four have to be finished before Lucia is released from prison. They take a few minutes, cost nothing that either guide mentions, and decide how the relationship between the two leads starts. Miss the window and they are gone for the rest of the game.
The four projects at a glance

Project
Where
What you do

Steps
Outside, by the stairs near the driveway
Replace the worn steps with the wood stacked beside them

Leaky roof
Up the ladder by the porch
Walk across the roof and repair the damaged section

Railing
Back deck, by the workout equipment
Face the house and fill the gap in the railing

Bedroom wall
Bedroom, wall opposite the bed
Finish the wall, then paint it

When they become available
VGC says the repairs open once you have full control of Jason after Gone Fishing, with the objective appearing when you return to the house.
1. The steps
A stack of wood sits beside the stairs outside. Stand next to it and use the prompt; Playnews gives it as holding Triangle on PS5 or Y on Xbox. VGC notes this one is required to get into the house, so you cannot miss it.
2. The leaky roof
Ladders stand by the front of the house on the porch. Climb up, cross the roof to the damaged part near the top, which VGC describes as covered by a tarp, and repair it.
3. The railing
Go out of the back door onto the deck and down to Jason's workout equipment. Turn to face the house. There is a gap in the railing next to a ladder, and the prompt appears when you look at it.
4. The bedroom wall
In the bedroom, the wall opposite the bed is unfinished, with boards leaning against it. Interacting starts a longer sequence: Jason closes the wall up and then paints it. You pick the colour.
Tip: choose whatever you like. VGC checked, and the colour does not change Lucia's reaction or the relationship gain.
The deadline
Both guides are clear that the projects cannot be done after Lucia is collected in Coming Home. VGC adds that the game warns you before she returns, and that there are no further chances afterwards.
The same window covers five optional errands, such as flowers, groceries and a necklace. They are listed in the Coming Home walkthrough.
What you get

Result
Source

Lucia is happier with the house, which helps the relationship
Playnews

The starting relationship meter is much lower if you skip the repairs
VGC

Neither guide mentions a trophy, a cheat or cash for the repairs. The relationship itself matters later: several cheats unlock from time and activities with your partner.
Suggested order

Steps, on your way in.
Bedroom wall, while you are inside.
Railing, out the back.
Roof, last.

Playnews suggests doing the errands in town first and the house afterwards, so that you are already home when Lucia's second call comes. The order above simply saves walking.
If you already missed them
There is no way to redo them. Beebom uses these repairs as its example of why to keep a manual save before big story moments. If you have an older save from before Coming Home, load it: see how to save in GTA 6.
The house itself does not stay with you for the whole story, so nothing here carries a long-term cost beyond the relationship. For what happens to it, see the warning in the Tourist Trap walkthrough.

Q: What are the projects at Jason's house in GTA 6?
A: Four repairs: the steps outside, the leaky roof, the railing by the workout area and the bedroom wall, which you also paint. VGC and Playnews list the same four.

Q: Can you fix Jason's house after Lucia comes home?
A: No. Both guides say the projects cannot be done once Lucia is released. VGC says the game warns you before she returns.

Q: Does the paint colour matter in Jason's bedroom?
A: No. You choose the colour, but VGC says it does not change Lucia's reaction or the relationship gain.

# GTA 6 Just a Scratch Walkthrough: Fix Jason's Car for Free

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-just-a-scratch-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Just a Scratch is the fifth mission in GTA 6 and one of the shortest: a tutorial for the repair shop.
- Drive Jason's '70 Ganado to Coastal Auto Care, where the repair is free during this mission.
- Later repairs cost money, and you can phone the shop for a paid tow.

This GTA 6 Just a Scratch walkthrough covers the fifth mission, a two-minute stop at the repair shop that teaches you how fixing and respraying a car works. PowerPyx also lists it as "Fix Your Car". The repair costs nothing this once, so take it.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Just a Scratch (mission 5, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Fix Your Car

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Coastal Auto Care in Key Lento, driving Jason's own car

Requirement
Finish Gone Fishing

Reward
Free engine repair and respray

Next mission
Unwanted Attention

You need Jason's personal car, a '70 Ganado, which is kept at his house. If you wrecked it, PowerPyx's fix is to save manually (Pause Menu &gt; Game &gt; Save/Load Game) and load that save: you return at the house with the car outside.
Objectives

Talk to Joey.
Restore the engine and get a respray.

Step-by-step
1. Drive the Ganado to Coastal Auto Care
Follow the marker to the shop. Joey is standing outside the garage. Talk to him (PowerPyx gives the prompt as hold Up and press X on PS5, A on Xbox), then drive into the garage.
2. Choose Full Engine
In the shop menu, pick Full Engine. It is free during this mission.
3. Respray the car
Open Cosmetics &gt; Respray and choose any colour. The colour has no effect on the mission.
4. Leave the shop
Drive out. VGC notes that a short cutscene plays, and from then on this is where you repair and change cars.
Where players fail
There is no real way to fail. The only snags reported are:

Arriving in the wrong car. The mission is about Jason's Ganado, not a stolen vehicle.
Spending money on upgrades. VGC says you probably cannot afford mods yet anyway. PowerPyx warns that the Ganado is replaced later and upgrades do not carry over.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Free engine repair and respray

Optional goals
None listed in either guide

Unlocks
Coastal Auto Care for repairs, resprays and mods

What the mission teaches

Repairs cost money after this. The free fix is a one-off.
You can call for a tow. VGC says you can phone Coastal Auto Care from anywhere. It costs money but is quicker than driving a damaged car back.
A respray is more than cosmetic. Police remember your vehicle, so a new colour helps after a chase. The next mission, Unwanted Attention, makes you do exactly that, and our wanted level guide explains the system.
Personal vehicles come later. PowerPyx reports that the Ganado is your personal car for the rest of Chapter 1. You can drive stolen cars, but registering a new personal vehicle opens up in Chapter 2.

For the cars you can expect to find, see GTA 6 cars. The full story order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where does the GTA 6 Just a Scratch walkthrough start?
A: At Jason's house in Key Lento. Get into his own car, a '70 Ganado, and drive to the Coastal Auto Care marker.

Q: Is the repair free in Just a Scratch?
A: Yes. Both PowerPyx and VGC say the engine repair is free during this mission. PowerPyx lists the respray as free too. Later visits cost money.

Q: What if Jason's car is destroyed before Just a Scratch?
A: PowerPyx's fix is to make a manual save from the pause menu and load it. You come back at the house with the car parked outside.

Q: Can you upgrade Jason's car in Just a Scratch?
A: The mod options are there, but you probably cannot afford them yet. PowerPyx also warns that this car is replaced later in the story and its upgrades are lost.
