# GTA 6 Lab Fees Walkthrough: Mission 4 and Both Door Codes

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-lab-fees-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Lab Fees is the fourth mission in GTA 6: Jason collects Brian's rent from a shop that hides an acid lab.
- The back-room keypad code is 0420 and the code for Brian's lockup is 7700.
- The $600 reward is reported to arrive later in the mailbox outside Jason's house.

This GTA 6 Lab Fees walkthrough covers the fourth mission of the game, where Jason collects rent for Brian and walks out with acid instead of cash. PowerPyx also lists it under the task name "Collect Brian's Rent". The two door codes you need are 0420 and 7700.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Lab Fees (mission 4, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Collect Brian's Rent

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
A small shop in Key Lento, marked on the map

Requirement
Finish Gone Fishing

Reward
$600, delivered to Jason's mailbox (PowerPyx)

Next mission
Just a Scratch

VGC notes that once you control Jason, several early missions can be done in any order. We follow the order of the in-game story recap, the same order both guides use.
Objectives

Talk to the clerk.
Enter the lab and collect the acid.
Call Brian.
Stash the acid in Brian's lockup.

Step-by-step
1. Go to the shop and call Brian
Drive to the mission marker in Key Lento. The shop sits in a small cluster of stores and bars; PowerPyx calls it a gift shop, VGC a trinket shop behind a surf shop. Open the phone with Up on the D-pad and call Brian. He tells you to go in and get his money.
On the way, VGC points out a WAiNK scan nearby: the large whale statue. Point the phone at it to log it. See GTA 6 collectibles for what scans count toward.
2. Deal with the clerk
Talk to the clerk (L2 + X on PS5, LT + A on Xbox). He says he has no rent. The guides show three ways to change his mind:

Approach
Result
Source

Punch him once
He offers the acid in the back room
PowerPyx

Aim your gun at him
He gives up the code
VGC

Wait for him to pull a baseball bat, then take it
He backs down and gives up the code
VGC

All three end the same way. VGC adds that killing him still lets you use the code but brings the police, so there is no reason to do it.
3. Open the lab with 0420
Use the keypad on the door in the corner and enter 0420. Pick up the acid. Both guides say there is cash to take as well: PowerPyx mentions the register in the shop, VGC a cash box in the back room. Then leave.
4. Call Brian and drive to the lockup
Call Brian again. He sends you to his lockup at the southern end of the Keys, shown as a green icon on the map.
5. Stash the acid with 7700
Enter 7700 on the lockup door, go inside and put the acid in the stash. That ends the mission.
Where players fail

Killing the clerk. It is not needed, and VGC reports it alerts the police. See GTA 6 wanted level.
Looking for the pay straight away. The reward is not handed over at the lockup. PowerPyx reports it arrives in Jason's mailbox after a while, because he has no bank account at this point.
Forgetting the second call. The lockup marker appears only after you phone Brian from outside the shop.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

$600 by mail (PowerPyx; VGC does not list a reward)

Optional loot
Cash in the shop

Nearby scan
The whale statue, for WAiNK

Unlocks
Brian's lockup as a place to sell drugs

Brian's lockup stays useful after the mission: both guides say you can sell drugs there. PowerPyx adds that fences also buy jewelry and marked bills, that more of them open up as the story goes on, and that stolen goods travel in a bag you can leave in your car trunk. More ways to earn early are in how to make money in GTA 6.
Next up is Just a Scratch. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What is the door code in the GTA 6 Lab Fees walkthrough?
A: The keypad on the lab door in the shop is 0420. The clerk gives it to you, and one guide says it is also written on a notepad in the room. Brian's lockup opens with 7700.

Q: How do you get the clerk to pay in Lab Fees?
A: He has no cash. Hit him once, point a gun at him, or take the baseball bat off him when he pulls it out. He then offers the acid in the back room instead of rent.

Q: What happens if you kill the clerk in Lab Fees?
A: VGC reports that the 0420 code still works, but killing him alerts the police. You do not need to kill him.

Q: What is the reward for Lab Fees in GTA 6?
A: PowerPyx lists $600. Jason has no bank account yet, so the money turns up later in the mailbox in front of his house.

# GTA 6 on Netflix: What the Extended Look Is and Where to Watch

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-netflix/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- GTA VI: An Extended Look premiered on Netflix on August 27, 2026.
- It is a gameplay presentation of about 26 minutes, not a series or a film.
- The same video is free on Rockstar's YouTube channel and the official GTA VI site.

GTA 6 on Netflix is not the game: it is Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, a gameplay video that Rockstar premiered on Netflix on August 27, 2026, six hours before it went up everywhere else. The game itself cannot be played or streamed through Netflix. This page explains what the Netflix title is, when and why it appeared there, what it shows, where to watch it now without a subscription, and why so many people still search for a GTA 6 Netflix series that does not exist.
Dates, times and the running length below are confirmed by Netflix's own article and at least one independent outlet. Viewing figures come from a single report and are labelled as such.
GTA 6 on Netflix at a glance

Title on Netflix
Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look

What it is
An official gameplay presentation, not a series, film or playable game

Announced
August 6, 2026, by Rockstar Games

Netflix premiere
Thursday, August 27, 2026, 3 p.m. ET

Free release
9 p.m. ET the same day, on Rockstar's YouTube channel and the GTA VI site

Netflix head start
Six hours

Length
About 26 minutes (Netflix lists it as 27 minutes)

Captured on
PlayStation 5, in-game footage

Rating on Netflix
TV-MA

Can you play GTA 6 on Netflix?
No

What the Extended Look is
It is the third official GTA 6 video and the first to show the game being played. Trailer 1 in December 2023 and Trailer 2 in May 2025 were cinematic. The Extended Look runs for close to half an hour and walks through missions, police chases, car theft and the things you do between jobs. Netflix describes it as captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5.
Why it matters: fans had spent more than a year waiting for a "Trailer 3". Rockstar skipped the short trailer and went straight to a long gameplay showcase, so if you are looking for Trailer 3, this is it. All three videos are covered in all GTA 6 trailers.
When it premiered, hour by hour
Rockstar announced the video on August 6, 2026, three weeks ahead. The schedule on the day:

Time (ET), August 27, 2026
What happened

3 p.m.
Premiere on Netflix, worldwide

9 p.m.
Release on Rockstar's YouTube channel and the official GTA VI site

That gave Netflix a six-hour window. Netflix's own article used the same figure, saying members could watch six hours before anyone else.
Tip: if you read that the Extended Look was "a Netflix exclusive", that was true for those six hours only.
Who could watch it on Netflix
According to Netflix, the video was available globally to all subscribers, with subtitles in 13 languages. No particular plan was required. It has its own title page on the service, so searching for "Grand Theft Auto" in the Netflix app finds it.
Netflix files it oddly. TechSpot noted that the service counted it as an English-language film in its charts, which is part of why people assume there is a GTA movie.
Where to watch it now

YouTube: on the Rockstar Games channel. Free, no account needed.
Rockstar's site: on the official GTA VI page.
Netflix: where it premiered. Availability there can change, as with any Netflix title.

You do not need a Netflix subscription. The YouTube version is the same video.
What it shows
Our full breakdown is in GTA 6 gameplay: what the Extended Look showed. The short version:

Shown in the video
What we learned

Police and wanted level
Six stars, plus red heat icons for what the police know about you

Car theft
A short hands-on sequence instead of one button press

Two leads
Jason and Lucia working the same mission, one driving while the other shoots

Activities
Gym workouts, jet skis, kayaks, base jumping, store robberies

Racing
Wheel-to-wheel racing on a purpose-built circuit

Why it matters: the systems in the video are the ones launch guides now document in the released game. The wanted system is explained in GTA 6 wanted level, and the race venues are covered in Port Gellhorn.

How the game plays

PCWorld, writing when the Netflix premiere was announced, put the two earlier trailers at nearly 300 million and about 200 million views, and pointed out that no real gameplay had been shown officially before August 27.
Why it matters: if you only have time for one video before buying, the Extended Look tells you far more about what you will actually be doing than either trailer.
Is there a GTA 6 Netflix series or film?
No. The Netflix title is one video of under half an hour. There is no announced GTA series, documentary or film on Netflix or anywhere else. The confusion comes from three things: the premiere was promoted like a show, Netflix lists it among films, and it carries an age rating like any other title on the service.
Can you play GTA 6 through Netflix?
No. Netflix's games catalogue does not include GTA 6, and the game is not streamed through the service. It is sold for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. See GTA 6 platforms for what it runs on and GTA 6 price and editions for what it costs.
Tip: any site offering to "unlock GTA 6 on Netflix" or asking for a login to play it there is not genuine. There is no such version.
Why Rockstar premiered it on Netflix
Neither company has given a detailed reason. The one statement on record is from Netflix: Brandon Riegg, its vice president of nonfiction series, said the company was honored that Rockstar had partnered with it to show the next part of the story to Netflix members first.
What can be said is that it was a first. Rockstar's earlier GTA 6 videos went straight to YouTube.
How many people watched it
Netflix has not published a figure in its own article. TechSpot reported these numbers, without naming where the Netflix figure came from:

What this means for you
If you searched for GTA 6 on Netflix hoping to play it, you need a PS5 or an Xbox Series X|S. If you wanted the video everyone talked about in August, it is free on YouTube and still worth half an hour, especially before you start the story. And if you were looking for a GTA series, there is none.

Q: Is GTA 6 on Netflix?
A: The game is not. A gameplay video called Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look premiered on Netflix on August 27, 2026.

A: No. The Netflix title is a single gameplay presentation of about 26 minutes.

Q: Do I need Netflix to watch the GTA 6 Extended Look?
A: No. It is also on Rockstar's YouTube channel and on the official GTA VI website for free.

# GTA 6 News Today: Launch Week Round-Up for November 20

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-news-today/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: live

- GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; Sensor Tower estimates about 24.6 million copies through launch day.
- Two updates arrived before launch (01.002.000 and 01.002.001), and Rockstar has published no patch notes or known-issues list.
- No online mode, PC version or first post-launch patch has been dated as of November 20.

GTA 6 news today, November 20, 2026: the game has been out for one day, early sales estimates are far above GTA 5's record, and Rockstar has not yet published patch notes, an online date or a PC version. This round-up covers everything that changed around launch, in order of how much it affects you if you are playing right now. We update it through the week.
How we checked: each item is confirmed by Rockstar, Sony or Microsoft, or reported by at least two independent outlets. Anything that rests on one report or on player posts is labelled that way.
The week at a glance

Date
What happened

November 10
Pre-loading opened

November 13
Update 01.002.000 released, about 1 GB on PS5

November 16
Update 01.002.001 released, about 602 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox

Reviews published; New Zealand unlocked first; PS5 owners reported PSN sign-in errors

November 19
Worldwide launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; first sales estimates

November 20
Metacritic user reviews due to open; no official sales figure yet

GTA 6 is out
Rockstar's launch post is short: Grand Theft Auto VI is available worldwide for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocked at midnight local time on November 19, region by region, starting with New Zealand. The date set a year earlier held.
Why it matters: nothing about the launch platforms changed at the last minute. There is no PC version and no previous-generation version. See GTA 6 platforms.
Sales: about 24.6 million copies through launch day, by estimate
Take-Two has not announced sales. The analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates about 24.6 million copies and roughly $2.36 billion through the evening of November 19, pre-orders included, with about three in four copies on PlayStation. GTA 5's official first-day figure in 2013 was 11.21 million copies and $815.7 million.
Why it matters: the estimate is not an official number, and it counts months of pre-orders. Our full breakdown is in how much money GTA 6 has made.
Reviews: 99 on Metacritic
Reviews went live on November 18. GTA 6 holds a Metascore of 99 from about 150 critics, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest on the site. Metacritic's user reviews were scheduled to open at midday Pacific time on November 20.
Tip: user scores for huge launches swing wildly in the first days. The critic average is the steadier guide. Details: GTA 6 reviews.
Updates: two before launch, no patch notes

Both updates rolled out in waves on PS5. Rockstar has not said what either changed, has not called either a "day-one patch", and as of November 19 its support site listed no title update notes for GTA 6.
Tip: install both before you start. On PS5, highlight the game, press Options and choose Check for Update. On Xbox, look in My games & apps under Manage and Queue. Storage needs are in GTA 6 file size.
PS5 owners need the latest system software
On November 17, PlayStation Support said a PS5 system software update must be installed before GTA 6 will start, even if the game is already pre-loaded. Reports give different version numbers for it, so we are not quoting one.
Tip: go to Settings, then System, then System Software and install whatever is offered. If the game refuses to launch, this is the first thing to check.
PSN sign-in errors on November 18
As the first regions unlocked, PS5 owners reported being unable to sign in to PlayStation Network for a couple of hours, with a message that services were busy. Outage trackers logged more than a thousand reports. Sony did not give a cause, and its status page showed services as normal for much of that time. No similar Xbox outage was reported.
Why it matters: GTA 6 is single-player, but a boxed copy is a download code and a digital copy needs a licence check, so you must be able to sign in at least once. If sign-in fails, check the PlayStation status page and wait before retrying; reinstalling does not help when the problem is on Sony's side.
Boxed copies: it is a code, so check it early
The retail box holds a download code, not a disc, and you have to sign in to redeem it. In the days before launch there were scattered reports of boxes with a missing or unreadable code. Neither Rockstar nor Sony has confirmed a widespread problem. PlayStation's guidance is that a buyer with a missing or unreadable code should go back to the retailer, while account, download and redemption problems go to the platform's support.
Tip: if you bought a box as a gift, open it and check the code now rather than on the day. More in GTA 6 physical copy.
Bugs: player reports, nothing confirmed
Rockstar has not acknowledged any bug or published a known-issues list. Launch trackers checked on November 18 and 19 found no confirmed gameplay bugs. One launch-day round-up collected player reports of crashes in the opening mission and of characters falling through the map; those are unverified posts, and the same round-up notes that many players report no problems.
Tip: GTA 6 has 15 manual save slots. Keep two or three in rotation rather than relying on the autosave. Our beginner's guide shows where the save menu is.
Cheats: 18 codes confirmed, a 19th reported
The picture has not changed since launch morning: 61 cheats exist, all locked until the story is finished, and 18 button codes are published by two or more guides. A code for the Drunk cheat now appears on two sites, but one of them says it comes from a single guide, so we are holding it back until it is independently confirmed. Full table: GTA 6 cheats.
Walkthroughs: the first eleven missions
Mission guides are filling in quickly. PowerPyx lists five chapters for the story. We added eight walkthroughs today, from Lab Fees through Coming Home, which takes our coverage to the point where Lucia rejoins Jason. The running order is in the GTA 6 mission list.
Online and PC: still nothing dated

Online. Both console stores describe GTA 6 as a single-player experience. Rockstar has not announced an online mode or a date. See GTA 6 online.
PC. No PC version has been announced, so there are no system requirements either. Take-Two's chief executive said on November 9 that news about other versions will come from Rockstar. See GTA 6 PC requirements.
Cloud and Remote Play. Xbox Cloud Gaming is listed for Xbox consoles, including Xbox One, not for PC or browsers. Rockstar says the game supports Remote Play from your own PS5 or Xbox, which is the only official way to see it on another screen.

What is not confirmed

A dated first patch. Posts claiming Rockstar has apologised and scheduled a fix for a specific day are unverified; nothing on Rockstar's own channels supports them.
Official sales. Take-Two has said only that figures will be shared soon.
Patch contents. Guesses that the pre-launch updates were about stability or security are guesses.
GTA Online transfers, a PC date, a Switch 2 version. None announced.

What to do today if you are playing

Install the PS5 system software update, then both game updates.
Make a manual save before each mission and keep a spare slot.
Bank your cash as soon as the BuckMe account opens; carried money is lost when you are wasted or busted.
Do the optional errands before Coming Home; they affect the relationship between the leads.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you go. Progress made during the story counts toward 100% completion.
Be careful with links promising unlock tools, free codes or PC versions. None of those exist.

What this means for you
One day in, the launch has been steady for a release of this size: the game works for most people, the only widespread problem was a short PlayStation Network sign-in issue the day before, and the reviews are as good as reviews get. The open questions are all about what comes next rather than what is broken. If you were waiting to see whether the launch was a mess, it was not.
What we will add to this page

Take-Two's first official sales figure.
The first post-launch title update and its notes, when Rockstar publishes them.
Metacritic user scores once they settle.
Any announcement about online play or PC.
New cheat codes as two sources confirm them, and each new mission walkthrough.

Q: What is the GTA 6 news today?
A: As of November 20, 2026: the game is out, Sensor Tower estimates about 24.6 million copies through launch day, the Metacritic score is 99, and Rockstar has not yet published patch notes, an online mode date or a PC version.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 day-one patch?
A: Two updates were released before launch: 01.002.000 on November 13 (about 1 GB on PS5) and 01.002.001 on November 16 (about 602 MB on PS5, about 1.6 GB on Xbox). Rockstar has not published notes for either.

Q: Are the GTA 6 servers down?
A: GTA 6 is a single-player game at launch, so there are no game servers to go down. PS5 owners had PlayStation Network sign-in errors on November 18; Sony gave no cause.

# GTA 6 PC Requirements: No Official Specs Yet

URL: https://gta6box.com/pc/gta-6-pc-requirements/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: unconfirmed

- There are no official GTA 6 PC requirements: the game launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, and no PC version has been announced.
- Every minimum and recommended spec list online is a guess.
- The only confirmed numbers are from consoles: up to 212 GB of storage and a 30 FPS target.

There are no official GTA 6 PC requirements. GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. Rockstar Games has not announced a PC version, so it has not published minimum or recommended specs. This page separates what is confirmed from what is guesswork and suggests how to plan a PC without relying on invented numbers.

Why there are no PC specs
System requirements are published when a PC version is announced, usually on the store page. GTA 6 has no Steam page, no Epic Games Store page and no PC listing on Rockstar's site, which shows two platforms. Rockstar's launch post on November 19 says the game is available for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
What Take-Two has said about PC
Rockstar's parent company has been asked about PC many times. Its chief executive, Strauss Zelnick, has answered in general terms:

When
What he said
Reported by

February 2025
Rockstar has historically started on some platforms and moved to others later
Endgame Tools, Gaming Route

May 2026
Rockstar "always starts on console"; PC can be 45 to 50% of sales for a big game
Endgame Tools, Gaming Route

November 9, 2026
GTA VI is on two consoles at launch, and news about other versions will come from Rockstar
Endgame Tools, Output Lag, Hone

None of these is an announcement, and none mentions hardware.
The spec lists you see online
Search results are full of "GTA 6 minimum requirements" tables with specific processors and graphics cards. They are predictions. Nobody outside Rockstar has seen a PC build's requirements, and every guide we checked that is careful about sourcing says the same. We do not publish a predicted table, because a guess presented in a table looks like a fact.
What the console version tells us
The consoles are the only real evidence of how demanding the game is:

Storage. Rockstar says the download needs up to 212 GB depending on the device. See GTA 6 file size.
Frame rate. The game targets 30 FPS on every console, with no 60 FPS mode. See does GTA 6 run at 60 FPS.
Hardware floor. It runs on the Xbox Series S, the least powerful of the supported consoles. See GTA 6 platforms.

These facts suggest a heavy game that needs a fast SSD with a lot of free space. They do not translate into a specific graphics card.
How long Rockstar's PC versions have taken

Game
Console release
PC release
Gap

GTA 5
September 17, 2013
April 14, 2015
About 19 months

Red Dead Redemption 2
October 26, 2018
November 5, 2019
About 12 months

In both cases the requirements came with the PC announcement, not at console launch. Counting the same gaps from November 19, 2026 gives late November 2027 to mid-June 2028. That is arithmetic, not a forecast.
One report points earlier: GamesBeat wrote on October 13, 2026, citing unnamed sources, that a PC version is planned for the first three months of 2027. Rockstar did not comment, and it remains unconfirmed. Our GTA 6 PC release date page follows this.
How to prepare a PC without guessing

Do not buy parts for GTA 6 yet. Hardware gets cheaper and better while you wait, and the real requirements may be a year or more away.
If you are building now anyway, leave room for a large game: at least 250 GB free on an NVMe SSD is a reasonable plan given the console size.
Ignore "GTA 6 ready" labels on pre-built PCs. No such certification exists.
Do not buy PC keys. Any site selling a GTA 6 PC key is not selling a real product.

Can you play GTA 6 on a PC today?
Only through a console you own. Rockstar's support pages say the game supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox, so you can stream it from your own PS5 or Xbox to a PC screen. Xbox Cloud Gaming is listed for Xbox consoles, not for Windows or browsers.
What is not confirmed

That a PC version is in development.
Any PC release date or window.
Any minimum or recommended specification, storage size or price for PC.
Whether console saves would carry over.

What we will add to this page
The official minimum and recommended requirements, on the day Rockstar publishes them, with a plain-language explanation of what each tier is good for.

Q: What are the GTA 6 PC requirements?
A: None have been published. Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6, so there are no minimum or recommended specs. Lists you see online are estimates.

Q: What are the GTA 6 system requirements on console?
A: A PlayStation 5 or an Xbox Series X or S, and up to 212 GB of free storage according to Rockstar. On PS5 the latest system software is also required.

Q: How much storage will GTA 6 need on PC?
A: Unknown. The console version needs up to 212 GB, so planning for at least that much free SSD space is sensible, but it is not an official PC figure.

Q: Can I play GTA 6 on my PC now?
A: Only by streaming from a console you own with Remote Play. There is no Steam, Epic or Rockstar Games Launcher version.

# GTA 6 Pipework Walkthrough: Fix Mandy's Sink (Mission 7)

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-pipework-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Pipework is the seventh mission in GTA 6: Jason goes to collect Mandy's rent and ends up fixing her sink.
- The plunger is on the bathroom floor; use it on the kitchen sink with R3, then clear the pipe underneath.
- Jason cannot romance Mandy, whatever you choose in the conversation.

This GTA 6 Pipework walkthrough covers the seventh mission, a short indoor job where Jason has to unblock a tenant's sink before she will talk about rent. PowerPyx also lists it as "Collect Mandy's Rent". There is no combat and no way to fail.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Pipework (mission 7, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Collect Mandy's Rent

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Mandy's house in Key Lento

Requirement
Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch and Unwanted Attention (PowerPyx)

Reward
Macizo Cigar (PowerPyx); rent money (VGC)

Next mission
Hey Arnold!

If the marker is missing, finish the four earlier missions first: Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch and Unwanted Attention.
Objectives

Follow Mandy.
Pick up the plunger.
Fix the sink.

Step-by-step
1. Talk to Mandy
Drive to the house and talk to Mandy outside. She is one of Brian's tenants, and she will not pay until her sink is fixed. Follow her in. PowerPyx notes that you can let her keep talking or cut in and ask where the plunger is.
2. Pick up the plunger
The plunger is on the floor of the bathroom, across from the bedroom.
3. Plunge the sink
Go to the kitchen, interact with the sink and tap R3 to work the plunger.
4. Clear the pipe
The second half happens under the sink. The guides word it differently:

Source
What you do

PowerPyx
Press R2 (RT) to use a wrench on the pipe

VGC
Move under the sink and clear the pipes in a short minigame

Follow the on-screen prompt. Mandy keeps flirting with Jason throughout.
5. The conversation afterwards
When the sink is fixed, Mandy makes a pass at Jason. You can interrupt or hear her out. PowerPyx reports the same result either way: she offers a cigar for the repair, Jason says no to the rest, and she throws the cigar box out into the street.
6. Leave the house
Head outside. PowerPyx says to pick up the cigar from the ground on your way out. VGC says you collect the money from Mandy and that Brian phones as you leave.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail condition. The two things players get stuck on are:

Not finding the plunger. It is in the bathroom, not the kitchen.
Walking past the cigar. If you want it, pick it up before you drive off.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Macizo Cigar, if you pick it up (PowerPyx)

Rent
VGC says you collect the money; PowerPyx does not mention a payment

Optional goals
None listed

Does the choice matter?
Not for romance. VGC says plainly that Jason cannot romance Mandy however you handle the visit, and that the relationship with her is still intact when you leave. The dialogue choice only changes how much of her pitch you hear. Jason's story is with Lucia, who returns four missions later in Coming Home.
After Pipework, wait a few minutes: PowerPyx reports that a call from Brian starts the next mission, Hey Arnold!. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Where is the plunger in the GTA 6 Pipework walkthrough?
A: On the floor of Mandy's bathroom, across from the bedroom she leads you to.

Q: How do you fix the sink in Pipework?
A: Interact with the kitchen sink and tap R3 to plunge it, then work on the pipe under the sink. PowerPyx gives the second prompt as R2 (RT on Xbox) with a wrench.

Q: Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?
A: No. VGC states that Jason cannot romance Mandy however you play the mission, and PowerPyx describes him turning her down.

Q: What is the reward for Pipework?
A: PowerPyx lists a Macizo Cigar, which you can pick up outside after Mandy throws the box out. VGC says you collect the rent money from her.

# GTA 6 Recalibration Walkthrough: Fishing With Cal

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-recalibration-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Recalibration is a quiet mission: beer for Cal, a fishing trip, a barbecue and a talk with Lucia.
- Fishing: cast, circle the right stick, press R2 on a bite, then push the left stick against the fish while reeling.
- It is the last calm point of Chapter 1; both guides warn that the next mission, Tourist Trap, ends free roam until Chapter 2.

This GTA 6 Recalibration walkthrough covers the calm before the end of Chapter 1: a beer run, a fishing trip with Cal, a barbecue, and the checklist to finish before you start the next mission. PowerPyx lists it as "Recalibration (Talk to Lucia)". Nothing here can go badly wrong, but what comes straight after it can cost you money and free roam.
Before you start

Step-by-step
1. Beer for Cal
Lucia suggests cheering Cal up. Drive to the marked liquor store and take any six-pack from the fridge. PowerPyx notes you pay as you pick it up; there is no register.
2. Find Cal
At his house, Cal is on a lounger out back by the water. Talk to him, then take the boat to the fishing spot. PowerPyx puts the trip at about two minutes.

If the fish swims right, push left, and the other way round. Jason lands it automatically once it is close (VGC). You need three (PowerPyx). The basics are the same as in Gone Fishing.
4. Grill
Back at Cal's dock, use the grill beside him. Cook all three fish and flip each until both sides have changed colour.
Tip: flip early. VGC's only warning for the whole mission is not to let them burn.
5. Follow Lucia
Lucia says she is not hungry and walks off. Follow her to the front of the house, talk, and drive her home. A cutscene ends the mission.
Before you start Tourist Trap
VGC's warning page and PowerPyx agree on the main point: the last three missions of Chapter 1 run back to back, and you cannot free roam again until part-way into Chapter 2. PowerPyx attaches the warning to Recalibration; VGC says the lock begins when you start Tourist Trap. Use this checklist either way:

Make a manual save in its own slot and do not overwrite it.
Bank your cash. PowerPyx says pocket cash carried into the finale is lost, and recommends at least $5,000 in Family Savings.
Finish what you want to do as Jason. PowerPyx says you cannot play as him for a long time; VGC adds that his Ultimate Edition vehicles are out of reach during that stretch.
Do not worry about side content. PowerPyx says Kenton's treasure dives, fish for Cal and the Kingfishers hideouts pause and come back later.

Why it matters: PowerPyx reports that the Key Lento house is lost for good after these missions. Anything you wanted to do there, do now.
Where players fail
Neither guide lists a fail state. Burning the fish only means cooking again.
Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed (PowerPyx)

Worth doing
The pre-finale checklist above

When you are ready, talk to Lucia on the south beach to begin Tourist Trap. Not sure about the banking part? See Buck Me.

Q: How do you fish in the GTA 6 Recalibration walkthrough?
A: Cast with L2 + R2 (LT + RT on Xbox), rotate the right stick to attract a fish, press R2 (RT) when it bites, then push the left stick opposite to the fish's direction while rotating the right stick to reel.

Q: How do you grill the fish in Recalibration?
A: Use the grill next to Cal and cook all three fish, flipping each one until both sides change colour. Flip them before they burn.

Q: Is Recalibration the point of no return in GTA 6 Chapter 1?
A: The lock-in starts with the next mission, Tourist Trap, according to VGC. PowerPyx places its warning on Recalibration, so treat the free time before and after this mission as your last in Chapter 1.

# Can You Replay Missions in GTA 6? No, Here Is the Fix

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-replay-missions/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 has no mission replay, no chapter select and no gold medals, for story missions or Strangers and Freaks.
- The workaround is the 15 manual save slots: keep a save at the start and end of each of the five chapters.
- Some optional missions disappear as the story moves on, so a spare save is the only way back to them.

No, you cannot replay missions in GTA 6: there is no replay menu, no chapter select and no medal system. That is a real change from GTA 5, where any finished mission could be restarted from the pause menu. The only way to see a mission again is a manual save from before it, so it is worth setting up your saves properly from the first hour.
The short answer

Feature
GTA 5
GTA 6

Replay a story mission from the menu
Yes
No

Gold medal objectives
Yes
No

Chapter select
No chapters
No

Replay Strangers and Freaks
Yes
No (PowerPyx)

Manual save slots
-
15

New Game Plus
No
Not at launch (Beebom)

Why there is no replay
Rockstar has not explained it. Insider Gaming, citing an IGN report, gives the likely reason: choices in missions change what happens afterwards, and random events in the open world depend on those earlier choices, so restarting a single mission in isolation would not fit the state of your game.
You can see this in the missions themselves. In Coming Home and Day Release, small choices feed the relationship between the two leads.
The workaround: plan your 15 saves
PowerPyx and KeenGamer recommend the same layout. The story has five chapters:

Slots
Use

1 to 10
One save at the start and one at the end of each chapter

11 to 15
Rotating saves for free roam, or before a mission you may want again

How to make a save is covered step by step in how to save in GTA 6. The short version: pause, open Game, choose Save Game. You cannot save in the middle of a mission, so do it before you walk into the marker.
Tip: the most important single save in the early game is the one before Tourist Trap, the point of no return for Chapter 1.
What you can miss for good

Optional missions tied to a chapter. PowerPyx says some become unavailable as the story advances, with big changes between chapters.
Jason's house repairs. They close when Lucia is released: see Jason's house projects.
Time-limited stranger missions. A few are flagged as missable in Strangers and Freaks.
One-off pickups, such as the pistol in the trunk in Don Gone.

What you cannot miss
After the credits you return to free roam. Collectibles, challenges and most of the 100% checklist stay available, and PowerPyx notes that missable optional missions are not needed for 100%.
If you already passed a mission you wanted to replay

Check your save list for an older manual save. The autosave will not help: there is one autosave slot and it is overwritten constantly.
If there is none, the only route is a new game.
From now on, alternate two or three slots after every mission so you always have a recent fallback.

Will replay be added later?
Nobody knows. Beebom says it is unclear whether Rockstar will add replay or a New Game Plus in an update. We will change this page if that happens. For how long a second run would take, see how long GTA 6 is.

Q: Can you replay missions in GTA 6?
A: No. Beebom, Insider Gaming and PowerPyx all report that GTA 6 has no mission replay feature. You can only play a mission again by loading a manual save made before it.

Q: Does GTA 6 have gold medals?
A: No. Beebom and PowerPyx both say the gold medal objectives from GTA 5 are gone, so there is no score to improve by replaying.

Q: Does GTA 6 have New Game Plus?
A: Not at launch, according to Beebom. Rockstar has not said whether one will be added.

---

# GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks: All Side Missions by Chapter

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-strangers-and-freaks/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has more than 35 Strangers and Freaks missions from about 15 characters, opening chapter by chapter.
- The Strangers and Freaks trophy needs 8 strands; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
- Three missions are flagged as missable: Get Shirley's Rum, Steal the Scooter and Race Against Yago.

GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks are the optional side missions given by characters you meet around Leonida, and there are more than 35 of them spread over the first four chapters. This page lists every one that appears on both major lists, GTABase and PowerPyx, with the giver, who can play it and the chapter. Where the two disagree, we say so. The status is "partly confirmed" because neither list gives rewards, and a few details differ.
How Strangers and Freaks work

Finding them. PowerPyx says they usually show as Optional Missions in the map's quest list or as purple side-activity markers; some are unmarked.
Strands. Each character has a chain of missions. After one, do something else until the character calls or texts; the next part can take in-game days and can cross into the next chapter.
Characters. Many can be played as either lead, but some are for Jason only or Lucia only.
After the story. Both lists say strands stay available in free roam afterwards, apart from the missable ones.
No replay. See can you replay missions in GTA 6.

Q: How many Strangers and Freaks missions are in GTA 6?
A: Neither main list gives an official total. GTABase lists 35 entries and PowerPyx lists 41, from about 15 characters across Chapters 1 to 4.

Q: Which GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks missions are missable?
A: PowerPyx flags Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter, which exist only in Chapter 1, and Race Against Yago, which is time-sensitive. Both lists say missable missions are not needed for 100%.

Q: Can you replay Strangers and Freaks missions in GTA 6?
A: No. PowerPyx reports that neither story missions nor Strangers and Freaks missions can be replayed, so keep a manual save if you want to see one again.

Q: Which strands count for the Strangers and Freaks trophy?
A: You need 8 strands. Both lists agree that Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count and that Billy, Andy, Yasmani, Tyrone, Eddie Acosta and Shirley do not. The remaining strands are not labelled yet.

# GTA 6 Swamped Walkthrough: Kingfishers Camp and Lori

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-swamped-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Swamped sends Jason and Brian to the Kingfishers camp to make peace; it turns into an ambush and a rescue.
- The chase has two parts: shooting from a helicopter, then jumping from your boat onto the one carrying Lori.
- The mission fails if the Kingfishers get away with Lori or if you shoot her by accident.

This GTA 6 Swamped walkthrough covers Brian's attempt to settle things with the Kingfishers: the drive to their camp, the ambush, a helicopter pursuit over the swamp and a jump between boats to rescue Lori. PowerPyx lists it as "Swamped (Meet Brian)". This page describes a major story event in the step-by-step section, so skip to the objectives if you want to avoid it.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Swamped (mission 17 in our list, Chapter 1)

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Brian's marina, Key Lento

Requirement
Finish Day Release, Clear Skies and Building a Life

Reward
None listed

Next mission
Don Gone, which starts immediately

Arrive with armor and plenty of ammo. Once you get into Brian's truck there is no chance to shop.
Objectives

Go to the Kingfishers Camp.
Escape with Brian and get to Lori.
Get into the helicopter.
Rescue Lori.

Step-by-step
1. Ride to the camp
Meet Brian and get in his truck. The camp is in the north-west of Mariana County and PowerPyx calls the drive a long one. Lori covers the meeting from a distance with a rifle (VGC).
2. Walk in with Brian
A Kingfisher meets you at the entrance. Follow Brian on foot through the camp to the far end, where he talks to a man named Doug beside a pig pen.
3. The pig pen
Inspect the pen when prompted (L2 + Triangle on PS5, LT + Y on Xbox). PowerPyx describes what Jason finds: Donnie's body. The Kingfishers have already killed him, and the meeting is a trap.
4. Fight out
Shoot your way through the camp and stay near Brian, who shows as a green dot on the minimap. VGC says you do not have to kill everyone, but getting out without thinning the gang is hard. Lori is grabbed during the fight.
5. Helicopter
A helicopter sits at the edge of the camp, on the left according to PowerPyx. Get in and go after the Kingfishers carrying Lori.
Tip: when the game prompts you to destroy the truck, do it. VGC says that removes a large group of Kingfishers at once.
Keep shooting the enemies on the ground. PowerPyx notes that one of them always moves Lori to another boat, and VGC says killing her kidnapper during this stretch can end the chase early.
6. Boat chase
If they reach the water, the pursuit continues by boat. There are two ways to finish it:

Method
How

Jump across
Pull alongside and hold Square (PS5) or X (Xbox), then tap the same button in the quick-time event (PowerPyx)

Shoot the driver
VGC says shooting the Kingfisher steering the boat also works

Be quick. PowerPyx warns that enemy fire can destroy your engine and force a checkpoint restart.
7. Afterwards
The rest is cutscenes. Back home you can tell Lucia about Brian's retirement plans.
Tip: do tell her. PowerPyx says the conversation improves the relationship and skipping it loses the boost.
Where players fail

Shooting near Lori. Hitting her fails the mission (VGC). Aim at the driver or the men away from her.
Hanging back in the boat. The jump prompt needs you right alongside.
Letting them leave. If the Kingfishers escape with Lori, the mission fails.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed (PowerPyx)

Optional
The conversation with Lucia at home, for a relationship boost

Brian's next request follows straight away: Don Gone. The Kingfishers first appear in Clean Up After Donnie.

Q: How do you start the GTA 6 Swamped walkthrough mission?
A: Finish Day Release, Clear Skies and Building a Life. The marker then appears at Brian's marina in Key Lento; PowerPyx says to enter the back room.

Q: How do you jump onto Lori's boat in Swamped?
A: Drive close alongside it and hold Square on PS5 (X on Xbox). PowerPyx warns that the prompt does not appear if you are too far away, then you tap the same button in a short quick-time event.

Q: What makes you fail Swamped?
A: VGC lists two fail states: the Kingfishers escaping with Lori, and shooting Lori. PowerPyx adds that enemy fire can destroy your boat's engine, which sends you back to a checkpoint.

# GTA 6 Tourist Trap Walkthrough: The Point of No Return

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-tourist-trap-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Tourist Trap starts the three-mission finale of Chapter 1; once it begins there is no free roam until Chapter 2.
- You start as Jason and finish as Lucia, fighting out of the Visitor Center and getting Jason to a boat.
- The mission fails if Jason dies. Shoot the red-glowing canisters at the dock to stop the cars chasing you.

This GTA 6 Tourist Trap walkthrough starts with a warning: this mission is the point of no return for Chapter 1. PowerPyx lists it as "Tourist Trap (Take Up Mattia's Offer)". It, Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time play one after another, and you do not get the open world back until Chapter 2. The steps below include the story turn that causes that, so read the preparation section first.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Tourist Trap (mission 20 in our list, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Take Up Mattia's Offer

Playable characters
Jason, then Lucia

Starts at
South beach of Key Lento: talk to Lucia

Requirement
Finish Recalibration

Reward
None listed

Next mission
Home Sweet Home, immediately

Do these first

Manual save in a spare slot. PowerPyx recommends keeping it for good.
Deposit your cash. PowerPyx says pocket cash brought into the mission is lost, and suggests at least $5,000 in Family Savings. See Buck Me for how banking works.
Finish Jason's business. PowerPyx says you cannot play as him for a long time and that the Key Lento house is gone for the rest of the game.
Carry adrenaline shots and ammo. VGC recommends using both in the escape.

VGC's advice is simple: there is no rush. If you still want to explore, do not start this yet.
Objectives

Find the locker in the Visitor Center and get the bag.
Return to the car.
Follow the cop.
Pick up the bag.
Follow Jason, protect Jason and escape with Jason.
Escape to open water.
Go to Cal's house.

Step-by-step
1. The locker
Lucia is collecting trash on the beach. Talk to her, and the two accept a pickup job from Mattia, who drops them at the Visitor Center in disguise. Go up the ramp and along the long path to the lockers at the far end, and take the bag.
2. The arrest
On the way back to the car, police stop you. The bag was bait. Jason and Lucia are taken to an interrogation room under the Visitor Center.
3. The interrogation room
A police captain arrives who wants the bag for himself, and his men turn on the other officers. Jason gets free. Shoot the men coming at you and go for the bag.
4. Switch to Lucia
Jason is shot and badly hurt, and control passes to Lucia. Deal with the attacker, then fight out of the building behind Jason.
Tip: VGC says to pick up the weapons and ammo enemies drop, and to use Zombix and adrenaline shots when you can. PowerPyx notes that the officers you shoot here do not count against your criminal profile.
5. Get Jason to the dock
Stay close to him. At the docks Lucia drags Jason toward the boat with one arm and fires her pistol with the other.
6. Stop the cars
Vehicles race toward the dock. Enter focus mode with L3 + R3: anything glowing red is flammable. Shoot the canisters as the cars pass to blow them up.
7. Open water, then Cal's
Drive the boat out along the pink waypoint. Lucia calls Cal, and you steer to his house. Cal takes Jason on to a hospital in Vice City.
Where players fail

Jason dies. It is the fail state VGC lists. Do not run ahead of him.
Ignoring the canisters. Shooting the cars' occupants one by one is slower than one explosion.
Starting unprepared. The cash and save warnings above cannot be fixed afterwards.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
None listed (PowerPyx)

Lost
Pocket cash; the Key Lento house (PowerPyx)

Paused
Kenton's dives, fish for Cal, Kingfishers hideouts: PowerPyx says they return later

Home Sweet Home begins as soon as Lucia is back at Jason's house. For when you get both leads back, see how to switch characters in GTA 6.

Q: Is Tourist Trap the point of no return in GTA 6?
A: Yes. VGC and PowerPyx both say that once Tourist Trap begins you are locked into the last missions of Chapter 1 and cannot return to the open world until Chapter 2. Make a manual save first.

Q: What should you do before the GTA 6 Tourist Trap walkthrough mission?
A: Save in a separate slot, deposit your pocket cash (PowerPyx says it is lost, and suggests $5,000 in Family Savings) and finish anything you want to do as Jason in Key Lento.

Q: How do you protect Jason in Tourist Trap?
A: Stay close to him on the way to the dock, pick up weapons and ammo from fallen enemies, and at the dock use focus mode (L3 + R3) to spot red flammable canisters and blow up the arriving cars.

# GTA 6 Unwanted Attention Walkthrough: Impound Lot and Heat

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-unwanted-attention-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- Unwanted Attention is the sixth mission: Jason and Cal take a car back from the police impound in Hamlet.
- It is the tutorial for heat: you respray the car, adjust your hat and glasses and buy a new outfit.
- The rewards are a police radio scanner on your phone and $150.

This GTA 6 Unwanted Attention walkthrough covers the sixth mission, where Jason and Cal lift a car from a police impound and the game teaches you how heat works. PowerPyx also lists it as "Go See Cal". Keep the car in one piece: it is the one thing that can fail the mission.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Unwanted Attention (mission 6, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Go See Cal

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
Cal, by the water in the north of Key Lento

Requirement
Finish Gone Fishing

Reward
Police radio scanner and $150

Next mission
Pipework

The guides place Cal slightly differently: PowerPyx says he is on the beach, VGC says he is fishing from a bridge. Follow the marker.
Objectives

Drive to the Hamlet impound with Cal.
Search the impound for the Phoenix.
Lose the cops.
Take the Phoenix to the Pay 'n' Spray.
Deliver the Phoenix to Brian's garage.
Collect the cash.
Adjust your hat and glasses.
Buy an outfit at the gun store.

Step-by-step
1. Drive to Hamlet
Get in Cal's truck and drive to Hamlet, a small town to the north-west. On the way Cal installs a police radio scanner on your phone. It runs in the background and lets you hear police chatter during crimes and chases.
2. Get into the impound lot
You have to climb in. The guides describe two routes:

Source
Way in

PowerPyx
Over the fence, then up the containers in the back corner and over a second fence

VGC
Through a gap at the top of the wall on the left side of the lot

Guards patrol inside. PowerPyx warns that knocking one out brings a police patrol, so either stay out of sight or move fast once you are seen.
3. Find and unhook the Phoenix
The car is a red Imponte Phoenix at the back of the lot, attached to a tow truck. Get into the tow truck and press R3 to release the cable, then get into the Phoenix straight away.
Tip: PowerPyx suggests scanning the parked cars with WAiNK while you are here. Scans made during the story count toward 100% completion.
4. Get out and lose the cops
Drive to the gate. PowerPyx says to hold the car in front of it until it slides open; VGC describes going straight through it. Either way the police are alerted. If a guard grabs the door, tap Square (X on Xbox) to shake him off.
Now leave the flashing search area on the minimap. VGC says the wanted level stays low and the car is quick, so this is not hard. The real risk is damage: VGC reports the mission fails if the car stops being driveable.
5. Respray, then deliver
Once the police give up, Brian wants the car resprayed. Drive into the Pay 'n' Spray in Hamlet, pick a colour, then park in the marked garage nearby.
6. Collect the cash and change your look
Pick up the $150. PowerPyx places it in the back room of the garage and VGC in the back of the car, so check both. Then:

Hold L1 (LB) to open the item wheel and press R1 (RB) to reach headwear and glasses. Toggle each one. The icon changes from red to white when police no longer know that look.
Go to the gun store next door and buy any outfit. The $150 covers it.

The mission ends when you have changed clothes and your heat is clear.
Where players fail

Wrecking the Phoenix. Take corners gently. Losing the police slowly is fine; a dead car is not.
Fighting the guards. It brings a patrol before you are in the car.
Skipping the outfit. The mission does not complete until you have bought and changed clothes.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
Police radio scanner and $150

Optional goals
None listed; WAiNK vehicle scans in the lot are a bonus

Teaches
Heat, resprays, outfit changes

The heat lesson in short
After an escape, red icons at the top right show what police remember: your clothing, your headwear and glasses, and your vehicle. Respray or swap the car, change the outfit, and they turn white. PowerPyx adds two habits worth keeping: store a spare outfit in your car trunk, and hold Circle (B) while driving to duck behind the wheel. The whole system is explained in GTA 6 wanted level.
Next is Pipework. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you get the car in the GTA 6 Unwanted Attention walkthrough?
A: Climb into the Hamlet impound lot, find the red Imponte Phoenix hooked to a tow truck at the back, release it from the tow truck (R3) and get in before the guards react.

Q: Can you fail Unwanted Attention?
A: Yes. VGC reports that the mission fails if the car is too damaged to drive, so escape the police without wrecking it.

Q: How do you lose the cops in Unwanted Attention?
A: Drive out of the flashing search area on the minimap. The car is fast and the wanted level stays low. Then respray it at the Pay 'n' Spray in Hamlet.

Q: What do you get for finishing Unwanted Attention?
A: A police radio scanner app from Cal and $150, which is enough to buy the outfit the mission asks for.

# GTA 6 Update: Every Patch So Far, Sizes and Patch Notes

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-update/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: partly

- The latest GTA 6 update is 1.002.001, released on November 16, 2026: 602.5 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S.
- Rockstar has not published patch notes for either pre-launch update, and no post-launch patch had been released as of November 20.
- On PS5, press Options on the game tile and choose Check for Update; on Xbox, keep automatic updates switched on.

The latest GTA 6 update is version 1.002.001, released on November 16, 2026, and there have been two updates in total, both before launch. Neither came with patch notes, and as of November 20, the day after release, Rockstar had not put out a post-launch patch. This page lists every update with its date and size on each console, explains what is and is not known about the contents, shows how to check that you are on the newest version, and separates the rumours from what Rockstar has said.
Dates and sizes below match across at least two independent trackers. Where they disagree, both figures are shown. Nothing here comes from datamined files.
GTA 6 updates at a glance

Version
Released
PS5 size
Xbox Series X|S size
Patch notes

1.002.000
November 13, 2026
About 1.07 GB
About 1.07 GB (one outlet: 2.18 GB)
None published

1.002.001
November 16, 2026
602.5 MB
About 1.59 GB
None published

Post-launch patch
Not released as of November 20
-
-
-

Xbox shows the second update as 1.0.2.1, according to RockstarINTEL. It is the same patch.
Update 1.002.000 (November 13)
The first update arrived six days before launch, while the game was still in its pre-load period. Beebom and Of Zen and Computing put it at about 1.07 GB on both consoles; KeenGamer reported about 2.18 GB on Xbox. On PS5 it appeared in the download list without a proper name.
It rolled out in stages on PlayStation rather than to everyone at once. KeenGamer, citing the PlayStation Game Size account, reported the first half of eligible consoles getting it and the rest about 11 hours later.
Why it matters: if your console was offline between November 13 and launch, this is the first thing it will download, so allow a few minutes before you can play.
Update 1.002.001 (November 16)
The second update followed three days later. Four trackers agree on the sizes: 602.5 MB on PS5 and about 1.59 GB on Xbox Series X|S. RockstarINTEL noted that the installed size on Xbox afterwards was 211.9 GB.
Xbox consoles received it straight away. On PS5 it again came in waves, reported as roughly a third of consoles at a time, with the last group getting it on the morning of November 17.
Tip: the PS5 figure can vary slightly by region. If yours shows a few megabytes more or less, it is the same patch. Total install sizes are covered in GTA 6 file size.
How to read the version number
The same patch is written three ways depending on where you look. Trackers that copy the PS5 listing write 01.002.001, most news sites shorten it to 1.002.001, and RockstarINTEL reports that Xbox shows 1.0.2.1. They are all the second pre-launch update.
Between the two patches so far, only the last block changed, from 000 to 001. So when you compare your console with a list like the one above, match the final digits: a console showing 1.002.000 is one patch behind.
Tip: on PS5 the first update was listed without a proper title, which led some players to think it was a mistake or a different game's file. It was the 1.002.000 patch.
Has there been a GTA 6 update since launch?
No. GTAside, GTA6DB and Output Lag each checked on or after November 19 and none found a new title update or a Rockstar announcement of one. The version you should see on a fully updated console is still 1.002.001.
Why it matters: if a site or video claims to list "day-one patch notes", it is describing one of the two pre-launch updates above, or guessing.
GTA 6 patch notes: what Rockstar has published
Nothing so far. Every tracker we checked says the same: Rockstar released both updates without patch notes, and Rockstar Support had no title update article for GTA VI on launch day. GTA6DB points out that Rockstar normally posts title update notes as separate support articles, so that is where the first real notes are likely to appear.
Some outlets called the second update a "bug fixing" patch, and some described both as mandatory. Neither description comes with a Rockstar source. What is certain is practical: both are small, and an online console with automatic updates installs them without you doing anything.
The PS5 system update from November 17
Sony released PS5 system software 26.07-14.23.00 on November 17. Beebom, Of Zen and Computing and SixWanted all report that it is needed to play GTA 6 at launch. Of Zen and Computing adds that neither Sony nor Rockstar announced that requirement in those words.
Tip: install it anyway. Go to Settings &gt; System &gt; System Software. An out-of-date console is one of the few launch problems you can rule out in two minutes.
How to check for a GTA 6 update on PS5

Highlight GTA 6 on the home screen.
Press the Options button.
Choose Check for Update.
Let it install, then start the game.

To have patches install while the console sleeps, turn on automatic updates under Settings &gt; Saved Data and Game/App Settings &gt; Automatic Updates, and allow the console to stay connected to the internet in rest mode under the power saving settings.
How to update GTA 6 on Xbox Series X|S
Xbox handles game patches automatically when Keep my games & apps up to date is ticked under Profile & system &gt; Settings &gt; System &gt; Updates. Pending downloads appear under My games & apps &gt; Manage &gt; Queue.
Trackers differ on a manual check. Of Zen and Computing describes opening Manage game and add-ons from the game's menu and looking at the Updates tab; GTA6DB says Xbox Support does not document a per-game check. If the game starts and does not ask for an update, you are current.
Storage: leave room for patches
Rockstar's own requirements say to keep up to 212 GB free. The two updates so far are small, but future ones will not always be. If you are choosing hardware or short on space, read which console is best for GTA 6 and GTA 6 platforms.
Launch problems that were not the game
Two trackers, GTAside and SixWanted, report that PlayStation Network sign-ins failed for a period on November 18, just as the game was unlocking in the first time zones. That was a PSN issue. Reinstalling the game or rebuilding the console database does not fix a network outage.
Tip: before you troubleshoot, check Rockstar's service status page and your console's network status page. If either shows a problem, wait.
What is not confirmed

What the two updates changed. Posts about altered story files, shaders or scripts come from community file comparisons. Of Zen and Computing and KeenGamer both label them unconfirmed.
A patch on November 25. Output Lag mentions the date as a rumour. Rockstar has announced no patch and no date.
Known bugs. Rockstar has no known-issues article for GTA 6 yet. One troubleshooting guide collected crash, audio and overheating reports from launch night; Rockstar has acknowledged none of them, and GTAside lists no bug as confirmed.
A 60 FPS mode. No update adds one. The game targets 30 FPS on every console: see does GTA 6 run at 60 FPS.
GTA Online. Nothing has been dated. See GTA 6 online.

What future GTA 6 updates could bring
Only two things are on record. Rockstar describes the launch game as single-player, so an online mode would have to arrive through a later update; GTA Online followed GTA 5 by two weeks, but no schedule exists this time. And there is no PC version, which is a separate release rather than a patch: see GTA 6 on PC.
One practical note for players using cheats: codes are entered on the D-pad and could in principle change with a patch. We recheck the published codes after every update.
What to do right now

Check for a game update using the steps above. You want 1.002.001.
Install the latest system software on your console.
Turn on automatic updates and rest-mode downloads.
Keep spare storage rather than filling the drive to the last gigabyte.
If something breaks, look at the status pages first, then restart the console before anything drastic.

What this means for you
For now the answer to "is there a new GTA 6 update?" is short: two small patches before launch, none since, no notes for either. The first update with real patch notes will be the one worth reading closely. For how the launch version was received, including the performance complaints, see GTA 6 reviews.
What we will add to this page
Each new title update will get a row in the table with its version, date and size on both consoles, followed by a plain-language summary of Rockstar's patch notes when they exist. We will also note any change that affects cheats, performance or saves. The weekly round-up is in GTA 6 news today.

Q: What is the latest GTA 6 update?
A: Version 1.002.001, released on November 16, 2026, three days before launch. It is 602.5 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S. No newer patch had been released as of November 20.

Q: Are there GTA 6 patch notes?
A: Not yet. Rockstar has not published patch notes for 1.002.000 or 1.002.001, and trackers that checked Rockstar Support on launch day found no title update notes for the game.

Q: How do I update GTA 6 on PS5?
A: Highlight the game on the home screen, press the Options button and choose Check for Update. With automatic updates on, the console also installs patches in rest mode.

# GTA 6 What's in the Bag? Walkthrough: Chapter 2 Begins

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-whats-in-the-bag-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- What's in the Bag? is the first mission of Chapter 2 and one of the shortest in the game.
- As Lucia, you look through the bag from the Visitor Center: a small statue with a note under it, and a hard drive.
- The Paradise Lost trophy for finishing Chapter 1 unlocks here, and free roam returns with Lucia as the playable lead.

This GTA 6 What's in the Bag? walkthrough covers the opening mission of Chapter 2, a short scene in a motel room where Lucia finally looks at what she and Jason nearly died for. It takes a couple of minutes, but it matters: it is where Chapter 1's trophy unlocks and where the open world comes back.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
What's in the Bag? (first mission of Chapter 2)

Playable character
Lucia

Starts at
A motel room; PowerPyx names the Starlet Motel in Kelly County

Requirement
Finish Discharge Time; it follows directly

Reward
Paradise Lost trophy; free roam as Lucia

Next
Ambulance Chaser appears when you leave the room

The guides place the motel slightly differently: VGC says Kelly County, GTABase says Port Gellhorn, and PowerPyx uses both. It is the same room. See Port Gellhorn for the area.
Objectives

Wake up at the motel.
Look inside the bag and read the note.

GTABase lists the two steps above; PowerPyx shows only "Read the note".
Step-by-step
1. Wake up
The morning after the hospital escape, the news is on. The police captain from the Visitor Center is on screen blaming the two of them for what happened.
2. The statue
Lucia goes through the bag. Pick up the small statue of a woman and turn it over. A note is fixed underneath:

From my collection. She reminded me of someone.

Tip: VGC says to keep that line in mind for later.
3. The hard drive
The other item is a hard drive. There is no computer in the room, so nothing can be done with it yet. The mission ends.
Where players fail
There is nothing to fail. It is close to a cutscene.

Change
Details

Free roam
Returns, with Lucia as the character you control (PowerPyx)

Jason
Recovering; VGC says early Chapter 2 is Lucia's and that you will soon be able to swap between the two

Trophy
Paradise Lost (Bronze, per PowerPyx) unlocks during the mission

100%
GTABase marks the mission as required

For the swap itself, see how to switch characters in GTA 6.
Optional goals and rewards
Nothing optional is listed by any of the three guides.
PowerPyx lists a task called Take Care of Jason next. The first job on the map is getting rid of the getaway vehicle: Ambulance Chaser. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What do you do in the GTA 6 What's in the Bag walkthrough mission?
A: Examine the bag as Lucia. Flip the small statue of a woman and read the note underneath, then look at the hard drive, which cannot be opened yet because the two have no computer.

Q: What does the note under the statue say?
A: "From my collection. She reminded me of someone." All three guides we checked quote the same line, and VGC suggests remembering it.

Q: Can you free roam after What's in the Bag?
A: Yes, as Lucia. PowerPyx lists open-world play as Lucia as the result of this mission, while Jason recovers.

# How Much Money Has GTA 6 Made? Copies Sold and Revenue So Far

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/how-much-money-has-gta-6-made/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: partly

- Take-Two has not published a GTA 6 sales figure as of November 20, 2026.
- Sensor Tower estimates about 24.6 million copies and $2.36 billion through launch day, pre-orders included, with roughly three in four on PlayStation.
- GTA 5's official first-day record was 11.21 million copies and $815.7 million in 2013.

How much money has GTA 6 made? Officially, nobody outside Take-Two knows yet: the publisher has not released a sales figure as of November 20, 2026. The best available number is an estimate from the analytics firm Sensor Tower: about 24.6 million copies and $2.36 billion through launch day, with pre-orders counted in. Below is what that number covers, how it grew over 48 hours, how it compares with GTA 5's record, and when a real figure is likely.
How we checked: every figure here appears in at least two independent reports, or is marked with the single outlet that reported it. Estimates are labelled as estimates throughout.
GTA 6 sales at a glance

Measure
Figure
Who says so

Not published

Guinness World Records

GTA 6 launch date
November 19, 2026
Rockstar

There is no official number yet
Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar's parent company, has not said how many copies GTA 6 has sold. Before launch its statements were deliberately vague. On its earnings call on November 9, chief executive Strauss Zelnick said pre-orders were far in excess of the company's expectations and, in the line most outlets quoted, that "we still aren't ready to declare victory."
Why it matters: every number in a headline this week is someone else's estimate. In 2013 it was the other way round: Take-Two announced GTA 5's first-day sales itself, one day after launch.
The Sensor Tower estimate: 24.6 million copies, $2.36 billion
Sensor Tower tracks digital store activity and publishes running estimates. By the evening of launch day, November 19, its tracker showed about 24.58 to 24.59 million copies and roughly $2.36 billion in revenue. Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has confirmed it.
Three things to know about the figure:

It is cumulative. It includes months of pre-orders, not only copies bought after the midnight unlock.
It covers PlayStation and Xbox. Those are the only platforms the game is on; see GTA 6 platforms.
It does not subtract refunds, as TweakTown points out.

Tip: when you see "GTA 6 sold 24 million in a day", read it as "24 million through its first day, counting pre-orders".
How the estimate grew in 48 hours
The same tracker was quoted at three points, which is why you will find three different numbers online.

When
Estimated copies
Estimated revenue

Wednesday, November 18, midday
About 17.1 million
About $1.65 billion

Thursday, November 19, morning
About 19.1 million
About $1.84 billion

Thursday, November 19, evening
About 24.6 million
About $2.36 billion

The game unlocked at local midnight in each region, starting in New Zealand on November 18; see what time GTA 6 came out. The Wednesday figure is therefore almost entirely pre-orders.
Why it matters: on these estimates, roughly 7.5 million copies and about $700 million were added between Wednesday midday and Thursday night. Most of the launch-day total was already in the bank before anyone played.
PlayStation vs Xbox
Sensor Tower's split is about three to one in PlayStation's favour.

Platform
Estimated copies
Estimated revenue

PlayStation 5
About 18.4 million
About $1.77 billion

Xbox Series X and Series S
About 6.2 million
About $588 million

The per-platform figures were reported by GameSpot and repeated by Make Tech Easier. Before launch, Sony said GTA 6 was the most pre-ordered game in the history of the PlayStation Store, and Microsoft said the same for its own store. Neither gave a count.
Why it matters: if you are choosing where to play with friends, far more of them are likely to be on PlayStation. Our best console for GTA 6 comparison covers the other differences.
How it compares with GTA 5's record
GTA 5 set the bar every big launch has been measured against since 2013. Its numbers were official:

GTA 5 (2013)
GTA 6 (2026, estimate)

First day, copies
11.21 million
About 24.6 million

First day, revenue
$815.7 million
About $2.36 billion

Source

Sensor Tower

Time to $1 billion
Three days

On paper GTA 6 is at more than twice the copies and almost three times the revenue. Two cautions apply. The GTA 5 figure came from the publisher and the GTA 6 figure from an outside firm. And a dollar in 2013 is not a dollar in 2026: the base game costs more now, which is the next point.
Why revenue rose faster than copies
GTA 5 launched at $59.99. GTA 6 costs $79.99 for the Standard Edition and $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition. Dividing Sensor Tower's revenue by its copies gives an average of about $96 per copy. That is our arithmetic on their estimate, not a reported figure, but it suggests either that a large share of early buyers chose the more expensive edition or that the estimate runs high.
Tip: if you have not bought yet, the difference between the two is covered in GTA 6 price and editions and what the Ultimate Edition adds.
What Take-Two and the platform holders have said

Take-Two has described demand with phrases such as "unprecedented" and "far exceeding expectations", without numbers.
Zelnick has said official sales data will be shared soon, and that the company prefers not to claim success before it happens.
Sony and Microsoft each called GTA 6 their store's most pre-ordered game ever, on November 10.

One comparison Zelnick did give is for the previous game: GTA 5 has now sold nearly 235 million copies. That is the long-run number GTA 6 will eventually be measured against.
Has GTA 6 made its budget back?
Rockstar has never published a budget. Reports citing Reuters put the development cost at an estimated $1 billion or more. If the Sensor Tower estimate is close, launch-day revenue alone is more than twice that, before the stores and retailers take their share and before marketing is counted. Our GTA 6 budget page goes through what is and is not known about the cost, and how long GTA 6 was in development explains where the money went.
What analysts expect next
These are forecasts from individual firms, each reported by one outlet we checked:

Firm

Take-Two's shares rose about 6% on Wednesday, November 18, and slipped about 1% on launch day itself.
What is not confirmed

Any official unit or revenue figure. Everything above is an estimate or a forecast.
Sales of boxed copies as a separate number. The box contains a download code, so retail copies are redeemed on the same stores; see GTA 6 physical copy.
Regional sales. No report we checked breaks the estimate down by country.
Profit. Revenue is not profit, and Take-Two has not discussed either for launch.

How to read GTA 6 sales headlines

Check the source. "Take-Two announced" is official. "Sensor Tower estimates" or "analysts expect" is not.
Check the window. "First day", "through launch day", "first 24 hours" and "first three days" are different measures.
Check for pre-orders. Almost all early figures include them.
Check the unit. Copies and dollars are often swapped in headlines; 24.6 million is copies, $2.36 billion is revenue.
Ignore numbers with no source at all. Round figures passed around on social media usually trace back to nothing.

What this means for you
For players, the size of the launch matters in two practical ways. A game that sells like this gets long support, so patches and extra content are a safe bet even though Rockstar has dated nothing; see GTA 6 online for what has been said about multiplayer. And critics agree with the buyers: the game sits at 99 on Metacritic, as covered in GTA 6 reviews.
What we will add to this page

Take-Two's first official sales announcement, the moment it is published. One report said it could come as early as Friday, November 20; the company has only said "soon".
First-weekend and first-week figures.
The numbers from Take-Two's next earnings report. The launch falls in its fiscal third quarter, which ends on December 31, 2026.

Q: How much money has GTA 6 made?
A: There is no official number yet. The analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates about $2.36 billion through launch day, November 19, 2026, including months of pre-orders. Take-Two has not confirmed it.

Q: How many copies of GTA 6 have sold?
A: About 24.6 million through launch day according to Sensor Tower's estimate: roughly 18.4 million on PS5 and 6.2 million on Xbox Series X|S. It is an estimate, not a publisher figure.

Q: Did GTA 6 beat GTA 5's first-day sales record?
A: On the estimates, easily. GTA 5 sold 11.21 million copies worth $815.7 million in its first 24 hours. The comparison is not like for like, because the GTA 6 figure is a third-party estimate that includes pre-orders.
