# How to Switch Characters in GTA 6 (and When It Unlocks)

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/how-to-switch-characters-in-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- To switch characters in GTA 6, hold Right on the D-pad and tap R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox; a greyed-out portrait means the other lead is unavailable.
- You cannot switch in Chapter 1. Jason is the only free-roam character there, with Lucia playable only inside set missions.
- Free switching opens during Chapter 2; one guide puts it at about 35% story completion.

To switch characters in GTA 6, hold Right on the D-pad and tap R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox Series X|S, but the option only works once the story unlocks it in Chapter 2. Until then the game decides who you play. That catches out a lot of people coming from GTA 5, where you could jump between three characters within the first couple of hours. This guide covers the controls, the exact points in Chapter 1 where you do play as Lucia, why the portrait is sometimes greyed out, and what to finish before the game takes Jason away for a while.
The controls and unlock points below are confirmed by at least two independent launch guides, and the design reasons come from a Rockstar interview. Where only one guide reports something, we name it.
Switching characters at a glance

Question
Answer

Controls
Hold Right on the D-pad, tap R1 (PS5) or RB (Xbox)

Playable leads
Two: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos

Who you start as
Lucia in the Prologue, then Jason

First free roam
As Jason, after Gone Fishing

First time back as Lucia
Day Release, inside the mission only

Free switching
Chapter 2 (SVG: about 35% story completion)

Greyed-out portrait
The other lead is unavailable right now

In missions
Some fix the character, some force a swap, some let you choose

The controls
Hold Right on the D-pad. Two portraits appear in the bottom-right corner of the screen. With Right still held, tap R1 on PlayStation 5 or RB on Xbox Series X|S to move to the other lead. VGC, SVG and Insider Gaming all give Right on the D-pad as the input; Insider Gaming and GamesRadar add the shoulder button.
Tip: if you learned GTA 5's version, the direction has changed. GTA 5 used Down on the D-pad for its character wheel. In GTA 6, Up opens the phone and Right is the character prompt. The rest of the early controls are in our beginner's guide.
Why you cannot switch in Chapter 1
Lucia begins the story in prison. After the Prologue, which you play as her, the game hands you Jason in Key Lento and keeps you with him. Even after her release in Coming Home, the two live in the same house but the switch prompt does nothing useful: VGC explains that she is on parole, and the story is not ready to let her roam.
Why it matters: nothing is broken if the prompt does not respond in your first ten hours. It is the design. Rushing will not unlock it much sooner either; SVG's advice is not to race through the early missions just to get there.
Every time you play as Lucia before switching unlocks
Chapter 1 does give you Lucia, but only inside missions:

Mission
Who you control
Free roam as Lucia?

Prologue
Lucia
No

Gone Fishing to Down to Earth
Jason
No

Day Release
Jason, then Lucia for the yacht and club, then Jason
No

Clear Skies to Recalibration
Jason
No

Tourist Trap
Jason, then Lucia after he is wounded
No

Home Sweet Home
Lucia
No

Chapter 2
Lucia first, then both
Yes

Tip: Day Release is worth playing slowly. The choices you make as Lucia there, such as sharing a jet ski and dancing, are the first chances to raise the relationship from her side.
When free switching unlocks
Guides agree on the outline and differ on the exact moment:

VGC says your first open-world time as Lucia comes after Chapter 1 ends, and that swapping becomes available as you play through Chapter 2.
SVG is the most specific: a job goes wrong at about 30% of the story, you play as Lucia while Jason recovers, and free switching arrives at about 35% story completion during a run of robberies.
Insider Gaming estimates three to four hours of rushing, or ten to twelve at a normal pace, to reach the point where Lucia is out of prison and back with Jason. That is when both leads are on screen together, not when you can swap in free roam.

So plan on finishing Chapter 1 and the opening stretch of Chapter 2 before the D-pad prompt does what you expect.
The stretch where Jason is unavailable
The last three missions of Chapter 1, Tourist Trap, Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time, run back to back with no free roam. VGC's warning page says you cannot explore as both leads again for several hours of Chapter 2. PowerPyx goes further: you cannot play as Jason for a long time, pocket cash carried into Tourist Trap is lost, and the Key Lento house does not come back.
Why it matters: this is the one place where the two-character structure can cost you something. Anything you want to do as Jason in the Keys, do it before Tourist Trap. Our Recalibration walkthrough has the checklist.
Why the portrait is greyed out
Once switching is unlocked, a greyed-out portrait means the other lead cannot be selected right now. VGC and SVG both describe it. The usual reasons:

The story has them busy or elsewhere.
You are in a mission that fixes the character.
VGC reports a quirk: after you swap, the lead you left may call a RydeMe and leave the area, which can briefly grey out the menu.

Tip: if it is greyed out in free roam, wait a minute or finish what you are doing. If it stays that way, check for a story mission marker; the game usually wants you to play one first.
How switching works in missions
Rob Nelson, co-head of Rockstar North, described three kinds of mission in an interview with Famitsu that GamesRadar translated: missions where you are fixed to one character, missions where the game moves you to the other at a set moment, and missions where you can alternate freely. He said switching is sometimes limited by story progress because the studio wants certain sections seen from one character's point of view.
He gave examples. One early mission was changed during development so that Jason leads it. A getaway sequence moves you from Jason firing out of the car to Lucia driving. Other missions leave the choice to you.
Why it matters: if the prompt is missing mid-mission, there is nothing to fix. Tourist Trap is the clearest Chapter 1 case of a forced swap.
What the other character does
Two guides describe the companion side of the system. SVG says a successful swap puts you at the other lead's current position on the map straight away, and that you can ask the lead you are not controlling to meet you or to help, for example by drawing police attention or shooting from the passenger seat. Beebom's guide likewise describes calling the other lead over and giving them a job, such as driving while you ride along.
Time together also feeds the relationship. PowerPyx notes a "Jason & Lucia" menu that tracks it, and several cheats unlock from hours and activities with your partner.
How it compares with GTA 5

GTA 5
GTA 6

Leads
Three
Two

Switching available
Early in the story
Chapter 2

Input
Down on the D-pad, character wheel
Right on the D-pad, then R1 / RB

Relationship between leads
Separate lives
A couple, with a relationship menu

More differences are in GTA 6 vs GTA 5: new features.
What is not confirmed

Separate cash, weapons and wardrobes. None of the guides we checked says clearly how money, guns and clothes are split between the two leads. We will add it once two sources agree.
The exact unlock mission. "About 35%" comes from one guide. No second source names the mission yet.
Instant travel on swap. Only SVG states that you jump to the other lead's position immediately.
Switching at any wanted level. Not documented yet; see how the wanted level works.

What to do before the game locks you to Lucia

Finish the Key Lento side content you care about as Jason.
Move pocket cash into the bank. Buck Me explains how.
Make a manual save in a spare slot before Tourist Trap.
Play the three closing missions in one sitting if you can; there is no free roam between them.
In Chapter 2, keep following the story missions until the Right D-pad prompt shows two live portraits.

What this means for you
GTA 6 treats character switching as something the story earns, not a menu option. Expect to spend Chapter 1 as Jason, a few hours of Chapter 2 as Lucia, and the rest of the game with both. If you came for Lucia, she is worth the wait; if you prefer Jason, do his business before the end of Chapter 1.
What we will add to this page
We will add the name of the mission that unlocks free switching once two walkthroughs agree, how cash, weapons and outfits are shared, and whether swapping works with a wanted level. The mission table will grow as we publish Chapter 2 walkthroughs in the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: How do you switch characters in GTA 6?
A: Hold Right on the D-pad until the two portraits appear in the bottom-right corner, then tap R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox Series X|S. It only works once switching has unlocked in Chapter 2.

Q: When can you play as Lucia in GTA 6?
A: You play her in the Prologue, then in parts of Day Release, Tourist Trap and Home Sweet Home in Chapter 1. Free roam as Lucia, and switching at will, come in Chapter 2.

Q: Why can't I switch characters in GTA 6?
A: Either you are still in Chapter 1, you are in a mission that fixes the character, or the other lead's portrait is greyed out because they are busy. VGC notes they sometimes leave in a RydeMe after a swap.

# What Time Does GTA 6 Come Out? Launch and Pre-Load Times

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/what-time-does-gta-6-come-out/
Updated: 2026-11-20
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 unlocked at midnight local time on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and is out now.
- It was a rolling launch: New Zealand played first, and each region followed at its own midnight.
- Pre-loading opened on November 10; two updates and a PS5 system update must be installed before you play.

What time does GTA 6 come out? It came out at midnight local time on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and it is available now in every region. The launch covered PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S; there is no PC version. This page keeps the full timetable for reference: how the rolling midnight launch worked, when pre-loading opened, what happened on the night, and what to do before your first session if you are starting late.
How we checked: launch and pre-load times come from Rockstar and the platform holders, and the launch-night details are each reported by at least two outlets.
GTA 6 launch times at a glance

Event
When

New Zealand, midnight NZDT on November 19 (11:00 UTC on November 18)

Unlock everywhere else
Midnight local time, November 19

How the midnight launch worked
The game unlocked when the clock passed 12:00 a.m. on November 19 where you were. It was not one worldwide moment.

Region
When it unlocked

New Zealand
12:00 a.m. NZDT, November 19 (first in the world)

United States and Canada

Why it matters: a rolling launch meant that guides, streams and spoilers from New Zealand and Australia were online for most of a day before players in the Americas could start. If you are still avoiding spoilers, that head start is why they are everywhere.
The United States: one unlock or four?
Before launch, some reports said US store listings would unlock for the whole country at Eastern midnight, which is 11:00 p.m. Central and 9:00 p.m. Pacific on Wednesday, November 18. At least one launch-day guide describes the US unlock that way. Rockstar's own wording was simply midnight local time.
Tip: the question no longer matters for buying, since the game is live everywhere. It is worth remembering for future Rockstar releases: your own local midnight is the time you can rely on, and anything earlier is a bonus.
Pre-load times

Platform
Pre-load opened

PlayStation 5
November 10 at midnight local time

Xbox Series X|S
November 10 at 12:00 a.m. GMT, worldwide

Boxed copies
From November 12, after redeeming the code in the box

The download needs up to 212 GB of free space. See GTA 6 file size for the numbers, download times and how to make room.
What happened on launch night

The date held. After two delays, November 19 did not move; see how many times GTA 6 was delayed.
PlayStation Network sign-in errors. On November 18, as the first regions unlocked, PS5 owners reported a "services are busy" message when signing in, for a couple of hours. Sony did not give a cause. No similar Xbox outage was reported.
Two updates were already waiting. Version 01.002.000 arrived on November 13 and 01.002.001 on November 16. Rockstar published no notes for either.
A PS5 system update was required. PlayStation Support said on November 17 that the console's system software had to be updated before GTA 6 would start.
Reviews were already in. The embargo lifted on November 18, and the game opened at 99 on Metacritic; see GTA 6 reviews.

Why it matters: none of the launch-night problems were in the game itself. The one widespread issue was signing in on PlayStation, and it cleared within hours. The daily picture is in our GTA 6 news round-up.
Does it unlock at the same time on Xbox and PlayStation?
Yes for consoles: both followed local midnight. On Xbox, the unlock follows the store region of your Microsoft account. Xbox Cloud Gaming, which lets Xbox One owners stream the game, is listed for Xbox consoles only, not for PC or browsers. The supported hardware is set out in GTA 6 platforms.
Buying now: how long until you can play?
Now that the game is out, the wait is the download, not the clock.

Buy digitally or redeem the code from a boxed copy. The box has no disc; see GTA 6 physical copy.
Start the download: about 210 GB. On a 100 Mbps connection that is close to five hours at full speed.
Install the game updates when the download finishes.
On PS5, install the latest system software.
Sign in to the account that owns the game before you launch it.

Prices and what each edition includes are in GTA 6 price and editions.
Before your first session: a short checklist

Check that no update is waiting. On PS5, highlight the game, press Options and choose Check for Update.
Keep a few gigabytes free beyond the 212 GB.
Turn on automatic updates and leave the console in rest mode with internet access.
Pick your first manual save slot early. There are 15, and cheats or crashes are easier to live with when you have a recent save.

What is not confirmed

A PC release time. No PC version has been announced; see GTA 6 on PC.
An online mode launch. GTA 6 is single-player at launch and Rockstar has dated nothing; see GTA 6 online.
The first post-launch patch. No date has been given.

The map of Leonida

What we will add to this page
Release times for any future versions or major updates as Rockstar announces them: an online mode, a PC version, or story content.

Q: What time does GTA 6 come out?
A: It came out at 12:00 a.m. local time on November 19, 2026, on both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is available now in every region.

Q: Does GTA 6 unlock at the same moment worldwide?
A: No. It unlocked at midnight in each region, so New Zealand and Australia got it hours before Europe and the Americas.

Q: Can I pre-load GTA 6?
A: Pre-loading ran from November 10 until launch. Now that the game is out, buying it or redeeming a boxed code starts the full download straight away.

# Best Console for GTA 6: PS5, PS5 Pro or Xbox Series X|S?

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/best-console-for-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Every console version of GTA 6 targets 30 FPS, so no console plays it faster.
- The PS5 Pro is the only version with PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows.
- Xbox Series S is the cheapest native option; Xbox Cloud Gaming streams it at Series S settings.

The best console for GTA 6 is the PS5 Pro if you want the sharpest picture, but it is not faster: every console targets 30 FPS. Rockstar confirmed the console differences shortly before launch, and they are smaller than many players expected. This guide compares all four versions, explains what each extra actually does, and tells you which one to pick for your budget and the console you already own.
Every fact here is confirmed by Rockstar, Sony or Microsoft, or reported by at least two independent outlets. Anything rumoured is listed separately at the end.
Best console for GTA 6 at a glance

PS5
PS5 Pro
Xbox Series X
Xbox Series S

Native launch version

Xbox owners

Rockstar has not published a resolution for any console, so the table leaves resolution out on purpose.
1. The frame rate is the same everywhere
Rockstar's target for every current console is 30 frames per second. There is no performance mode and no 60 FPS option at launch, and that includes the PS5 Pro. The Extended Look gameplay video in August was captured on a standard PS5, and outlets that watched it noted that it appeared to hold 30 FPS for most of the footage.
Why it matters: the most common reason to buy a more powerful console, a higher frame rate, does not apply to GTA 6 right now. You are choosing image quality, controller features and price, not smoothness. Full details: GTA 6 frame rate on every console.
2. PS5 Pro: the sharpest version
The PS5 Pro is the only console with two confirmed extras: PSSR (PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution), Sony's machine-learning upscaler, and ray-traced shadows that Rockstar lists as exclusive to the Pro. Rockstar describes the result as higher image clarity.
Why it matters: on a large 4K TV, upscaling quality is where you notice the difference, especially in fine detail like palm fronds, power lines and distant traffic. On a small screen or a 1080p TV, the gap shrinks.
Tip: if you already own a standard PS5, the Pro is an upgrade for picture quality only. Do not buy it expecting GTA 6 to feel faster.
3. Standard PS5: best value for most players
The base PS5 gets the same 30 FPS target as the Pro, plus the PlayStation-specific features: DualSense haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, sounds such as police radio and phone calls played through the controller speaker, and Tempest 3D Audio. Rockstar also mentions shorter loading times on PS5. According to GIGA's report on Rockstar's announcement, Rockstar said the game plays best on PlayStation 5.
Why it matters: these are the only confirmed gameplay-feel differences between the PlayStation and Xbox versions. If you are buying a console just for GTA 6, the standard PS5 gets you every confirmed feature except the Pro's image upgrades.
Tip: the haptics can be adjusted in the accessibility settings if they feel too strong in long driving sessions. More on the pad: GTA 6 controller guide.
4. Xbox Series X: the best native Xbox version
The Series X installs and runs GTA 6 locally with the same 30 FPS target. Microsoft calls it the best native Xbox experience for the game. Rockstar has not published Xbox-specific resolution, ray tracing or visual settings, and analysts expect the standard PS5 and Series X to perform very similarly.
Why it matters: if your friends, your saved games and your digital library are on Xbox, there is no confirmed reason to switch. The confirmed PlayStation extras are about the controller and audio, not the frame rate.
Tip: check where your friends will play before you buy. Crossplay depends on GTA Online, which arrives later: GTA 6 crossplay.
5. Xbox Series S: the cheapest way to play natively
The Series S is a full launch platform with the same 30 FPS target. Microsoft positions it as the most affordable way to play GTA 6 natively on Xbox. Rockstar has not published its internal resolution or which visual effects are reduced, but it is the least powerful of the four consoles, so expect a softer picture.
Why it matters: storage is the real problem. The download is about 210 GB, and the 512 GB Series S has roughly 364 GB usable, so GTA 6 alone takes more than half of it.
Tip: if you have a 512 GB Series S, plan to uninstall other games or add an expansion card before launch day. See GTA 6 file size for the numbers on each console.
6. Xbox Cloud Gaming and Xbox One
There is no native Xbox One version. Microsoft says GTA 6 can be streamed through Xbox Cloud Gaming, including on Xbox One, and that the stream uses Series S graphics settings. Picture quality and input delay depend on your internet connection.
Why it matters: cloud play is a way in if you do not own a current console, but it will not match a local install. A wired connection or a strong 5 GHz Wi-Fi signal makes a big difference.
Tip: check the cloud gaming requirements on your Xbox account before you rely on it, since availability and plans can change. The full platform list is in GTA 6 platforms.
7. Storage on every console
Rockstar says to plan for up to 212 GB of free space, and boxed copies still need the large download. A standard PS5 or Series X has room, but a nearly full drive will not.
Why it matters: running out of space on launch night is one of the most common problems. Clear space before the pre-load, not after.
Tip: a disc does not save space. More in GTA 6 physical copy.
8. Watch the launch trailer
The official launch trailer shows the look Rockstar is aiming for on current consoles. It is a short mood piece rather than a gameplay demo, so treat it as a guide to the style, not as a test of any one console.
Why it matters: if the trailer's image looks good on your TV, the standard version will too. The Pro's extras sharpen the same picture rather than change it.
9. What about PC?
Rockstar has not announced a PC version or date. If you only play on PC, you will need a console or Xbox Cloud Gaming to play at launch. We track every update in GTA 6 on PC.
What is not confirmed
These claims circulate widely, but Rockstar has not confirmed them:

A 40 FPS or 120 Hz mode on PS5 Pro. This comes from dataminers, not Rockstar.
Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos on Xbox. Based on a photo of a physical Xbox case, not an official feature list.
Quick Resume, VRR, FSR or Auto HDR support. Named in rumours and community discussions only.
Resolution for any console. No official figures yet.

We will move any of these into the comparison table once Rockstar or two reliable outlets confirm them with the released game.
Which console should you buy? A quick checklist

You already own a PS5 or Series X: keep it. Both get the same frame rate target and the full game.
You own a Series S: it works. Free up storage and accept a softer picture.
You are buying new and want the best image: the PS5 Pro, ideally with a 4K TV.
You are buying new on a budget: the standard PS5 gets every confirmed feature except the Pro's image upgrades.
You prefer Xbox or your friends are there: the Series X.
You own only an Xbox One or a PC: try Xbox Cloud Gaming first, and check your connection.

Before you buy, compare the editions too: GTA 6 price and editions.
Verdict: what this means for you
The best console for GTA 6 depends less on raw power than usual. With a 30 FPS target everywhere, the PS5 Pro wins on image quality, the standard PS5 wins on value and controller features, and the Series X is the natural choice for anyone already on Xbox. The Series S runs the full game but needs careful storage planning. If you already own one of these consoles, the best console for GTA 6 is probably the one under your TV.
What we will add to this page

Resolution figures for each console, once Rockstar or testers publish them.
Any performance mode added in a patch.
Side-by-side image comparisons from the released game, in our own words.
PC news the moment Rockstar announces a version.

Q: What is the best console for GTA 6?
A: The PS5 Pro, if you want the best image. Rockstar confirmed PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows only for it. The frame rate target is still 30 FPS, the same as on every other console.

Q: Is GTA 6 better on PS5 or Xbox Series X?
A: Rockstar has not published a performance comparison. Both target 30 FPS. The PS5 adds DualSense haptics, adaptive triggers and Tempest 3D Audio; Rockstar has said the game plays best on PlayStation 5.

Q: Can the Xbox Series S run GTA 6?
A: Yes. It is a native launch platform with the same 30 FPS target. Rockstar has not published its resolution, and the roughly 210 GB download takes most of the 512 GB model's usable space.

# GTA 6 100% Completion: Full Checklist and Reward

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-100-completion/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- The 100% checklist has 35 requirements in three groups: Story & Tasks, Exploration & Activities, and Discovery.
- Many requirements are lower than the full total, for example 300 of 397 stunts and 100 of 255 animals.
- Nothing is missable, and the reward is the gold trophy A Long Road (100G on Xbox).

GTA 6 100 completion means finishing the story and 34 other requirements on an in-game checklist. The checklist has 35 lines in three groups. Most lines ask for less than the full total, so you can skip the stunts, races or collectibles you like least. The game only shows the checklist after the story ends.
What counts for 100% in GTA 6
Only the 35 lines below count. The "Needed" column is the target. The "Total" column is how many exist in the game, where guides give it.

What you must do in full
Eleven lines have no slack. You need every one of these:

39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs and 8 Vaults.
33 Underwater Discoveries.
42 Shooting Range gold medals and 42 Drone Time Trials.
2 Unique Playlists, 4 Video Games and 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
The main story.

Everything else leaves room. You can skip 97 stunts, 10 challenges, 10 races, 77 base model vehicles and 155 animals.
Can you miss anything?
No. Two guides state that nothing is missable for 100% and that every line can be finished in free roam after the story. A few things to know:

Some Optional Tasks can be missed during story missions. It does not matter, because there are enough others to reach 100.
Kenton is not available for a while after Chapter 1. He returns later.
The video games on the TV cannot be played during part of Chapter 2.
Bret's hunting tasks are for Jason only.
A Gang Operation that you did not clear fully comes back, but it takes a long time.

GTA 6 100% checklist reward
The reward is A Long Road, a gold trophy on PS5 and a 100G achievement on Xbox. It is the largest achievement in the game and is needed for the platinum. Guides do not agree on any other reward, so we do not list one.
The checklist also covers most other trophies on the way. It asks for 300 stunts where the stunt trophy needs 250, and 70 challenges where the challenge trophy needs 50. One exception: the meditation trophy needs all 18 spots, while the checklist needs 15. The full list is in our GTA 6 trophy guide.
A sensible order

Play the story and do optional tasks, robberies and stranger missions as you meet them.
Scan vehicles and study animals from the start. These two lines take the longest.
After the credits, open the checklist and see what is left.
Finish the full-count lines first, then pick the easiest of the rest.

Q: What do you need for GTA 6 100 completion?
A: Finish the story and meet 34 other requirements: robberies, fenced goods, collectibles, races, shooting ranges, stunts, challenges, and scanning vehicles, weapons and animals.

Q: What counts for 100% in GTA 6?
A: Only the 35 lines on the in-game checklist. Most have a target below the full total, so you do not need every collectible, every stunt or every animal.

Q: What is the reward for 100% in GTA 6?
A: The gold trophy A Long Road, worth 100G on Xbox. It is also needed for the platinum.

Q: Can you miss anything for 100% in GTA 6?
A: No. Guides agree that every requirement can be finished in free roam after the story.

# GTA 6 Age Rating: ESRB M, PEGI 18 and What It Means

URL: https://gta6box.com/buying/gta-6-age-rating/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 is rated M (Mature 17+) by the ESRB in North America.
- It is rated PEGI 18 in Europe and the UK, and R18 in Australia and New Zealand.
- The ESRB lists seven content descriptors, plus in-game purchases.

GTA 6 is rated for adults everywhere it is sold: M for Mature 17+ in North America and 18 in Europe, the UK, Australia and New Zealand.
GTA 6 age ratings by region

Region
Rating

United States and Canada (ESRB)
M, Mature 17+

Europe and the UK (PEGI)
18

Australia
R18+

New Zealand
R18

ESRB content descriptors
The ESRB lists seven descriptors for Grand Theft Auto VI:

Blood and Gore
Intense Violence
Mature Humor
Nudity
Strong Language
Strong Sexual Content
Use of Drugs and Alcohol

It also carries an In-Game Purchases notice.
What parents should know

The rating describes the kind of content in the game, not how often it appears.
The story is about career criminals. Violence, drugs and sexual content are part of it and cannot be switched off.
PlayStation and Xbox parental controls can block games above a chosen rating and require approval for purchases.
The game launches as a single-player experience, so there is no online chat with strangers at launch. See GTA 6 online.

Is it stricter than GTA 5?
The age categories are the same as GTA 5's. The labels in Australia and New Zealand name sex scenes specifically, which GTA 5's did not.

Q: How old do you have to be to play GTA 6?
A: It is rated for adults: 17 and over in North America (ESRB M) and 18 and over in Europe, the UK, Australia and New Zealand.

Q: What is GTA 6 rated?
A: ESRB M for Mature 17+, PEGI 18, and R18 in Australia and New Zealand.

Q: Can a parent buy GTA 6 for a child?
A: Ratings restrict sales to minors in many places but do not stop a parent buying it. Console parental controls can block games by rating.

# GTA 6 Animals: Wildlife Confirmed in Leonida

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-animals/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Rockstar says GTA 6 has more than 170 animal species.
- That includes over 60 birds and more than 30 land mammals.
- Alligators, flamingos, pelicans and manatees appear in a Rockstar game for the first time.

GTA 6 has more than 170 animal species, the most in any Grand Theft Auto. Rockstar shared the number in a Game Informer cover story in September 2026: over 60 birds, more than 30 land mammals, plus fish, reptiles and marine life.
Animals confirmed in official footage and previews

Group
Species seen

Reptiles
Alligators, green iguanas, sea turtles

Land mammals
Deer, wild boar, bobcats, big cats, dogs

Marine life
Sharks, dolphins, manatees

Wetland birds
Flamingos, pelicans, spoonbills, cranes, storks, ducks

Other birds
Eagles, woodpeckers, pigeons, seagulls

Alligators, flamingos, pelicans and manatees are new to Rockstar's games.
Where to look

Grassrivers: the swamp region is alligator and wading-bird country.
Leonida Keys and the coast: pelicans, gulls, dolphins and sharks.
Mount Kalaga National Park: deer and forest predators.
Vice City: pigeons, gulls, pets, and the occasional alligator where it should not be.

See the GTA 6 map guide for the regions.
What is not confirmed

A full official species list. Rockstar has given the total, not the names.
Hunting, selling or collecting animals.
How dangerous predators are to the player.

We will build a species-by-species list with locations from the game.

Q: How many animals are in GTA 6?
A: More than 170 species, according to details Rockstar gave to Game Informer in September 2026.

Q: Are there alligators in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Alligators appear in official trailers, in swamps and in town.

Q: Can you hunt in GTA 6?
A: Hunting has not been confirmed. We will update this page once it is checked in the game.

# How to Play GTA 6: Beginner's Guide to Your First Hours

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-beginners-guide/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Save from the pause menu under Game, then Save Game; there are 15 manual slots.
- Switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks in Chapter 2: hold Right on the D-pad and press R1/RB.
- Cash you carry is lost when you are wasted or busted, so bank it once the BuckMe account opens.

To learn how to play GTA 6, start with five basics: the new controls, the phone, saving by hand, the hold L2/LT interaction and keeping your cash safe. These GTA 6 tips come from launch guides that agree with each other. Anything only one guide reports has been left out.
Key controls at a glance
The default layout differs from GTA 5. Running is on a click of the left stick, and Cross/A is jump and climb.

Action
PS5
Xbox Series X/S

Run
L3 (click left stick)
LS (click left stick)

Jump or climb
Cross
A

Aim, or talk to a person (hold)
L2
LT

Holster weapon
L1
LB

Open the phone
D-pad Up
D-pad Up

Quick navigation (hold)
D-pad Down
D-pad Down

Switch character (from Chapter 2)
Hold D-pad Right + R1
Hold D-pad Right + RB

Map
Touch pad
View button

If you prefer the old layout, Push Square notes that the Control Scheme setting can be changed from Default to Classic.
How to talk to people
GTA 6 lets you speak to almost anyone on the street. The game teaches this in the Prologue.

Put your weapon away with L1/LB. With a gun out, L2/LT aims instead.
Walk up to the person and face them.
Hold L2/LT to focus on them.
Pick a response. The usual set is Greet, Provoke, Taunt and Defuse. Some characters offer their own options.

Greet is the safe choice with strangers. Defuse calms someone who is squaring up to you. Provoke and Taunt can start a fight, and a fight can bring police.
The phone
Press Up on the D-pad to open the phone. These are the apps you will use most early on:

BuckMe. Your bank. Its ATM Finder points you to the nearest ATM.
RydeMe. A ride service that works as fast travel.
Reminders. Important messages and contacts waiting for a reply.

How to save in GTA 6
Do not rely on the game to save for you.

Open the pause menu.
Go to Game.
Pick a slot and choose Save Game.

There are 15 manual save slots, and you load from the same menu. PC Gamer suggests keeping one save from the start of each chapter, which is a sensible habit in a long story.
One warning: an active cheat disables saving until you quit and reload.
How to switch characters in GTA 6
You cannot switch at the start. In Chapter 1 you play as Jason in the open world, and Lucia is playable only in certain story missions. Free switching unlocks in Chapter 2.
Once it is open, hold Right on the D-pad and press R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox.
A few rules apply:

A greyed-out portrait means the other character is busy. Try again a little later.
Some missions belong to one character. The mission's map icon shows who it is for.

Read more about the two leads on our GTA 6 characters page.
Keep your cash safe
Cash in your pocket is lost when you are wasted or busted. Early on you have no bank account, so do not carry more than you can afford to lose.
The account opens during the Chapter 1 story mission "Buck Me". After that, deposit at an ATM before every risky job. For ways to earn, see how to make money in GTA 6.
Getting around

Find the next mission. Open the map and use its index to list story missions, then set a waypoint.
Quick waypoints. Hold Down on the D-pad for a short list of nearby places.
Fast travel. Book a RydeMe from the phone. It needs the bank account, so it is not available in the very first missions. You can sit through the drive or pay an extra $100 to skip it.
Keep a car. Pay 'n' Spray locations let you store vehicles you want to keep and sell the ones you do not.

Wanted level basics
GTA 6 has six wanted stars, and police also track what they know about you: your face, your clothes and your vehicle. Getting out of sight is only half the job. Change your car and your outfit as well. The full system is explained in our GTA 6 wanted level guide.
What to do first

Play the story until the bank account opens, then deposit your cash.
Make a manual save at the end of each session.
Practise the hold L2/LT interaction on people in the street.
Use the map index to learn where shops, ATMs and Pay 'n' Spray locations are.
Push on into Chapter 2 to unlock character switching and the first steady income.

Q: How to play GTA 6 as a beginner?
A: Follow the story until the bank account and the phone apps open up, save by hand often, deposit your cash at ATMs and learn the hold L2/LT interaction, which is how you talk to people.

Q: How to save in GTA 6?
A: Open the pause menu, go to Game and choose Save Game. There are 15 manual save slots. Saving is disabled while a cheat is active.

Q: How to switch characters in GTA 6?
A: Hold Right on the D-pad and press R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox. This works only from Chapter 2, and only when the other character is not greyed out.

Q: Is there fast travel in GTA 6?
A: Yes. The RydeMe app on your phone books a ride to a destination, and you can pay an extra $100 to skip the journey.

---

# GTA 6 Challenges: All 8 Categories and Their Rewards

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-challenges/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has 80 challenges: 10 each in combat, criminal, exploration, fitness, shopping, sports, survival and vehicle.
- 50 challenges earn the One Last Thing trophy and 70 of 80 count toward 100% completion.
- Finishing 5 or all challenges in a category is the reported unlock task for a vehicle spawn cheat.

GTA 6 challenges are 80 optional goals split into eight categories of 10. They are separate from story missions. They count toward a trophy and 100% completion, and each category is tied to vehicle spawn cheats. The cheat unlocks come from launch guides, not from Rockstar, so this page is marked partly confirmed.
The eight challenge categories

That makes 80 in total. We do not list all 80 individual challenges here yet, because only one full list has been published and we wait for a second source to confirm the exact targets.
Where to track GTA 6 challenges

Open the menu (Touch Pad on PS5).
Go to Progress.
Open Challenges.

The 100% checklist itself sits under Progress &gt; Stats &gt; 100% Completion and appears only after you finish the story.

For 100% you can leave out 10 challenges. If you want every cheat, you cannot skip any.
GTA 6 challenge rewards
Each category has two reported cheat unlocks: one for completing 5 challenges and one for completing all 10. Completing every challenge in the game is the unlock task for a jet.

These are spawn cheats, not vehicles delivered to a garage. Cheats only work after the main story, and an active cheat turns off saving and trophies. Codes and entry steps are on GTA 6 cheats.
Tips

Check Progress &gt; Challenges early. Many challenges are things you do anyway during the story and free roam.
Aim for 5 in every category first. That is 40 challenges and eight vehicle cheats.
The tank needs all 10 survival challenges, and the jet needs all 80, so those two take the longest.
Some exploration challenges overlap with GTA 6 collectibles, so do them together.
Police-related criminal challenges are easier once you know how heat works: see GTA 6 wanted level.

Q: How many challenges are in GTA 6?
A: 80. There are eight categories with 10 challenges each: combat, criminal, exploration, fitness, shopping, sports, survival and vehicle.

Q: What are the GTA 6 challenge rewards?
A: Each category is tied to two vehicle spawn cheats, one for 5 challenges and one for all 10. All 80 are the reported unlock task for the Hauners P-996 LAZER jet cheat. 50 challenges also earn the One Last Thing trophy.

Q: Do you need all GTA 6 challenges for 100% completion?
A: No. The 100% checklist asks for 70 of the 80, so you can skip the 10 you find hardest.

Q: Where do you track challenges in GTA 6?
A: In the menu under Progress > Challenges.

Status: partly

- GTA 6 has 18 collectible card sets with 480 cards, 125 cocaine flamingos and 34 luxury watches, plus WAiNK scans, underwater discoveries and meditation spots.
- You do not need everything for 100%: for example 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 flamingos and 100 WAiNK scans are enough.
- Several collectibles unlock cheats, including the Inflatable Flamingo and the two time-of-day cheats from watches.

GTA 6 collectibles come in more than a dozen types, led by 480 collectible cards, 125 cocaine flamingos and 34 luxury watches. This hub lists every type, how many there are, what each one unlocks and where to check your progress. It does not list individual locations. Counts are given only where at least two launch guides agree; those guides are still being filled in, so this page is marked partly confirmed.

GTA 6 collectible cards
There are 18 sets and 480 cards. Sets have between 12 and 36 cards each.

What to know:

Cards lie around the world, indoors and outdoors. Outdoors they are often in yellow boxes.
Colour variants of a card count as separate cards for the set.
You can sell cards at pawn shops. A sold card still counts toward its set.
3 complete sets earn the Don't Touch My Deck trophy. 15 complete sets are needed for 100%.
All 24 Vice City Flamingos cards are the reported unlock task for the Bubblegum screen filter cheat.

GTA 6 cocaine flamingos
Cocaine flamingos are pink flamingo figures with a drug package inside. There are 125. You destroy them; you do not pick them up.

The ones that count have a black and white beak. Ordinary lawn flamingos do not count.
50 destroyed is the reported unlock task for the Inflatable Flamingo spawn cheat.
100 destroyed counts toward 100% completion. No trophy is tied to them.

GTA 6 watches and other styles
The Styles category has 79 entries: magazine styles for Jason, magazine styles for Lucia, magazine tattoos and 34 luxury watches. You need 70 of the 79 for 100%.
Watches matter for cheats. Finding 10 collectible watches is the reported unlock task for Move Time Forward, and 20 for Pause Time of Day.
WAiNK scans
WAiNK is the phone scan app. Guides agree on 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures. No Flusher tags, which are spray-paint markings on the ground, also count, but guides do not agree on how many there are. 100 scans earn the You WAiNKer! trophy and tick the 100% requirement.
One cheat, the Powdered Sugar filter, is reported to need all space debris scanned with WAiNK. Launch guides have not yet listed how many pieces there are.
What collectibles unlock

Task
Unlock

Destroy 50 cocaine flamingos
Inflatable Flamingo cheat

Find 10 collectible watches
Move Time Forward cheat

Find 20 collectible watches
Pause Time of Day cheat

Find all 24 Vice City Flamingos cards

Powdered Sugar filter cheat

Discover all 16 Girlypop vehicles
Neon Jungle filter cheat

Earn $250,000 selling collectibles
Pixel Art filter cheat

Complete 3 card sets
Don't Touch My Deck trophy

Scan 100 WAiNK locations
You WAiNKer! trophy

Meditate at all 18 spots
Positive Mental Attitude trophy

Cheats only work after the story, and codes for most of these are not published yet. The full list is on GTA 6 cheats.
Where to see your progress
Open the menu (Touch Pad on PS5) and go to Progress.

Progress &gt; Collections holds collectible cards, WAiNK locations, styles and an Exploration group with underwater discoveries, magazines, meditations and flamingos.
Some sub-categories only show up after you find the first item of that type.
Progress &gt; Stats &gt; 100% Completion shows the full checklist. It appears only after you finish the story.

Tips

Do not chase full sets of everything. The 100% checklist leaves spare items in most categories.
Sell duplicate and finished cards at pawn shops. It costs you no progress and feeds the Pixel Art unlock.
Check the beak before you spend ammo on a flamingo.
Collectibles pair well with GTA 6 challenges: several exploration challenges are about cards, scans and underwater finds.

Q: How many collectibles are in GTA 6?
A: There is no single official number. The main collectible types that launch guides agree on are 480 collectible cards in 18 sets, 125 cocaine flamingos, 79 styles (34 of them luxury watches), 33 underwater discoveries, 18 meditation spots and at least 89 WAiNK scan locations.

Q: Do you need all GTA 6 collectibles for 100% completion?
A: No. The 100% checklist asks for part of most types: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, 100 WAiNK locations, 70 of 79 styles and 15 of 18 meditation spots. All 33 underwater discoveries are needed.

Q: What do cocaine flamingos unlock in GTA 6?
A: Destroying 50 cocaine flamingos is the reported unlock task for the Inflatable Flamingo spawn cheat. Destroying 100 of the 125 counts toward 100% completion.

Q: Can you sell collectible cards in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Cards can be sold at pawn shops, and guides agree that a sold card still counts toward its set.

# GTA 6 Gear Up Walkthrough: Mission 3 Step by Step

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-gear-up-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- Gear Up is the third mission in GTA 6 and the second one you play as Jason.
- You go to the Ammu-Nation near Jason's house and choose a long gun.
- The mission is short and cannot be failed in a way that blocks the story.

This GTA 6 Gear Up walkthrough covers the third mission of the game, where Jason buys his first long gun. PowerPyx also lists it under the task name "Pick Up Another Gun". It opens after Gone Fishing and takes only a few minutes.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Gear Up (mission 3, Chapter 1)

Also listed as
Pick Up Another Gun

Playable character
Jason

Starts at
The Ammu-Nation near Jason's house in Key Lento

Requirement
Finish Gone Fishing

Reward
The long gun you choose

Next mission
Lab Fees

VGC's guide says to collect the cash from the mailbox outside Jason's house before you leave, and that mission pay arrives in that mailbox. The other guides do not mention this, but it costs nothing to check the mailbox on the way out.
Objectives

Go to Ammu-Nation.
Approach Andrew and buy a long gun.
Deal with the Kingfishers outside.

Step-by-step
1. Go to Ammu-Nation
Take the car parked outside Jason's house and drive to the Ammu-Nation marked on the map. It is close by.
2. Buy a long gun from Andrew
Go into the store and talk to Andrew, the clerk. He offers a choice of long guns. PowerPyx and GTABase list two: a shotgun and a tactical rifle. Both say you will most likely only have enough money for the shotgun at this point. Guides do not give the prices.
VGC says the choice does not matter for the mission, so take whichever you can afford. For the full list of guns, see GTA 6 weapons.
3. Leave the store
When you walk out, three Kingfishers pull up in a truck and come for Jason. The guides suggest different ways to handle it:

Source
Advice

PowerPyx, GTABase
The Kingfishers open fire. Shoot back. Once they are down, a phone call ends the mission.

VGC
Fight them with your fists. Shooting brings the police, and they react much more slowly to a fist fight.

Both ways work. If you use the gun, expect a wanted level and be ready to leave the area.
4. The phone call
After the fight there is a phone call. VGC describes it as Jason calling Donnie to warn him that the Kingfishers are looking for him. The call ends the mission.
Where players fail

Not having enough cash. If you can only afford one gun, that is expected. Take the shotgun.
Walking out unprepared. The ambush starts as soon as you leave the store. Have a weapon ready or be ready to fight.
Worrying about dying. PowerPyx and GTABase report that if Jason dies here, he wakes up at his house and the mission ends anyway, with no lasting effect.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Reward
The long gun you picked at Ammu-Nation

Optional goals
None listed in any guide

Medals
None. PowerPyx reports that GTA 6 has no mission medals and no mission replay.

After Gear Up the map opens up. VGC notes that you can explore, collect Brian's rent or visit Coastal Auto. In story order the next mission is Lab Fees. See the GTA 6 mission list for everything that follows.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 Gear Up walkthrough for the gun choice?
A: Yes. Talk to Andrew at Ammu-Nation and pick a long gun. Guides list a shotgun and a tactical rifle, and say you can probably only afford the shotgun this early. The choice does not change the mission.

Q: What is the third mission in GTA 6?
A: Gear Up, also listed as Pick Up Another Gun. It follows Gone Fishing and comes before Lab Fees.

Q: Can you fail Gear Up?
A: Not in a way that matters. PowerPyx and GTABase report that if Jason dies in the ambush he wakes up at his house and the mission still counts as done.

Q: What comes after Gear Up in GTA 6?
A: Lab Fees, where Jason collects rent for Brian.

# GTA 6 Gone Fishing Walkthrough: Mission 2 Step by Step

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-gone-fishing-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- Gone Fishing is the second mission and the first one you play as Jason.
- It teaches boats, binoculars, stealth takedowns, fist fights, healing and flying.
- An optional stash of cash in a trailer can be missed during the escape.

This GTA 6 Gone Fishing walkthrough covers the second mission of the game, the first one you play as Jason. It starts right after the Prologue and is a long tutorial: a boat, binoculars, stealth, a fist fight, a shootout and a seaplane.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Gone Fishing (mission 2, Chapter 1)

Playable character
Jason

Mission giver
Cal

Starts
On a boat with Cal, straight after the Prologue

Requirement
Finish the Prologue

Missable
Cash in a trailer during the escape

Next mission
Gear Up

There is nothing to prepare. The mission starts automatically and gives you everything you need.
Objectives
Guides word these slightly differently. The order is the same:

Follow the plane and collect the packages.
Watch the deal in the swamp.
Search the camp for Donnie.
Find a way into the shack and untie Donnie.
Head to the plane.
Fly back to Brian's Marina.

Step-by-step
1. Follow the plane and collect the packages
Jason and Cal wait on a boat. Donnie, the pilot, flies over and drops packages into the sea. Drive the boat after the plane. The packages are marked on the map. Slow down next to each one, or Cal cannot hook it out of the water.
2. Watch the deal
After the last package, follow the route on the minimap into the swamps. When the game asks, take out the binoculars: open the weapon wheel with L1/LB and pick them from the bottom-right slot. Watch the meeting on the docks. It goes wrong, and the Kingfishers gang takes Donnie.
3. Search the camp for Donnie
Bring the boat to the docks near the camp. Jason goes in alone.

Crouch with Circle/B.
Come up behind a guard and grab him with R2/RT.
Press Square/X to knock him out.
Work your way to the far end of the camp. Donnie is held in a shack there.

VGC suggests using the tall grass on the right side of the camp for cover. Going in loud is possible, but you have only one weapon at this point, so stealth is the easier way.
4. Get into the shack and untie Donnie
Wait for the guard near the shack to move, then go in through the front door and untie Donnie. A large Kingfisher walks in and you have to fight him with your fists. Press Square/X to hit. The X/A button is your defence: PowerPyx calls it a block, VGC calls it a dodge.
He drops Zombix, the game's healing item. Pick it up, then equip a gun.
5. Head to the plane
The camp is now alert, and you fight your way to the dock. You do not have to beat every enemy. Reaching the plane is enough.
On the way there is a trailer with cash inside. Getting it is optional. VGC warns that an enemy jumps out when you go in, so be ready.
6. Fly back to Brian's Marina
Get in the seaplane and fly to the marker. Land on the water and bring the plane in to the marina. A cutscene introduces Brian, Jason's boss.
The guides that cover the ending (VGC and GTABase) agree that Jason then goes back to his house in the Keys and gets a phone call from Lucia. VGC adds that you drop Cal at his home first. That call ends the mission.
Where players fail

Going too fast past the packages. Cal needs the boat almost stopped beside each one.
Standing up in the camp. Stay crouched and always approach guards from behind.
Skipping the Zombix. Pick it up after the fist fight. You will want the healing during the run to the plane.
Fighting everyone on the dock. The goal is the plane, not a clean sweep.

Optional goals and rewards

Item
Details

Trailer cash
Optional and missable. In a trailer near the route to the plane. Guides do not give the amount.

Unlock
PowerPyx lists Jason's house in Key Lento as the reward. GTABase shows one unlock without naming it.

Medals
None. PowerPyx reports that GTA 6 has no mission medals and no mission replay.

PowerPyx and GTABase also describe a reputation system that starts here: quiet takedowns and non-lethal play push Jason one way, and killing pushes him another. We will cover it in a separate guide once the details are tested.
Next up is the Gear Up walkthrough. For the whole story in order, see the GTA 6 mission list.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 Gone Fishing walkthrough for the stealth part?
A: Yes. Crouch with Circle/B, come up behind each guard, grab with R2/RT and press Square/X to knock them out. Work towards the shack at the far end of the camp.

Q: Which mission comes after the Prologue in GTA 6?
A: Gone Fishing. It is the second mission overall and the first mission of Chapter 1.

Q: Can you miss anything in Gone Fishing?
A: Yes, one thing. During the escape there is cash in a trailer near the route to the plane. It is optional and guides mark it as missable.

Q: What comes after Gone Fishing?
A: Gear Up, where Jason buys a long gun at Ammu-Nation.

# GTA 6 Map vs GTA 5: How Big Is Leonida?

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-map-size/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Rockstar developers say the GTA 6 map is about twice the size of the GTA 5 map.
- They also say it is about three times the size of the Red Dead Redemption 2 map.
- Rockstar has not published the map size in square miles or square kilometres.

GTA 6 map vs GTA 5: Leonida is about twice the size of the GTA 5 map, according to Rockstar's own developers. Rockstar has not published an area in square miles or square kilometres, so every exact number you see online is an estimate. This page lists what Rockstar has actually said and what is still unmeasured.
GTA 6 map vs GTA 5 at a glance
All of these comparisons come from Rockstar staff in interviews before launch. None of them is an official measurement.

Comparison
What Rockstar said
Where it was said

GTA 6 map vs GTA 5 map
About twice the size
Rob Nelson, head of development, to YouTuber TGG; repeated in Edge magazine's cover story

GTA 6 map vs Red Dead Redemption 2 map
About three times the size
Rob Nelson to TGG

GTA 6 landmass vs GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 together
Nearly the same as all three combined
Edge magazine cover story

Vice City vs Los Santos
About twice the size
Rob Nelson to TGG

Vice City with suburbs vs Los Santos with suburbs
About eleven times larger
Rob Nelson to TGG

The TGG comparisons were reported by VGC in August 2026. The Edge comparison was reported by Forbes and others in October 2026.
How big is the GTA 6 map in square miles?
Nobody outside Rockstar can say yet. Rockstar has given ratios, not an area.
Sites that print a figure are doing their own sums. They take a number for GTA 5 and multiply it. The trouble is that published sizes for the GTA 5 map already disagree, depending on whether the sea is counted and how the land was measured. That is why estimates for Leonida range from about 125 square kilometres to more than 300. We do not print any of them as fact.
On launch day we found no measurement taken inside the released game that two reputable sources agree on. When careful in-game measurements appear, we will add them here with the method used.
What "twice the size" means in practice

Los Santos and Blaine County fit inside Leonida twice. GTA 5 had one city and one large rural county. GTA 6 has Vice City plus five more named regions.
The city is the big change. Vice City alone is about twice the size of Los Santos. With its suburbs it is about eleven times the size of Los Santos and its surroundings, by Rockstar's count.
The streets are tighter. Rockstar North co-studio head Aaron Garbut said the roads in GTA 6 are significantly narrower than in GTA 5, as reported by Bloomberg's Jason Schreier. Narrower roads leave room for more buildings, so the city is denser as well as larger.
There are more interiors. Garbut told Edge that GTA 6 has far more interiors than any earlier Rockstar game.

GTA 6 vs GTA 5: the worlds compared

GTA 5
GTA 6

Setting
San Andreas, based on Southern California
Leonida, based on Florida

Main city
Los Santos
Vice City

Countryside
Blaine County
Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park

Overall size
Baseline
About twice GTA 5

Official area figure
None from Rockstar
None from Rockstar

For what each region is, see the GTA 6 map and all confirmed regions. The city has its own page: Vice City.
Is bigger the whole story?
No. Size says little about how long the game is or how much there is to do. For that, see how long GTA 6 takes to beat. Smaller towns such as Port Gellhorn show how the space outside Vice City is used.
What is not confirmed

An exact area. No official figure in square miles or square kilometres.
Land versus water. Rockstar has not said how its comparisons treat the sea, swamps and islands.
Drive or flight times across the map. Early numbers from players vary with vehicle and route, and we have not found two reliable tests that match.

Q: How big is the GTA 6 map vs GTA 5?
A: About twice the size, according to Rockstar's head of development Rob Nelson. Rockstar has not given the figure in square miles or kilometres.

Q: How big is the GTA 6 map in square miles?
A: There is no official number. Figures such as 120 to 130 square miles are estimates worked out from Rockstar's comparisons, and published estimates disagree with each other.

Q: Is Vice City bigger than Los Santos?
A: Yes. Rockstar says Vice City alone is about twice the size of Los Santos, and far larger again once its suburbs are counted.

Q: Is the GTA 6 map bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2?
A: Yes. Rockstar puts it at about three times the size of the Red Dead Redemption 2 map.

# GTA 6 vs GTA 5: 14 New Features That Change How You Play

URL: https://gta6box.com/blog/gta-6-new-features/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- GTA 6 changes the core loop more than any GTA since San Andreas: two leads instead of three, a six-star wanted level with heat, and cash you can lose.
- The map is about twice the size of GTA 5's, with a much denser Vice City, more interiors and more than 170 animal species.
- Progress systems are new too: 80 challenges, 61 cheats that unlock after the story, and a 35-line 100% checklist.

GTA 6's new features change the basics you know from GTA 5: who you play, how the police hunt you, what happens to your money, and how you unlock extras. Thirteen years separate the two games, and you notice it within the first hour. Below are the 14 changes that matter most in practice, what each one means for how you play, and what GTA 6 still does not have.
Everything here is confirmed by Rockstar or by at least two independent launch guides. Where the guides disagree, we say so.
GTA 6 vs GTA 5 at a glance

Feature
GTA 5 (2013)
GTA 6 (2026)

Playable characters
Three: Michael, Franklin, Trevor
Two: Jason and Lucia

Switching characters
Available almost from the start
Unlocks in Chapter 2

Wanted level
Five stars
Six stars, plus heat icons

Map
San Andreas: Los Santos and Blaine County
Leonida: Vice City and five more regions, about twice the size

Your cash
Safe on the character
Carried cash is lost when wasted or busted; bank it

Fast travel
Taxis
RydeMe app, with a paid skip

Cheats
Button codes from the start
61 cheats that unlock after the story

Side goals
Scattered tasks and collectibles
80 challenges in 8 categories

Radio
In vehicles
In vehicles and on foot with earbuds

Online at launch
GTA Online followed two weeks later
Single-player only; no online mode dated

Frame rate on new consoles
60 FPS mode in the re-release
30 FPS target on every console

1. Two leads instead of three
GTA 5 split its story between three men with separate lives. GTA 6 follows a couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, and many missions put them in the same scene: one drives while the other shoots, or one keeps watch while the other works.
Why it matters: the story feels more personal, and missions are built around two people cooperating rather than three running in parallel. Expect fewer "pick your character" moments and more shared jobs.
2. Switching unlocks later, and works differently
In GTA 5 you could jump between characters almost from the start. In GTA 6, switching opens up in Chapter 2. You hold Right on the D-pad and press R1 (RB on Xbox).
Tip: until Chapter 2 you are locked to the character the story gives you, so do not worry if the option is missing early on. Our beginner's guide covers the controls for the first hours.
3. Six wanted stars, and the heat system
GTA 5's wanted meter stopped at five stars. GTA 6 goes to six, and adds a second layer underneath: red heat icons that show what the police know about you, such as your face, your clothes and your vehicle.
Why it matters: escaping is no longer only about breaking line of sight. If police still know your car and outfit, they can pick you up again. Swap vehicles, change clothes and stay out of the area they were searching. Full breakdown: GTA 6 wanted level explained.
4. A map about twice the size of GTA 5's
Rockstar's developers say Leonida is about twice the size of the GTA 5 map and about three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2's. Vice City on its own is said to be about twice the size of Los Santos.
The bigger change may be density. Rockstar North has said the roads are narrower than in GTA 5, which leaves room for more buildings, and that there are far more interiors than in any earlier Rockstar game. See how big the GTA 6 map is and the region-by-region map guide.
5. Your cash can be lost
In GTA 6, money in your pocket is at risk. Carried cash is lost when you are wasted or busted, so the safe move is to put it in the bank once your BuckMe account opens.
Tip: after any big job, such as a jewelry store robbery, find an ATM before you start something risky. The bank app on your phone shows the nearest one. More in how to make money in GTA 6.
6. The phone runs your life
The phone is now the hub for everyday systems:

BuckMe is your bank, with an ATM finder.
RydeMe is a ride service that works as fast travel. You can watch the drive or pay $100 to skip it.
Reminders collects messages and contacts waiting for a reply.

GTA 5's phone was mainly for calls, missions and the internet. In GTA 6 it is closer to the phone you actually use.
7. Stealing a car takes more than one button
Official gameplay shows car theft as a short hands-on sequence, working on a window before you drive off, rather than an instant break-in. After a job, the leads burn a getaway car to cover their tracks, which ties into the heat system above.
8. Racing on real circuits
GTA 5 raced mostly on public roads. GTA 6 adds purpose-built race tracks, with wheel-to-wheel racing shown in Rockstar's Extended Look. Three venues appear by name in cheat unlock conditions: Gellhorn Raceway, Thrillbilly Mud Club and Boone Speedway. See Port Gellhorn.
9. 80 challenges with real rewards
GTA 6 groups its side goals into 80 challenges, ten in each of eight categories: combat, criminal, exploration, fitness, shopping, sports, survival and vehicle. Finishing five in a category, and then all ten, unlocks a vehicle spawn cheat. All 80 unlock the hardest one, the Hauners P-996 LAZER jet.
Why it matters: side activities now feed directly into rewards you can use, instead of only ticking a box. Full list: GTA 6 challenges.
10. Cheats are a reward, not a shortcut
GTA 5 let you type cheat codes from the first minute. GTA 6 has 61 cheats, but the Cheats menu only opens after you finish the story, and each cheat has its own unlock task, such as shooting-range medals or collectibles. The money cheat, which GTA 5 never had, gives $250,000.
Codes have been published for 18 of the 61 so far. See the full table in GTA 6 cheats.
11. A much bigger collectible hunt
The numbers are large: 18 collectible card sets with 480 cards, 125 cocaine flamingos, 34 luxury watches, plus WAiNK scans, underwater discoveries and meditation spots. Many of them unlock cheats or count toward 100%. Start with GTA 6 collectibles.
12. A 100% checklist you can actually read
Instead of a hidden percentage, GTA 6 shows a 35-line checklist after the story, split into Story & Tasks, Exploration & Activities, and Discovery. Most lines ask for less than the full total, for example 300 of 397 stunts, so you can skip the activities you like least. Details: GTA 6 100% completion.
13. A living Leonida: animals and radio

Wildlife. Rockstar says GTA 6 has more than 170 animal species, including alligators, flamingos, pelicans and manatees, all new to Rockstar's games. See GTA 6 animals.
Radio on foot. You can listen through the phone with earbuds, not only in a car. Rockstar has detailed six stations with hosts such as Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Morgan Wallen. See GTA 6 radio stations.

14. More saves and a longer story
There are 15 manual save slots, reached from the pause menu under Game. The story is far longer than GTA 5's: launch guides report 91 main missions, and one Rockstar studio head put his own playthrough at about 80 hours. See how long GTA 6 is.
What GTA 6 does not have (yet)
Not everything is an upgrade on day one:

No online mode. Rockstar describes GTA 6 at launch as a single-player experience. GTA Online arrived two weeks after GTA 5; nothing similar has been dated for GTA 6. See GTA 6 online.
No PC version. It is on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only. See GTA 6 on PC.
No 60 FPS mode. Every console targets 30 FPS, including the PS5 Pro. See does GTA 6 run at 60 FPS.
No three-way switching. Two leads, not three.

Which changes to learn first
If you are starting today, these four make the biggest difference in the first hours:

Bank your cash as soon as BuckMe opens, so a bad chase does not wipe out a job.
Learn the heat icons before your first robbery, so you know when to swap cars or clothes.
Open the challenge list early. Workouts, races and shooting ranges you do during the story already count.
Save often. With 15 slots, keep one before every big mission.

Is GTA 6 better than GTA 5?
Critics overwhelmingly say yes. GTA 6 holds a Metacritic score of 99, with top scores from outlets including IGN, GameSpot and Game Informer. The most common complaints are the 30 FPS target and occasional performance dips. Our summary of the reviews is here: GTA 6 reviews.
What we will add to this page
We will expand this comparison as we test more systems in the released game, including property, businesses and how far the economy goes after the story. If a patch changes any of the features above, we will update the table and the date at the top.

Q: What are the biggest new features in GTA 6?
A: Two playable leads, a six-star wanted level with a heat system, a map about twice the size of GTA 5's, carried cash you can lose, a bank and ride app on your phone, 80 challenges, and 61 cheats that unlock after the story.

Q: Is GTA 6 better than GTA 5?
A: Critics think so: GTA 6 holds a Metacritic score of 99. The main complaint is the 30 FPS target on consoles.

Q: What does GTA 5 have that GTA 6 does not?
A: At launch, GTA 6 has no online mode, no PC version and no 60 FPS option, and its cheats are locked until the story is finished. GTA 5 also lets you switch between three characters rather than two.

# GTA 6 Physical Copy: Is There a Disc?

URL: https://gta6box.com/buying/gta-6-physical-copy/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- Boxed copies of GTA 6 contain a download code, not a disc.
- Only the Standard Edition is sold in a box; the Ultimate Edition is digital only.
- A boxed copy needs the same download of up to 212 GB.

GTA 6 has a physical edition, but there is no disc in it. The box holds a code that you redeem in the PlayStation or Xbox store, and the game then downloads like any digital purchase.
What the boxed copy is

Boxed copy
Digital copy

Edition
Standard only
Standard or Ultimate

What you receive
A download code
A store licence

Download size
Up to 212 GB
Up to 212 GB

Works without a disc drive
Yes
Yes

Pre-order bonus before November 20, 2026
Yes, on the same code
Yes

What this changes for you

Storage: a boxed copy saves no space. See GTA 6 file size.
Internet: you need a connection to download the game.
Resale and lending: a redeemed code cannot be passed on. Only a sealed, unused code has resale value.
Gifting: a boxed copy is still the simple way to give the game to someone.

Why buy the box at all

You prefer to pay in a shop or with a gift card.
You want something to wrap.
A retailer has a better price than the console store.

If none of those apply, buying digitally is the same game with fewer steps. For edition differences, see GTA 6 price and editions.

Q: Will GTA 6 have a disc?
A: No. The physical edition is a box with a download code inside.

Q: Can I resell a GTA 6 physical copy?
A: Only while the code is unused. Once it is redeemed, the game is tied to that account.

Q: Does GTA 6 work on a PS5 without a disc drive?
A: Yes. Because the game is a download on every version, it works on digital consoles.

# GTA 6 Prologue Walkthrough: The First Mission Step by Step

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-prologue-walkthrough/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: confirmed

- Prologue is the first mission in GTA 6 and you play it as Lucia.
- It starts at Hamlet Correctional and teaches talking, aiming and running on foot.
- There is no reward and nothing to miss; the next mission is Gone Fishing.

This GTA 6 Prologue walkthrough covers the first mission of the game from the opening cell to the final cutscene. Prologue is short and works as a tutorial. You play as Lucia, and the mission leads straight into Gone Fishing.
Before you start

Detail
Info

Mission
Prologue (GTA 6 first mission)

Playable character
Lucia

Starts at
Hamlet Correctional, in Lucia's cell

Requirement
None, it begins when you start a new game

Reward
None

Next mission
Gone Fishing

You cannot prepare for this mission. There is no free roam before it, and no choice here changes the story.
Objectives
The exact wording differs a little between guides, but the order is the same:

Talk to your cellmates.
Go with the prison guard.
Threaten the teller and grab the cash.
Lose the cops.
Return to the coffee shop.

Step-by-step
1. Talk to your cellmates
Lucia starts at the window of her cell. Turn around and face one of the cellmates. Hold L2/LT to focus on a person, then use the prompt to speak. This is the game's first lesson in how talking to people works, and you will use it for the whole story.
2. Go with the prison guard
After a short wait, a guard, CO Wilson, opens the cell and walks Lucia through the block. He stops in the common area for a phone call, then carries on. Follow him down the corridor to the counselor's office. You can look at other inmates on the way, but the mission only moves on when you reach the office.
The counselor's questions start a flashback to the crime that put Lucia in prison.
3. Rob the payday loan store
You take control again inside a payday loan store.

Hold L2/LT to aim at the teller.
Press Square/X to threaten him. He starts handing over cash.
Pick up the money from the counter.
A customer grabs Lucia from behind. Press the button shown on screen to shake him off.

4. Lose the cops
Police arrive as Lucia leaves, and you have to run. Jump and climb over obstacles with X/A. The flashing blue and red area on the minimap is the zone the police are searching. For how that system works in the open world, see GTA 6 wanted level.
Guides do not agree on this section:

Source
What it says about the chase

PowerPyx, GTABase
You cannot escape. The game cuts back to the counselor's office by itself.

VGC
You can be caught, which ends the mission in cutscenes, or you can get away on foot or in a vehicle, which leads to the coffee shop section.

In practice this does not matter for progress. Both versions end the mission the same way, and none of the guides lists a fail state here.
5. Return to the coffee shop
When the chase is over, follow the marker on the minimap back to the coffee shop. Lucia is arrested as she gets close. This is scripted and cannot be avoided. A cutscene explains why she went back, and the Prologue ends.
Where players fail

Trying too hard to win the chase. The arrest is part of the story. If the police catch you or the scene cuts away, nothing has gone wrong.
Missing the talk prompt. You have to hold L2/LT on a cellmate first. Walking up to them is not enough.
Not picking up the money. The teller puts the cash on the counter. The robbery does not move on until you take it.

Optional goals and rewards
Guides list no optional goals and no reward for the Prologue. PowerPyx also reports that GTA 6 has no mission medals and no mission replay, so there is nothing to come back for.
After the final cutscene the story moves to Chapter 1 and to Jason. Continue with the Gone Fishing walkthrough, or see the full GTA 6 mission list.

Q: What is the first mission in GTA 6?
A: The first mission in GTA 6 is called Prologue. You play as Lucia, starting in a cell at Hamlet Correctional. It is followed by Gone Fishing, the first Chapter 1 mission.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 Prologue walkthrough for the chase?
A: Yes. Run from the store, climb over obstacles and keep moving. Guides differ on whether the chase can be won, but every guide agrees the mission ends the same way, so you cannot fail the story here.

Q: Who do you play as in the GTA 6 Prologue?
A: Lucia. Jason becomes playable in the second mission, Gone Fishing.

Q: Does the Prologue give a reward?
A: No. Guides list no reward for the Prologue. It is a tutorial that sets up the story.

# How Long Is GTA 6? Story Length and Missions

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-story-length/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- The only figure from Rockstar is about 80 hours, from one studio head's own playthrough.
- That run included optional goals, so it is not a story-only time.
- Launch guides report 91 main story missions.

GTA 6 takes about 80 hours to finish, going by the one number Rockstar has given. Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North, said his own playthrough took around 80 hours. It covered the main story and some optional goals that affect how scenes play out.
What the 80 hours does and does not mean

It is one developer's playthrough, reported in an interview in August 2026.
It includes some optional content, so the story alone may be shorter.
It is not a completion time. Collectibles, challenges and activities add many more hours.

GTA 6 compared with earlier games

Game
Main story

GTA 6
About 80 hours (developer playthrough with optional goals)

GTA 5
About 32 hours

How many missions are there?
Several launch guides report 91 main story missions, the number you must finish before cheats unlock. Rockstar itself has not published a count. Our GTA 6 mission list grows as each mission is verified, and it will give the real total.
Planning your playthrough

Cheats unlock only after the credits, so the first run is cheat-free: see GTA 6 cheats.
Several cheats are tied to side activities such as workouts, shooting ranges and races. Doing these as you go saves time later.
If you have limited hours, follow the story missions and leave collectibles for free roam.

Q: How long is GTA 6 story mode?
A: About 80 hours, going by the playthrough of Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson, which included some optional goals.

Q: How many missions are in GTA 6?
A: Launch guides report 91 main story missions. Rockstar has not published a count; we are building the list as missions are verified.

Q: Is GTA 6 longer than GTA 5?
A: Yes, by a wide margin. GTA 5's main story takes about 32 hours.

This GTA 6 trophy guide lists all 55 trophies and achievements, what each one asks for, and the order to do them in. The list is the same on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Story trophies are kept vague here to avoid spoilers. We only give a requirement when at least two guides agree on it.

Missable GTA 6 achievements
None of the story trophies can be missed. Two guides flag one trophy as possibly missable:

Positive Mental Attitude. One of the 18 meditation spots is tied to Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it stays available later. Meditate when the game first offers it in Chapter 1 to be safe.

Everything else can be finished in free roam after the story.
GTA 6 platinum roadmap

Play the story. This gives 12 trophies. Meditate in Chapter 1. Do stranger missions as they appear.
Finish the stranger strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a trophy, and 8 strands in total give Strangers & Freaks. Kenton is away for a while after Chapter 1 and comes back later.
Work through the 100% checklist. It shows up after the story. It covers most other trophies on the way, because it asks for more: 300 stunts against 250, 70 challenges against 50, 200 vehicles against 100. See GTA 6 100% completion.
Clean up the one-off trophies. The tank, the airport, the jewelry store, 4-star escape and the hidden ones.

Two trophies need more than the 100% checklist does. Positive Mental Attitude needs all 18 meditation spots, while 100% needs 15. Top Fun needs a win at every drone race location.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 trophy guide for the platinum?
A: Yes. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, needs the other 54 trophies. Finish the story, then work through the 100% checklist, and clean up the stranger missions and one-off trophies.

Q: How many trophies and achievements does GTA 6 have?
A: 55 on PS5: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze. The Xbox list has the same entries and adds up to 1,000G.

Q: Are any GTA 6 trophies missable?
A: Guides flag one as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. One meditation spot is tied to Chapter 1, so meditate there before you move on.

Q: What is the hardest GTA 6 trophy?
A: A Long Road, the gold trophy for 100% completion. It needs far more than any other trophy, for example 300 stunts and 70 challenges.
