# Vice City in GTA 6: Districts and What to Expect

URL: https://gta6box.com/map/gta-6-vice-city/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Vice City is the largest city in GTA 6 and is modelled on Miami.
- It returns for the first time since GTA: Vice City in 2002, now set in the present day.
- Ocean Beach is confirmed by name through the pre-order bonus garage.

Vice City is the heart of GTA 6. It is the biggest city in the state of Leonida and Rockstar's modern take on Miami: beaches, high-rises, nightlife and money.
What is confirmed

It is the main urban area of the map, with the densest streets and crowds.
It is set today, with phones, social media and modern cars. The 1980s version belongs to the 2002 game.
Ocean Beach exists by name. The pre-order bonus garage, Shore Court, is described as being near Ocean Beach.
Local businesses matter to the story. Boobie Ike, a Vice City figure, has interests in property, a strip club and a recording studio, and co-runs the label Only Raw Records. See GTA 6 characters.

Vice City and the rest of Leonida
Vice City is one of six named regions. The others are the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. The full overview is in our GTA 6 map guide.
Things to do in the city
Official footage shows gyms, shops you can rob, beach activities and street life. Radio matters here too: Vice City FM is among the reported stations. See GTA 6 radio stations.
Coming to this page
A district-by-district guide with safehouses, shops, garages and collectibles, added as each is verified in the game.

Q: Is Vice City in GTA 6?
A: Yes. Vice City is the main city of the state of Leonida, where GTA 6 takes place.

Q: What city is GTA 6 based on?
A: Vice City is modelled on Miami, and the wider state of Leonida on Florida.

Q: Is GTA 6 set in the 1980s?
A: No. It is set in the present day. The 1980s setting belonged to 2002's GTA: Vice City.

# GTA 6 Wanted Level Explained: Six Stars and Heat

URL: https://gta6box.com/missions/gta-6-wanted-level/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- GTA 6 has six wanted stars, one more than GTA 5.
- Red heat icons under the stars show what police know: your face, your clothes, your vehicle.
- Changing what the police can recognise is as important as getting out of sight.

GTA 6 uses a six-star wanted level with a new heat layer on top. Stars show how hard the police respond. Heat shows what they know about you. This page is based on Rockstar's Extended Look and hands-on previews, and we will add tested details from the released game.
Stars: how hard the police come
The meter runs from one to six stars. GTA 5 capped it at five, so the top end is higher. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia reach four stars in a chase, with police cars and a helicopter already involved. Rockstar has not listed which crimes give which star level.
Heat: what the police know
Under the stars sits a row of red icons. Each one is a piece of information the police have:

Icon
What police know
How to clear it

Face
What you look like
Wear a mask during crimes, or change your look

Clothes
What you are wearing
Change into a different outfit unseen

Vehicle
What you are driving
Switch to another vehicle

Companion
Who you are with
Split up or stay out of sight

Witnesses who call the police and security cameras are how this information gets collected.
Hot areas
After you escape, the place where police were searching stays marked for a while. Coming back too soon, while they can still recognise you, can restart the chase. Previews report that at six stars the search covers the whole map.
How to lose the cops

Break line of sight.
Get out of the search area.
Change what they can identify: car first, then clothes.
Stay away from the hot area until it cools.

Wanted level cheats
Two reported cheat codes raise heat and the wanted level. Both unlock after escaping 3-star chases; see GTA 6 cheats.

Q: How many wanted stars are in GTA 6?
A: Six. GTA 5 stopped at five; the sixth star was last used in a main game in GTA 4.

Q: What is heat in GTA 6?
A: Heat is the information police hold about you, shown as red icons under the stars: your face, your outfit, your vehicle and who you are with.

Q: How do you lose the police in GTA 6?
A: Break line of sight, leave the search area and change what they can identify: swap vehicles, change clothes or cover your face.

---

# How to Make Money in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter

URL: https://gta6box.com/cheats/how-to-make-money-in-gta-6/
Updated: 2026-11-19
Status: partly

- Selling stolen cars to Moses from Chapter 2 is the first steady income, at about $1,000 or a little more per ordinary car.
- Jewelry store robberies from Chapter 3 pay roughly $10,000 to $20,000 or more each.
- Bank vaults open up late in Chapter 4, pay six figures and bring a 4-star wanted level.

The way to make money in GTA 6 changes with each chapter: sell stolen cars from Chapter 2, rob jewelry stores from Chapter 3 and hit bank vaults late in Chapter 4. This page lists only legitimate in-game methods that at least two launch guides agree on. Where guides give different payouts, we say so. We will add our own tested numbers later.
GTA 6 money methods compared

Method
Unlocks
Reported payout
Risk

Store hold-ups
Start of the game
Small; no agreed figure
Low

Races and other activities

No agreed figure

No agreed figure
Low

Medium

Bank vault robberies
Late Chapter 4
$100,000 or more per job
High, 4 stars

$250,000 cheat
After the story
$250,000
Disables saving

First, protect what you earn
Cash in your pocket is lost when you are wasted or busted. Three guides agree on this.
The fix is a bank account. It opens during the Chapter 1 story mission "Buck Me", which also puts the BuckMe app on your phone. After that, use the app's ATM Finder and deposit your cash at the nearest ATM before you try anything risky.
Early game: hold-ups, races and activities
At the start you have few options, and none of them pay much.

Store hold-ups. Aim your weapon at the clerk and take the cash from the register. Stores, restaurants and gas stations all work. Expect a wanted level; see how the wanted level works.
Races. Race events are spread across the map and pay cash for a win.
Gang operations. These combat-heavy locations reward cash and valuables.
Story missions. They pay a little, and they unlock every better method below.

No two guides give matching payouts for these, so we do not list numbers.
Chapter 2: sell stolen cars to Moses
Moses is the first real source of income in GTA 6. He appears early in Chapter 2, gives you a slim jim for breaking into cars and buys what you bring him.

Steal an ordinary, older car. Moses does not take cars fitted with trackers.
Keep it in good shape. Damage lowers the price.
Drive it to his auto shop and sell it.
Wait a short while. He will not buy another car straight away.

PowerPyx, PC Gamer and Beebom all put a regular car at about $1,000 or a little more. It is not a fortune, but each run takes only a few minutes.
Two more activities are worth knowing in this part of the game. The Demolition Derby at Ambrosia Raceway pays out for a win, and Bret pays for animals you hunt. Guides agree that both exist, but only one gives figures.
Chapter 3: jewelry stores and better cars
Chapter 3 is where the money starts to grow.
Jewelry store robberies
Jobs for Yasmani introduce jewelry store robberies, which the game calls Smash 'n' Grabs. Beebom reports $10,000 to $20,000 per store depending on what you take. PowerPyx reports $10,000 to $25,000. Either way, one store is worth more than ten cars sold to Moses.
Yasmani's work also leads to the snap gun, a tool that opens locked doors without setting off the alarm. Use it to reach back rooms and safes.
Randy and Pay 'n' Spray
Randy is a car fence who arrives in Chapter 3 and wants expensive, high-end cars. He pays far more than Moses, but guides do not agree on the amount: PC Gamer puts car sales at up to $20,000 depending on model and fence, while PowerPyx reports $30,000 or more for a car in perfect condition.
Pay 'n' Spray locations also buy vehicles. GamesRadar says they become available in Chapter 1, while PowerPyx lists selling tracked cars there as a Chapter 3 option, so treat the timing as unconfirmed. For the cars themselves, see our GTA 6 cars guide.
Chapter 4 and after: bank vaults
Bank vault robberies are the top earner. They unlock late in Chapter 4. The method is to follow a security van to a bank and get into the vault while it is open.

Payout: Gamers Heroes reports about $100,000 per bank. PowerPyx reports $100,000 to about $200,000.
Risk: an instant 4-star wanted level, according to PowerPyx and Beebom.

Plan your escape before you go in. A fast vehicle and a second one to switch to make a big difference.
Smaller extras

ATMs. With a winch fitted to your vehicle at a Mod Shop, you can pull out an ATM. It is loud and draws police.
The map index. The Robberies section of the map index lists targets such as Smash 'n' Grab locations, Payday Loan stores and banks, so you can plan a route.

The $250,000 money cheat
GTA 6 has a money cheat that adds $250,000, but it is reported to unlock only after the main story is finished, and an active cheat turns saving off. It cannot help you during the story. The code and steps are in our GTA 6 money cheat post, and every other reported code is on the GTA 6 cheats page.

Q: What is the best way to make money in GTA 6?
A: Late in the story it is bank vault robberies, which guides put at $100,000 or more per job. Before that, jewelry stores in Chapter 3 and car sales to Moses in Chapter 2 are the most reliable.

Q: How to make money in GTA 6 at the start?
A: Hold up store clerks, enter races and play the story until Chapter 2, when Moses starts buying stolen cars. Bank your cash at an ATM, because cash you carry is lost when you are wasted or busted.

Q: Can you make money fast in GTA 6 with a cheat?
A: Only after the story. The reported $250,000 cheat unlocks once the main story is finished, and using it switches off saving.

Q: Where do you sell cars in GTA 6?
A: At Moses' auto shop from Chapter 2, at Pay 'n' Spray locations, and to Randy from Chapter 3 for high-end cars. Cars in good condition sell for more.

A town of cheap motels, closed attractions and strip malls.

# Lucia Caminos in GTA 6: Everything Confirmed

- Her goal is the good life her mother dreamed of, and she is planning it with Jason.

Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6, and the first female lead in a mainline 3D Grand Theft Auto game.
Lucia's backstory
According to Rockstar's official character description:

Her father taught her to fight from a young age.
She grew up in Liberty City and has had to fight for her family.
That fight landed her in Leonida Penitentiary; the first trailer opens with her there.
She got out through "sheer luck" and has decided to make smarter moves from now on.

Lucia and Jason
Lucia is in a relationship with Jason Duval. The second trailer shows Jason picking her up on her release. Rockstar frames the story around the two of them: a simple score goes wrong, and they find themselves on the wrong side of a criminal conspiracy across Leonida, forced to rely on each other.
What Lucia wants
Rockstar describes her as more committed than ever to the good life her mother has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. Rather than daydreaming, Lucia is ready to take control.
Playing as Lucia
You play as both Lucia and Jason. We will document her missions, abilities and any differences from Jason after launch in the missions section.

Q: Who is Lucia in GTA 6?
A: Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable protagonists of GTA 6, alongside her partner Jason Duval.

Standard if you just want to play the story. Nothing in the Ultimate Edition is required to finish the game.
Ultimate if you want the extra in-game items from the start. Check the store listing for the exact contents in your region.

Pre-order bonus: Vintage Vice City Pack
Both editions include the Vintage Vice City Pack if you buy before November 20, 2026. It is themed around the original GTA: Vice City.
Platforms
GTA 6 is available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no PS4 or Xbox One version, and no PC version has been announced; see GTA 6 on PC.
Online purchases
GTA 6 launches as a single-player game. See GTA 6 online for what that means.

Q: How much is GTA 6?
A: In the US, the Standard Edition is $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition is $99.99. Prices in other countries vary by store.

Q: Is the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition worth it?
A: It adds in-game items rather than story content. If you only want the game, the Standard Edition is enough, and an upgrade to Ultimate has been reported at $20 if you change your mind.

Q: What is the GTA 6 pre-order bonus?
A: The Vintage Vice City Pack, included with pre-orders and purchases made before November 20, 2026.

Q: Is there a GTA 6 Collector's Edition?
A: Rockstar has announced two editions: Standard and Ultimate. No physical Collector's Edition has been announced.

# GTA 6 Release Date and Delay History

URL: https://gta6box.com/news/gta-6-release-date/
Updated: 2026-11-18
Status: confirmed

- The GTA 6 release date is Thursday, November 19, 2026.
- It launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only.
- The game was delayed twice: from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026, then to November 19, 2026.

GTA 6 releases on Thursday, November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Q: When does GTA 6 come out?
A: GTA 6 comes out on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Q: How many times was GTA 6 delayed?
A: Twice. It moved from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026, and then to November 19, 2026.

Q: Is GTA 6 on PS4 or Xbox One?
A: No. GTA 6 is only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Q: Is GTA 6 on PC?
A: Not at launch. Rockstar has not announced a PC version.

# GTA 6 Weapons: What Is Confirmed

URL: https://gta6box.com/weapons/gta-6-weapons/
Updated: 2026-11-18
Status: partly

- Rockstar has not published an official GTA 6 weapons list.
- Trailers and screenshots show pistols, rifles, shotguns and melee weapons.
- We will list each weapon with its in-game name, stats and location once verified.

Rockstar has not released a GTA 6 weapons list. Before launch, the only reliable information comes from official trailers and screenshots.
Weapon types seen in official footage

Handguns: pistols and revolvers
Long guns: assault rifles, hunting rifles and shotguns
Melee: bats, knives and improvised weapons

What we don't know yet

The full list and in-game names
How many weapons you can carry and how you switch between them
Where weapons are sold and what they cost
Upgrades and attachments

Details reported from leaks are not confirmed, and we do not publish them as fact.
What our weapons list will include
For each verified weapon:

In-game name and class
Damage, range and rate of fire
Where to buy or find it, and the price
The best missions and situations to use it in

See also: GTA 6 cheats for weapon cheats once they are verified.

Q: What guns are in GTA 6?
A: There is no official list yet. Official footage shows handguns, rifles, shotguns and melee weapons, and we will name each weapon once verified in the game.

Q: Is there a weapon wheel in GTA 6?
A: Rockstar has not detailed the weapon selection system. We will explain how the loadout works after launch.

Q: Where do you buy guns in GTA 6?
A: Earlier GTA games used Ammu-Nation stores. We will confirm the GTA 6 shops and their locations after launch.
